overview.zh: 寇克将军，欢迎您重返企业号！一团硕大无朋的高能离子云，在遥远而神秘的太空中迅疾地飘移。这团能量云具有无坚不摧的威力，足以毁灭宇宙间任何物质结构。在它所划过的轨迹上，早已有好几艘分属银河三大势力的星舰遇难了。地球：银河系星球联邦的重镇，星际舰队总部的所在地。在位于北美洲旧金山的星际联邦舰队总部，寇克将军正像往常一样百无聊赖无所事事，突然间却接到了一个再好不过的命令检视企业号准备执行紧急任务。原来地球的防卫体系己经发现了那团高能离子云，而且侦测出它正对准地球飞来。寇克将军的任务，就是要赶在它到达地球之前，率领企业号先迎上去一探究竟。
overview.en: When an unidentified alien destroys three powerful Klingon cruisers, Captain James T. Kirk returns to the newly transformed U.S.S. Enterprise to take command.

title.en: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan

overview.zh: 邪恶的可汗逃脱十五年前被寇克船长拘禁的星球，他本人是一位智勇双全的领袖，但此刻已变成一个邪恶的狂人，他誓言要向寇克船长讨回血仇。于是他先劫持了一艘联邦战舰，后又偷取了寇克船长的儿子和旧情人制造的毁灭性武器。并引诱企业号投入他精心设计的圈套。
overview.en: The starship Enterprise and its crew is pulled back into action when old nemesis, Khan, steals a top secret device called Project Genesis.

title.en: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock

overview.zh: 2285年，在与可汗的战斗中损坏的联邦星舰进取号，返回了地球的太空港以进行维修。柯克还在为斯波克的死感到悲伤。麦科伊医生出现了种种异常的行为：如擅自闯入被封锁的斯波克原来的舱房、胡言乱语等，最后他被送进了医院进行精神检查。斯科提被另分派到了联邦星舰精进号。星际舰队指挥部对新形成的创世星下达了禁入令。柯克被告知，进取号即将除役。斯波克的父亲沙瑞克找到柯克并告诉他，斯波克的遗体必须返回瓦肯星，否则他的灵魂就不得安息。沙瑞克要求柯克必须回到创世星，寻回斯波克的遗棺并将它带回瓦肯星——而斯波克临死前与麦科伊进行了心灵融合，因此带有斯波克灵魂的麦科伊也必须前往瓦肯星。可是，星际舰队拒绝让陈旧的进取号离开太空港。从医院出来后听闻消息的麦科伊，企图招募一艘飞船回到创世星。在与人争吵时他被逮捕，但这并没有影响到整个计划：在柯克、斯科特、苏鲁、乌乎拉和切科夫的帮助下麦科伊顺利逃脱，并一同登上了被废弃的进取号。为了避免被追击，斯科提还破坏了精进号的引擎。六名伙伴冒着毁掉毕生事业的风险，驾驶进取号航向创世星。其间，克林贡人得知了创世计划和创世星的消息。由于担心联邦将其改造为一种新式武器，克鲁格船长率领一艘克林贡猛禽战舰，去夺取或摧毁这一战略性的武器。
overview.en: A surprise visit from Spock's father provides a startling revelation: McCoy is harboring Spock's living essence.

title.en: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home

overview.zh: 太空探测器发出的怪声导致地球风暴，并面临自毁的威胁。寇克船长和他们的船员再度担负起拯救人类的使命。他们发现怪声其实是座头鲸的呼唤，唯一的选择就是回到20世纪去带回一只座头鲸来对探测器作出回应。
overview.en: When a huge alien probe enters the galaxy and begins to vaporize Earth's oceans, Kirk and his crew must travel back in time in order to bring back whales and save the planet.

title.en: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier

overview.zh: 本片是《星舰旅行》系列电影的第五集，由原班人马主演，但改由饰演寇克船长的威廉·赛特纳执导，也是他的导演处女作。故事描述一名神秘的疯狂幻想家赛布克占领了一个遥远的星球，劫持星际大使作人质，强迫企业号宇宙飞船紧急出发，进入没有人做访过的未知宇宙去寻找传说中的上帝，但上帝到底是谁呢？本片的开场颇具震撼力，可惜发展下去难以为继，使大部分的篇幅在过分玄奥的故事框架中兴圈子，只能靠壮观的视觉特效维持其吸引力，幸好结局是略有起色，不致令观众太过失望。正在基地修整的企业号接受了一项紧急任务，科克船长一行奉命到属于中立区的宁布星球，解救遭到叛徒控制的乐园市民。叛军挟持了企业号到银河系中心去寻找根源。
overview.en: A renegade Vulcan with a startling secret hijacks the U.S.S. Enterprise in order to find a mythical planet.

title.en: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country

overview.zh: 星际联邦的大敌克林贡帝国因为连年争战，经济及生态环境破坏殆尽，一位克林贡领袖遂在企业号太空船护送下前往地球谈和，中途却遭到阴谋份子暗杀，并且嫁祸企业号。
overview.en: After years of war, the Federation and the Klingon empire find themselves on the brink of a peace summit when a Klingon ship is nearly destroyed by an apparent attack from the Enterprise. Both worlds brace for what may be their deadliest encounter.

overview.zh: 寇克等人作为嘉宾乘新企业号试航，途中收到救援任务……而在另一时空，索伦博士正阴谋毁灭星球，攻击企业号。唯一能够帮助新船长皮卡特来阻止索伦的，只有销声匿迹了78年的寇克船长。
overview.en: Captain Jean-Luc Picard and the crew of the Enterprise-D find themselves at odds with the renegade scientist Soran who is destroying entire star systems. Only one man can help Picard stop Soran's scheme...and he's been dead for seventy-eight years.

overview.zh: 本片是以地球人与瓦肯人的“第一类接触”事件为背景，将重心放在《星际迷航之下一代》电视系列剧中的大敌『博格人』。企业号正在宇宙空间做例行巡航时，舰长皮卡特接到密电，称博格人已联合其他星系的力量，准备向地球发起攻击。由于舰长皮卡特曾受敌方俘虏并同化，星际舰队对其不很信任，故没有派其出战。皮卡特不顾命令，仍然参与战斗，之后企业号跟随博格人的时间漩涡回到21世纪，以阻挡博格人试图改变人类的外星发展史达到征服地球的企图。
overview.en: The Borg, a relentless race of cyborgs, are on a direct course for Earth. Violating orders to stay away from the battle, Captain Picard and the crew of the newly-commissioned USS Enterprise E pursue the Borg back in time to prevent the invaders from changing Federation history and assimilating the galaxy.

overview.zh: 皮卡特舰长获知百科（Data）中尉在巴库（Baku）星球被掳为人质后立刻率企业号前往营救。当他们来到巴库星球，整个星球上只居住了六百名巴库人，与世隔绝、摒弃科技、崇尚和平，过着纯朴的生活；百科被掳不像是巴库人的作风，想必另有隐情。皮卡特舰长遇到一名叫做安妮的巴库女子，经由她得知巴库人虽然看起来年轻，星球的原居民巴库其实年龄都已经超过三百岁了。面临老化的索纳（Sons）人，发现巴库人长生不老的秘诀再于巴库星球外围的特殊放射线能不断的重组基因结构。如今巴库人要遭受灭种的威胁……来自外层空间的索纳人联结星际联盟，根据原有的巴库人村落拟造了一个一模一样的环境，预谋将巴库人迁徙到这个虚拟村落，企图独享青春泉源。瑟纳人首领鲁阿弗假藉文化访查之名率众进入巴库星球，企图赶走巴库人，占领巴库星球。皮卡特舰长将所获知的情报呈报杜尔迪司令，却发现司令与星际联邦总部早已知情，并暗中参与这项阴谋。杜尔迪不理会皮卡特的抗议，下令企业号立即撤返，不得干预。毕卡舰长面临了关键性的一刻，若他服从命令就违背了当初加入星际舰队时曾立下的誓言，反之，若采取行动，他则必须放弃事业、组员、企业号、一切！来投入这场天堂之战。
overview.en: When an alien race and factions within Starfleet attempt to take over a planet that has "regenerative" properties, it falls upon Captain Picard and the crew of the Enterprise to defend the planet's people as well as the very ideals upon which the Federation itself was founded.

overview.zh: 企业号宇宙飞船遨游在太空，在人类和外星人中间传播好意，同时也在防范敌对星球有可能的攻击行为，因为有迹象表明，星际联盟的老对头罗木兰星球有可能发起新一轮的攻击。皮卡特船长和他的船员们也在小心翼翼的观察着事态的进展，时刻准备投入战斗。  　　可就在这时，罗木兰星球发出了和谈的讯息，星际联盟命令企业号前往谈判，当皮卡特船长第一次见到罗木兰星球新的执政官后惊呆了，原来对方就是罗木兰很久以前制造的皮卡特的人类复制品，面对这个难缠的对手，皮卡特船长和他的船员们该如何是好？
overview.en: En route to the honeymoon of William Riker to Deanna Troi on her home planet of Betazed, Captain Jean-Luc Picard and the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise receives word from Starfleet that a coup has resulted in the installation of a new Romulan political leader, Shinzon, who claims to seek peace with the human-backed United Federation of Planets. Once in enemy territory, the captain and his crew make a startling discovery: Shinzon is human, a slave from the Romulan sister planet of Remus, and has a secret, shocking relationship to Picard himself.

overview.zh: 史上最伟大的冒险，始于本片——一支年轻船员首次驾驶有史以来最先进的星舰“进取号”的传奇故事。在这场充满动作、喜剧与宇宙危机的旅程中，新招募的队员们必须设法阻止一个其复仇使命威胁全人类的邪恶存在。银河系的命运掌握在两位宿敌手中：一位是来自爱荷华州、叛逆而追求刺激的农场男孩詹姆斯·T·柯克；另一位是在摒弃一切情感的、基于逻辑的社会中长大的史波克。当炽热的本能与冷静的理性相撞，他们之间看似不可能却强大的伙伴关系，是引领团队穿越难以想象的险境、大胆前往前人未至之地的唯一希望！[派拉蒙]
overview.en: The fate of the galaxy rests in the hands of bitter rivals. One, James Kirk, is a delinquent, thrill-seeking Iowa farm boy. The other, Spock, a Vulcan, was raised in a logic-based society that rejects all emotion. As fiery instinct clashes with calm reason, their unlikely but powerful partnership is the only thing capable of leading their crew through unimaginable danger, boldly going where no one has gone before. The human adventure has begun again.

overview.zh: 在尼比鲁星球探查期间，企业号舰长柯克为营救史波克采取了胆大妄为的举动，几乎危及全舰队员的生命，他也为此付出代价。 不久，柯克官复原职，而伦敦发生一起死亡超过四十人的恐怖袭击事件。该事件的始作俑者约翰·哈里森正来自联盟内部。此后他驾驶飞机袭击了高层会议，柯克最为敬重的派克将军不幸遇难。为了阻止哈里森的外逃阴谋，柯克重新率领企业号启程追击。危机重重的旅途，他和舰员、朋友之间的信任也受到巨大考验。  当他们最终找到哈里森，才终于知晓他的真实身份，以及伦敦袭击事件背后的阴谋和黑幕……
overview.en: When the crew of the Enterprise is called back home, they find an unstoppable force of terror from within their own organization has detonated the fleet and everything it stands for, leaving our world in a state of crisis.  With a personal score to settle, Captain Kirk leads a manhunt to a war-zone world to capture a one man weapon of mass destruction. As our heroes are propelled into an epic chess game of life and death, love will be challenged, friendships will be torn apart, and sacrifices must be made for the only family Kirk has left: his crew.

overview.zh: 柯克船长带领企业号继续踏上宇宙探索的旅程，他向老骨头讲述了自己对于船长身份的忧虑，而在他与最好的朋友史波克互诉衷肠前，他们又接到了一个紧急救援的任务。而神秘敌人剋劳开始攻击企业号，而幸存的企业号成员也分散至一个行星上求生……
overview.en: The USS Enterprise crew explores the furthest reaches of uncharted space, where they encounter a mysterious new enemy who puts them and everything the Federation stands for to the test.

overview.zh: 杨紫琼饰演平行宇宙的Philippa Georgiou女皇，加入了“第31区”，即星际迷航里的秘密警察组织。 剧情会集中在Philippa Georgiou于「第31区」的冒险。
overview.en: Emperor Philippa Georgiou joins a secret division of Starfleet tasked with protecting the United Federation of Planets and faces the sins of her past.

overview.zh:
电视剧《星际迷航》（Star Trek），后称《星际迷航：原初系列》（Star Trek: The Original Series），是一部在文化上有重大意义的科幻电视系列剧，由吉恩·罗登伯里 (Gene Roddenberry) 于 1960 年代所创造。它有广大的爱好者，《电视指南》（TV Guide）将它评为“史上 25 大人文电视剧”的第一名，之后更陆续制播了 5 部衍生电视系列剧以及 12 部院线电影。吉尼斯世界纪录大全更将它列入有最多衍生作品的项目。

　　故事的设定是发生在有着乌托邦背景的 23 世纪，《原初系列》的故事是叙述星舰“企业号”以及它的航员的历险过程。每一集开头的旁白说明了他们的目标：宇宙，人类的终极边疆。这里叙述的是星舰企业号的旅程，它的五年任务，是为了要探索这全然未知的新世界，寻找新生命和新文明，勇踏前人未至之境。
overview.en: Space. The Final Frontier. The U.S.S. Enterprise embarks on a five year mission to explore the galaxy. The Enterprise is under the command of Captain James T. Kirk with First Officer Mr. Spock, from the planet Vulcan. With a determined crew, the Enterprise encounters Klingons, Romulans, time paradoxes, tribbles and genetic supermen led by Khan Noonian Singh. Their mission is to explore strange new worlds, to seek new life and new civilizations, and to boldly go where no man has gone before.

overview.zh: 柯克船长、史波克大副、麦考伊博士和其他进取号船员开始了为期五年的太空探索任务。
柯克和他的船员正面临着一种以人体内的盐为食，并可能以任何形式出现的外星生物的致命危险。
overview.en: Doctor Leonard “Bones” McCoy meets a former girlfriend when the enterprise brings supplies to a remote archaeological survey group. Still attractive to McCoy, the woman's current appearance hides a dark and deadly secret.

overview.zh: 查尔斯·埃文斯自幼被非实体生物抚养长大，17岁时被接走并转移到企业号上。在舰船上，这位少年证明了自己无法成熟地掌控其巨大的心灵感应能力，这带来了危险。
overview.en: Raised from boyhood by non-corporeal beings, 17 year old Charles Evans is picked up and transferred to the Enterprise. On board the ship, the teenager proves dangerously unable to wield his enormous psionic powers with maturity.

name.en: Where No Man Has Gone Before

overview.zh: 在探索银河系边缘时，“企业号”遇到了一道能量屏障，这道屏障赋予了两名船员神圣的力量。
overview.en: When Enterprise encounters a Force Field at the edge of the Galaxy, one of the crew members psionic abilities are accelerated to God like proportions causing him to become a powerful murderous being.

overview.zh: 当飞船脱离轨道时，一种奇怪的外星物质使船员们表现出他们最深的抑制。
overview.en: An alien virus strips the enterprise crew of their inhibitions, causing chaos as each crew member is overcome by hidden emotions. Meanwhile, the Enterprise is being pulled inexorably into a nearby planet's gravity well.

overview.zh: 运输机故障导致柯克上尉分裂成“善”和“恶”两个自我，如果他们不把这两个自我合并在一起，登陆队就会冻死。
overview.en: Split by a transporter malfunction into two beings with very different personalities, the resulting twin Captain Kirk proves that neither a purely evil nor a sweetly good captain can survive without the missing half.

overview.zh: 企业号抓到了一个星际骗子哈里·穆德和三个隐藏着一个黑暗秘密的漂亮女人。
overview.en: Rescuing the crew of a ship from an asteroid belt, the Enterprise plays host to conman extraordinaire, the cunning Harry Mudd and his cargo: three beautiful women looking for suitors.

name.en: What Are Little Girls Made Of?

overview.zh: 护士克里斯汀·查珀在Exo III上与她的前未婚夫重聚，但这位科学家对柯克船长和联邦有谋划。
overview.en: Helping nurse Christine Chapel search for her fiancé, the Enterprise finds a detached Dr. Korby working on a plan to create Android duplicates of key figures, beginning with James Kirk.

overview.zh: 柯克和一个登陆队由于一种疾病被困在一个星球上，这种疾病会导致任何成年人痛苦地死去，他们必须处理当地幸存下来的儿童。
overview.en: On a planet populated by children whose aging process has been slowed artificially. Kirk’s  landing party members contract a virus that kills adults. Despite their violent attacks, Kirk is determined to help the children.

overview.zh: 柯克调查了一个关押囚犯的实验设施，发现了一个险恶的阴谋。
overview.en: When a wild eyed maniac escaping from the Tantalus Penal Colony turns out to be one of the psychiatric staff, Kirk investigates the institution and discovers a chilling exercise in mind control.

overview.zh: 企业号遇到了一艘巨大的外星飞船，正准备对其进行测试。
overview.en: Threatened by the sinister captain of a powerful alien vessel, Kirk claims that the Enterprise carries a powerful explosive which will destroy both ships. The move produces unexpected actions from the alien adversary.

overview.zh: 斯波克绑架了他的前任船长，残废的克里斯托弗·派克，并前往一个被隔离的星球，这使他的职业生涯和柯克的生命处于危险之中。
overview.en: Apparently summoned to Star Base 11, Kirk, Spock and McCoy visit a former Enterprise Commander, the paralyzed and horribly disfigured Christopher Pike. Uncharacteristically, Spock commandeers the Enterprise, then turns himself in for court martial.

overview.zh: 斯波克的军事法庭仍在继续，他试图为绑架派克、盗窃企业号以及前往一个被星际舰队宣布为禁地的星球辩护。
overview.en: Spock's court martial reveals the actions of Captain Pike on his previous visit to Talos IV, where the powerful Talosians tried to persuade Pike to breed with women provided for the purpose.

overview.zh: 柯克是最后一批能够辨认出潜伏在企业号上的莎士比亚剧团中的大规模杀人犯的幸存者之一。
overview.en: Contacted by one of the other two witnesses to the crimes of mass murderer  “Kodos the Executioner,” Kirk is persuaded that the criminal may be disguising himself as an actor in a traveling theatrical troupe.

overview.zh: 柯克将企业号与一艘隐形宇宙飞船对峙，测试联邦防御系统。
overview.en: Despite the earlier Romulan war, the Romulans have never been seen in person. The Enterprise, in pursuit of a Romulan aggressor, makes a discovery that causes suspicion about a senior crew member.

overview.zh: 企业号船员在一个和平、田园的星球上休假。。。他们的梦想和幻想在那里实现。
overview.en: When McCoy sees the White Rabbit from Alice in Wonderland, the crew begins to realize that the planet they are visiting seems to have the dangerous power to turn any thought into reality.

overview.zh: 斯波克指挥着一支被困的客场球队，他们的穿梭机被困在一个有敌对土著的星球上。
overview.en: Crash landing on a planet populated by hostile giants, the 7-man crew of the shuttlecraft Galileo find themselves unable to communicate with the enterprise or to escape the planet's atmosphere.

overview.zh: 企业号发现自己受制于一个似乎无所不能的人，他自以为是18世纪的英国人。
overview.en: Encountering an uncharted planet in an empty region of space, Kirk and his crew are entertained by Trelane, a playful being who lacks the self-control to wield his great psionic powers with discipline.

overview.zh: 当一个神秘的外星种族摧毁了一个地球殖民地时，企业号追击，但是柯克和外星船长被强大的外星人逼迫相互争斗。
overview.en: With both their ships held captive by powerful beings, Kirk and the captain of the alien vessel are placed on an asteroid to fight for their lives and the lives of their crews.

overview.zh: 企业号与黑洞相撞，并在20世纪被抛回地球，在那里他们必须找到一条返回的路，抹去他们存在的任何痕迹。当他们营救一名空军飞行员时，事情变得复杂起来，如果不改变历史，就无法将他送回。。。但如果他消失了，这也将改变历史。
overview.en: In a freak accident the Enterprise is sent back to 20th century Earth, and must find their way back without changing history.

overview.zh: 柯克上尉因在离子风暴中失去一名船员而受审，他的职业生涯岌岌可危。
overview.en: Captain Kirk's career is at stake when he is put on trial for the loss of a crewman during an ion storm.

overview.zh: 企业号遇到了一个看似和平的文明，由一个名为兰德鲁的“仁者”经营。。。他打算让他们加入他的人民。
overview.en: The Enterprise encounters a seemingly peaceful civilization run by a "benevolent" being named Landru... who intends for them to join his people.

overview.zh: 企业号遇上野蛮残忍的超级人类，其首领可汗·努宁·辛格挑战寇克以夺取控制权，更说服一名可靠的同事变节，转而对抗星舰。
overview.en: The Enterprise picks up a crew of genetic supermen from the 20th century... and their leader, Khan, plans to create a new empire.

overview.zh: 企业号到达一个星球建立外交关系，发现自己处于一场“和平”的战争中，被威胁着要摧毁这艘船。
overview.en: The Enterprise arrives at a planet to establish diplomatic relations and finds itself in the middle of a "peaceful" war that threatens to destroy the ship.

overview.zh: “企业”号机组人员前来营救殖民者时，被困在天堂里。这些殖民者已沦为安抚外来孢子的牺牲品，企业号自己也被感染了。
overview.en: The Enterprise crew try to rescue colonists from deadly radiation, but instead encounter strange alien spores that seem to offer paradise.

overview.zh: 柯克调查了一个采矿星球上的一系列可怕的谋杀案，这些谋杀案是一个看似敌对的外星生物所为。
overview.en: Kirk investigates a series of grisly murders on a mining planet that are the work of a seemingly hostile alien creature.

overview.zh: 联邦和Kron帝国在战争边缘徘徊，因为Kirk调查了一个被和平主义者居住在Organia中间的卑微行星。
overview.en: The Federation and the Klingon Empire teeter on the brink of war as Kirk investigates Organia, a humble planet, inhabited by pacifists, that is unwittingly caught in the middle.

overview.zh: 柯克和斯波克遇到了一个名叫拉扎勒斯的外星人，他自称来自反物质宇宙。
overview.en: Kirk and Spock encounter an alien named Lazarus who claims to be from an anti-matter universe.

name.en: The City on the Edge of Forever

overview.zh: 柯克和斯波克必须回到过去，以纠正将改变历史的变化。
overview.en: Kirk and Spock must travel into the past in order to correct a change that will alter history.

overview.zh: 柯克和企业号必须与寄生外星人作战。
overview.en: Kirk and the Enterprise must combat parasitic aliens threatening the lives of millions.

overview.zh: 该剧第二季共 26 集，始于 1972 年 9 月的《狂躁时刻》（Amok Time），演员沃尔特·柯尼格（Walter Koenig）在其中饰演俄罗斯航海家帕维尔·切科夫（Pavel Chekov），观众们第一次看到了斯波克的家乡火神星。这一季还包括一些值得注意的剧集，比如“镜像世界”，介绍了“镜像宇宙”；《巴别塔之旅》（Journey to Babel），介绍了斯波克的父母萨瑞克和阿曼达；以及后来在《星际迷航：动画系列》和《星际迷航：深空九号》的一集中重新出现的漫画《小麻烦》。
大副斯波克回到他的家乡去进行一场残忍的火神交配仪式。
overview.en: First Officer Spock returns to his home world for a brutal Vulcan mating ritual.

overview.zh: 企业号的船员被一个外星人俘虏，他原来是希腊神阿波罗。
overview.en: The crew of the Enterprise are held captive by an alien who turns out to be the Greek god Apollo.

overview.zh: “企业号”航母的机组人员正在处理一个摧毁行星的太空探测器。
overview.en: The crew of the USS Enterprise deals with an indestructible planet-destroying space probe.

overview.zh: 在一个平行宇宙中，一场运输事故将柯克船长和他的同伴与他们邪恶的对手互换。在所谓的镜像宇宙中，企业号是一个邪恶的组织人族帝国的一艘飞船，就像行星联合会是仁慈的。
overview.en: A transporter mishap swaps Captain Kirk and his companions with their evil counterparts in a parallel universe. In the so-called Mirror Universe, the Enterprise is a ship of the Terran Empire, an organization as evil as the United Federation of Planets is benevolent.

overview.zh: “企业号”的机组人员访问了一个由当地居民提供服务的计算机控制的神秘天堂星球。
overview.en: The crew of the Enterprise visits a mysterious paradisical planet controlled by a computer that is served by the local inhabitants.

overview.zh: “企业号”星际飞船及其严重受损的姊妹舰“星座号”必须共同努力，阻止一架外星行星杀手驶向联邦领土的中心地带。
overview.en: The starship Enterprise and its heavily-damaged sister ship, the USS Constellation, must work together to stop an alien planet-killing machine headed for the heart of Federation territory.

overview.zh: 两个强大的外星人威胁着企业号和全体船员。
overview.en: Two powerful aliens threaten the well-being of the Enterprise and her crew.

overview.zh: 柯克上尉与骗子哈里·穆德再次交锋。穆德现在是一个机器人星球的最高统治者，他满足于自己的每一个突发奇想。
overview.en: Captain Kirk has a second run-in with the conman, Harry Mudd. Mudd is now the supreme ruler of a planet of androids who cater to his every whim.

overview.zh: 企业号的一名机组人员遇到了一位来自历史的人和他的神秘外星同伴。
overview.en: A shuttle crew from the USS Enterprise encounters a man out of history and his mysterious alien companion.

overview.zh: 企业号必须运送政要参加和平会议，而刺客却逍遥法外。
overview.en: The Enterprise must transport dignitaries to a peace conference, with an assassin on the loose.

overview.zh: 企业号的船员陷入了一个星球的部落权力斗争。
overview.en: The crew of the Enterprise become entangled in a planet's tribal power struggle.

overview.zh: 奇怪的辐射使企业号的指挥人员暴露在快速老化的影响之下。
overview.en: Strange radiation exposes the command crew of the Enterprise to the effects of rapid aging.

overview.zh: 詹姆斯·T·柯克上尉痴迷于摧毁一个他年轻时曾遇到的致命实体。
overview.en: Captain James T. Kirk becomes obsessed with destroying a deadly entity he once encountered in his youth.

overview.zh: 一系列奇怪的谋杀案表明斯科特先生是首要嫌疑人。
overview.en: A series of bizarre murders points to Mr. Scott as the prime suspect.

overview.zh: 这艘飞船前往深空站K7，守护一批运往谢尔曼星球的谷物。到达后，一位名叫Cyrano Jones的交易员向Uhura中尉进行了一番讨价还价，结果十分严重。柯克和船员们还必须应对科洛斯船长和他的克林贡巡洋舰的到来，但这次突袭意外地揭露了一个毒害谷物的阴谋。
overview.en: The Enterprise must protect a very important shipment of grain from both Klingons and some adorable creatures called tribbles.

overview.zh: 柯克船长和他的同伴被绑架为奴隶，并被训练成角斗士，以博彩娱乐三个无形的生物。
overview.en: Captain Kirk and his companions are abducted into slavery and trained to fight as gladiators for the gambling entertainment of three disembodied beings.

overview.zh: 《企业号》访问了一个有着类似地球的20世纪20年代黑帮文化的星球，有着Runyon式的对话和服装。
overview.en: The Enterprise visits a planet with an Earth-like 1920s gangster culture.

overview.zh: 企业号的船员遇到了一个消耗能量的太空生物。
overview.en: The crew of the Enterprise encounters an energy-draining field which may be able to destroy the galaxy.

overview.zh: 企业号的机组人员发现克林贡人干涉了一个曾经和平的星球的发展，并加入他们成为一场军备竞赛。
overview.en: The crew of the Enterprise discovers Klingon interference in the development of a formerly peaceful planet and is forced to help maintain a balance of power.

overview.zh: 具有心灵感应能力的外星人控制了柯克船长和斯波克大副的尸体。
overview.en: Ancient alien minds are given control of Captain Kirk's and First Officer Spock's bodies.

overview.zh: 企业号机组人员在一个由“纳齐斯克”政权统治的星球上追踪一名联邦观察员。
overview.en: The crew of the Enterprise tracks down a Federation observer on a planet dominated by a "Naziesque" regime.

overview.zh: 来自另一个星系的生物强占了企业号，试图返回家园。
overview.en: Beings from another galaxy commandeer the Enterprise in an attempt to return home.

overview.zh: 柯克船长必须找到一种致命疾病的治疗方法，并结束另一位星际舰队船长的文化干涉。
overview.en: Captain Kirk must find the cure to a deadly disease and put an end to another Starfleet captain's cultural interference.

overview.zh: 一名企业号骨干船员被指派测试一个革命性的计算机系统，该系统被赋予对船舶的全面控制权。
overview.en: A skeleton Enterprise crew are assigned to test a revolutionary computer system that is given total control of the ship.

overview.zh: 企业号船员在一个现代版的罗马帝国星球上调查船员失踪事件。
overview.en: The Enterprise crew investigates the disappearance of a ship's crew on a planet that is a modern version of the Roman Empire.

overview.zh: 1968年，《企业号》的工作人员在观测地球时遇到了神秘的加里七号，他在地球上有自己的计划。
overview.en: While back in time observing Earth in 1968, the Enterprise crew encounters the mysterious Gary Seven who has his own agenda on the planet.

overview.zh: 《星际迷航》最后一季共 24 集，始于 1968 年 9 月的“斯波克的大脑”。第三季还包括“寇克受困”，寇克被困在两个宇宙之间；2005 年前传系列《星际迷航：进取号》的两集《黑暗的镜像》（in a Mirror, darkness）中再次出现了这一集。该系列的最后一集“女性的复仇”于 1969 年 6 月 3 日播出，但《星际迷航》最终将以动画形式回归电视，《星际迷航：动画系列》于1973年9月首播。
一名外星女性登上飞船，在使其他船员丧失能力后，通过外科手术切除了斯波克的大脑。柯克和船员只有几个小时的时间在斯波克的身体死前找到并更换它。
overview.en: An alien female beams aboard the ship and, after incapacitating the rest of the crew, surgically removes Spock's brain. Kirk and the crew have just hours to locate and replace it before Spock's body dies.

overview.zh: 企业号的船员正在执行一项秘密任务，去偷一个罗慕兰隐形装置。
overview.en: The crew of the Enterprise are on a secret mission to steal a Romulan cloaking device.

overview.zh: 一个原始行星上的外星装置抹去了柯克船长的记忆，他开始了与该行星土著人民的新生活。
overview.en: An alien device on a primitive planet erases Captain Kirk's memory, and he begins a new life with the planet's indigenous people.

overview.zh: 在一个遥远的星球上，柯克、斯波克和麦考伊发现了一个科学小组的尸体，以及他们的孩子，船员们不知道这些孩子，他们拥有强大的力量。
overview.en: On a distant planet, Kirk, Spock and McCoy find a scientific team dead, and their children who, unknown to the crew, have great powers at their disposal.

name.en: Is There in Truth No Beauty?

overview.zh: 企业号和一位外星大使一起旅行，外星大使的出现会让人发疯。
overview.en: The Enterprise travels with an alien ambassador whose appearance induces madness.

overview.zh: 柯克船长和他的同伴被发现闯入梅尔科提安太空，他们被送去死亡，重新上演了奥克畜栏的枪战。
overview.en: Having been found trespassers into Melkotian space, Captain Kirk and his companions are sent to die in a re-enactment of the gunfight at the O.K. Corral.

overview.zh: 一股外星力量驱使企业号的船员与克林贡人发生残酷的冲突。
overview.en: An alien force drives the crew of the Enterprise into brutal conflict with the Klingons.

name.en: For the World Is Hollow and I Have Touched the Sky

overview.zh: “企业号”的船员们急忙阻止一颗小行星与联邦世界相撞，但发现这颗小行星实际上是一艘有人居住的一代飞船。
overview.en: The crew of the Enterprise rush to stop an asteroid from colliding with a Federation world, but discover the asteroid is actually an inhabited generation ship.

overview.zh: 科克船长在企业号机组人员试图找回他时被困在两个维度之间。一直以来，索里亚人都要求企业离开他们的空间。
overview.en: Captain Kirk is caught between dimensions while the crew of the Enterprise works to retrieve him. All the while, the Tholians demand that the Enterprise leave their space.

overview.zh: 《企业号》的船员们遇到了一个不老的、施虐的类人种族，他们拥有心灵遥控的力量，并声称他们的社会是围绕古希腊的理想组织起来的。
overview.en: The crew of the Enterprise encounters an ageless and sadistic race of humanoids with the power of telekinesis and who claim to have organized their society around Ancient Greek ideals.

overview.zh: 无形的“时间加速”外星人接管了企业号，并试图绑架机组人员作为“基因库”。
overview.en: Invisible "time-accelerated" aliens take over the Enterprise and attempt to abduct the crew for use as "genetic stock".

overview.zh: 在访问一颗注定要毁灭的行星时，登陆队受到强大的外星人的折磨。
overview.en: While visiting a doomed planet, the landing party is subject to torturous experiments by powerful aliens.

overview.zh: 企业号载着一位被宠坏的公主，她与特洛伊王室的订婚有望给处于战争状态的恒星系统带来和平。
overview.en: The USS Enterprise ferries a spoiled princess whose betrothal to a royal Troyian is hoped will bring peace to a star system at war.

overview.zh: 柯克船长与一位决心控制宇宙的疯狂变形星际飞船船长对峙。
overview.en: Captain Kirk faces off with a demented shape-shifting starship captain determined to control the universe.

name.en: Let That Be Your Last Battlefield

overview.zh: 企业号遇到了两个互相矛盾、互相敌对的外星人，他们把船放在冲突双方的中间。
overview.en: The Enterprise encounters two duo-chromatic and mutually belligerent aliens who put the ship in the middle of their old conflict.

overview.zh: 一群人口过剩的外星人绑架了柯克船长来解决他们的问题。
overview.en: A race of overpopulated aliens abduct Captain Kirk to solve their problem.

overview.zh: 柯克、麦考伊和苏鲁被困在一个贫瘠的星球上，一个神秘的女人试图一次杀死一个，而企业号必须穿越一半的银河系去营救他们。
overview.en: Kirk, McCoy, and Sulu are stranded on a barren planet where a mysterious woman attempts to kill them one at a time, while the Enterprise must travel halfway across the galaxy to rescue them.

overview.zh: 奇怪的无形外星人威胁着地球记忆阿尔法站和企业号。
overview.en: Strange incorporeal aliens threaten the Memory Alpha station and the Enterprise.

overview.zh: 《企业号》的船员们在莎士比亚的科幻小说《暴风雨》中遇到了一位不朽的人类。
overview.en: The crew of the Enterprise encounter an immortal human in this science fiction variation on Shakespeare's The Tempest.

overview.zh: 企业号搭载了一群太空“嬉皮士”寻找伊甸园。
overview.en: The Enterprise picks up a group of space "hippies" looking for Eden.

overview.zh: 柯克船长与时间赛跑，从一个反对严重的社会阶级不平等的民间起义的世界中获取抗瘟疫矿物。
overview.en: Captain Kirk races against time to acquire plague-fighting minerals from a world in the midst of a civil uprising against a grievous social class disparity.

overview.zh: 外星人迫使柯克上尉和斯波克大副与“亚伯拉罕·林肯”和“苏拉克”联手，在一场善与恶的较量中与恶棍作战。
overview.en: Aliens force Captain Kirk and First Officer Spock to join forces with "Abraham Lincoln" and "Surak" to battle villains in a contest of good vs. evil.

overview.zh: 柯克、斯波克和麦考伊被困在另一颗行星过去的两部分——当太阳变成超新星时，这个世界将面临毁灭的威胁。
overview.en: Kirk, Spock and McCoy are trapped in two parts of another planet's past - a world threatened with destruction when its sun goes supernova.

overview.zh: 柯克的前情人之一珍妮丝·莱斯特（Janice Lester）偷走了他的尸体，企业号陷入了危险之中。
overview.en: The Enterprise is in danger when Janice Lester, one of Kirk's former lovers, steals his body.

overview.zh:
Star Trek动画版为唯一在中国大陆地区播出的Star Trek“剧集”，译名《星际迷航》。

　　从可考的资料看，TAS应该是八零年代至九零年代中期先后在各地方电视台每晚18:30播出，第二天中午12:00重播。《星际迷航》至今在大陆虽不是主流动画片之选，但早晨的冷门时段内偶尔还能看到播出，可谓“长播不衰”。其培养出的星旅迷数量可能远胜台湾。

　　《星际迷航：动画版》是一部发生在星际迷航时空的科幻动画电视剧集。当初它在美国播出的时候叫做Star Trek，不过它在西方普遍被称为Star Trek: The Animated Series（星际迷航：动画版，缩写为ST:TAS或TAS）这个较长的名字，以和最初的真人演出的《TOS》作为区别。有时候（例如在官网上）它也被叫做“动画历险”（The Animated Adventures）。

　　动画版由飞美逊（Filmation）公司制作，总共播出了两季，1973年和1974年，一共播出了22集，每集半小时。它找来了大部分《TOS》的演员来为他们当初所饰演的角色配音，唯一的例外是帕佛·契可夫（Pavel Chekov，由华特·科宁格（Walter Koenig）饰演），因为预算不足以负担全体演员的片酬，所以没请他参与配音工作。他的角色被其他两个配角所取代：艾瑞克斯（Arex）上尉，他属于一个有三只手与三只脚的种族；以及穆瑞丝（M'Ress）上尉，她是一个像猫的女性外星人。詹姆斯·督汉和玛婕尔·巴瑞特除了为他们所扮演的角色，蒙哥马利·史考特（Montgomery Scott）和克莉丝汀·查培尔（Christine Chapel）配音外，也分别为艾瑞克斯和穆瑞丝配音。

　　1975年该剧获艾美奖。
overview.en: The animated adventures of Captain Kirk, Mr. Spock and the crew of the Starship Enterprise.

overview.zh: 在围绕一颗死星的轨道上，“企业号”遇到了一艘巨大的飞船，飞船上居住着一种寄生生物，威胁着整艘飞船。
overview.en:
Stardate: 5521.3

In orbit around a dead star, the Enterprise comes across a huge starship inhabited by a parasitic life form that threatens the entire ship.

overview.zh: 斯波克在执行完扫描任务后返回，发现没有他在星际舰队服役的记录，他已经被安道尔的一名大副塞林取代。由于斯波克没有亲自去救自己，他改变了时间表。他的宠物赛拉特在老斯波克出现之前牺牲了自己的生命救了他。时间线恢复，一切恢复正常。
overview.en:
Stardate: 5373.4

Spock travels back in time to prevent his death as a young Vulcan.

name.en: One of Our Planets Is Missing

overview.zh: 企业号的全体船员竞相寻找阻止星云破坏有人居住的行星的方法。
overview.en:
Stardate: 5371.3

The crew of the Enterprise races to find a way to stop a cloud from destroying inhabited planets.

overview.zh: 在每27.346年就有船只消失一次的太空区域，男性船员收到遇险信号后会受到信号的影响。Uhura和Chapel在船上的男机组人员开始表现出欣喜若狂时被迫接管指挥权。女性的生理和生命能量需求与地球息息相关，企业号同意将她们带到一个正常的星球。使用传送机和原始模式，他们恢复柯克和其他人。
overview.en:
Stardate: 5483.7

Female crew members must take over the Enterprise when the men are incapacitated by a race of sirens.

name.zh: 第5集 更多毛怪更多麻烦

overview.zh: 企业号正在护送机器人航母前往谢尔曼星球，克林贡人袭击了一艘小型侦察船，企业号营救了一名船员：商人塞拉诺·琼斯。他是毛球族。
overview.en:
Stardate: 5392.4

Cyrano Jones introduces tribbles that cannot reproduce.

overview.zh: 在罗穆兰边境附近，企业号发现了一艘载有失踪慈善家卡特·温斯顿的单人船。他的未婚妻安妮也在船上，这对夫妇很高兴能重聚。但是“温斯顿”变成了一个外星人，击倒了柯克，并占据了他的位置足够长的时间，命令飞船进入中立区。
overview.en:
Stardate: 5143.3

The Enterprise finds a long-lost explorer.

overview.zh: 企业号调查了一个看似废弃的星球，发现它居住着一种叫做Phylosians的植物。然后，他们面对的是一个巨大的人形机器人，肯尼克利乌斯5号博士，他是优生学战争中的难民。他领导着Phylosian，他们抓获了斯波克。
overview.en:
Stardate: 5554.4

A race of plant people, and their master, have a plan to force peace onto the galaxy.

overview.zh: 在银河系中心执行任务时，“企业号”被席卷了所有事物的中心，最终进入了一个所有自然法则和物理法则都无法发挥作用的外星世界。他们被一种名为卢西恩的类似卫星的生物从系统崩溃和死亡中拯救出来。
overview.en:
Stardate: 1254.4

At the center of the galaxy, the Enterprise discovers a race of powerful aliens.

overview.zh: 柯克回到了“海岸之旅”星球，但它不像他们上次看到它时那样平静。
overview.en:
Stardate: 5591.2

Kirk returns to the "shore leave" planet, but it's not as peaceful as it was when they last saw it.

overview.zh: 企业号被派去检查一个骗子，他是他们的老朋友哈里·穆德。他正试图向矿工们出售一种假的爱情药剂。
overview.en:
Stardate: 4978.5

Space con artist Harry Mudd returns, selling a fake love potion.

overview.zh: 在探索一颗烧毁的超新星时，“企业号”追踪到一个奇怪的信号，上面有一个无法识别的单词“terratin”。他们追踪到围绕超新星运行的一颗行星，并被来自火山行星的一束光击中。船员和所有有机物开始收缩。
overview.en:
Stardate: 5577.3

The Enterprise crew begins to shrink after radiation exposure.

overview.zh: 企业号正在调查一个“百慕大空间三角”，三艘克林贡战舰的追击迫使他们进入该地区。
overview.en:
Stardate: 5267.6

The Enterprise crew must work with Klingons to escape from a pocket universe.

overview.zh: 在探索阿尔戈星球时，柯克和斯波克变成了用水呼吸。
overview.en:
Stardate: 5499.9

While exploring the planet Argo, Kirk and Spock are turned into water breathers.

overview.zh: 当斯波克、乌胡拉和苏鲁把一个古代奴隶停滞箱带到一个恒星基地时，他们发现附近还有另一个奴隶停滞箱。经过调查，他们被克津蒂族俘虏。克津蒂族是一种猫一样的种族，在几次战争中输给人类后，他们憎恨人类。
overview.en:
Stardate: 4187.3

Spock, Sulu, and Uhura discover a time capsule from an ancient and technologically advanced race. However, it draws some unwanted attention.

overview.zh: 企业号的船员去寻找失踪的科学船艾瑞尔。他们追踪到一颗M级行星。科克、斯波克和麦考伊穿过一系列奇怪的生态区域后，被奇怪的蛞蝓状生物捕获。他们被带到一家高科技动物园，在那里他们遇到了阿里尔号的其余三名幸存者。
overview.en:
Stardate: 5501.2

Telepathic aliens put Kirk, Spock and McCoy in a zoo.

overview.zh: 柯克带领一支队伍去找回被盗的宗教遗迹；然而，他面临着来自该组织内部的破坏，这些破坏是由一个不想被发现的人发起的，这将引发一场星际圣战。
overview.en:
Stardate: 5683.1

Kirk and Spock are recruited for a heist to recover a stolen relic, which if not recovered could spark an galactic jihad.

overview.zh: 当斯波克被一种对瓦肯人来说是致命的疾病击倒时，企业号将与一艘载有唯一治疗方法的药物的货船会面，但猎户海盗袭击了这艘船，柯克必须在为时已晚之前追踪猎户海盗和药物。
overview.en:
Stardate: 6334.1

With Spock stricken down by a fatal disease, the Enterprise must track down the drug that can cure him before it is too late.

overview.zh: “企业号”目前的探测/联络任务中有一位观察员：潘德罗星球的指挥官阿里·本姆（Ari bn Bem）。他粗鲁、令人讨厌、危险地独立，但柯克奉命善待他，以进一步发展与潘德罗的关系。
overview.en:
Stardate: 7403.6

The Enterprise crew is joined by a unpredictable alien called Ari bn Bem, an independent observer from the planet Pandro.

overview.zh: 企业号在太空中探索神秘的星云。经过它之后，船上的计算机开始以一种奇怪的方式运行。它复制了柯克的衬衫，背面印有“柯克是个混蛋”，生产在斯波克身上留下黑眼圈的设备，并从食品设备中取出奶油派。
overview.en:
Stardate: 3183.3

The computer of the Enterprise gains partial sentience and starts playing practical jokes on the crew.

overview.zh: 麦考伊博士被逮捕，并对19年前在德拉米娅二号行星实施大规模无罪释放的瘟疫负责。
overview.en:
Stardate: 5275.6

Dr. McCoy is arrested and held responsible for causing a plague that ravaged the planet Dramia II, where he performed a mass-innoculation 19 years earlier.

name.en: How Sharper Than a Serpent's Tooth

overview.zh: 企业号正在追踪一个探测器的运行轨迹，该探测器扫描地球，并沿其运行轨迹发回信号。它们受到一条蛇形能量场的攻击，该能量场属于一条羽毛蛇，该蛇自称是玛雅阿兹特克传说中的库尔库卡人。
overview.en:
Stardate: 6063.4

The Enterprise runs into a being that once visited Earth and influenced the Mayan culture.

overview.zh: 随着海军准将罗伯特·阿普里尔（企业号首任指挥官）的登船，柯克追赶一艘坠入超新星的飞船，进入了一个时间倒流的宇宙。
overview.en:
Stardate: 6770.3

With Commodore Robert April (the first commander of the Enterprise) on board, Kirk pursues a ship plunging into a supernova, and enters a universe where time runs backwards.

overview.zh:
《星际迷航：下一代》（原名：Star Trek: The Next Generation，简称为 ST:TNG 或 TNG）是一出背景设定在《星际迷航》时空的科幻电视系列剧，它也是 1966 年至 1969 年间的《星际迷航：原初》电视剧之后第一个真人演出的电视续篇。《下一代》的时间设定在《原初》约一个世纪之后，描述的是一艘新的星舰和新的航员组的故事。

电视剧的构想来自《星际迷航》的原创人吉恩·罗登伯里，他也担任了制作人的工作。它于 1987 年 9 月 28 日首播第一集，两小时长的试播章节“远角遭遇战”，之后持续播映七季。最后一集是于 1994 年 5 月 29 日播出的“一切美好”。电视剧在播映期间吸引了许多追随者，而且跟它的前作一样，在世界各地多次重播。
overview.en: Follow the intergalactic adventures of Capt. Jean-Luc Picard and his loyal crew aboard the all-new USS Enterprise NCC-1701D, as they explore new worlds.

overview.zh: 在《星际迷航》原初系列的几十年后，新一季开始了。让-卢克·皮卡德船长和他忠诚的船员们在全新的企业号 NCC-1701D 上开始了星际冒险，探索了新的世界。
overview.en: Picking up decades after the original Star Trek series, season one begins the intergalactic adventures of Capt. Jean-Luc Picard and his loyal crew aboard the all-new USS Enterprise NCC-1701D, as they explore new worlds.

name.zh: 远角遭遇战：第 1 和第 2 部分

overview.zh: 在全新星舰企业号的处女航中，船员们探索着关于天津四行星上“远点站”创建的秘密。
overview.en: Stardate: 41153.7. The new commander of the recently built U.S.S. Enterprise (NCC1701-D), Captain Jean-Luc Picard  takes the crew on their first mission to discover the secret of Farpoint Station. During their journey, they encounter an omnipotent being known as Q. Q accuses humanity of barbarism, and places humanity on trial. Jean-Luc must prove otherwise or the human race will be annihilated.

overview.zh: 企业号船员感染了一种病毒，因此表现得好像喝醉了一般。
overview.en: Stardate: 41209.2. The crew of the Enterprise are infected with a virus contracted by the away team while they were investigating  the mysterious deaths of the entire crew of the Starship Tsilkovsky.

overview.zh: 一个外星文明的领导者对叶上尉产生好感，并宣布她是自己的女人，这令他的妻子倍感沮丧。
overview.en: Stardate: 41235.25. Tasha Yar must fight for her life and a vaccine to save a race of people when she is kidnapped and forced to battle with her abductor's wife.

overview.zh: 在追一个人称“佛瑞吉”的神秘种族时，企业号突然断电。
overview.en: Stardate: 41386.4. A powerful entity disables the Enterprise and a Ferengi ship. Their only means of escape is if they can correctly answer the riddles he asks.

name.en: Where No One Has Gone Before

overview.zh: 企业号奉命接受一系列测试，测试能使飞船航速达到无法估量的超高速。
overview.en: Stardate: 41263.1. The Enterprise is flung across space into a distant galaxy billions of light years away when a propulsion engineer and his mysterious companion, attempt to re-design the ship's engine systems.

overview.zh: 企业号护送两个不停闹矛盾的种族代表。
overview.en: Stardate: 41249.3. Picard's mind is taken over by an energy field that the Enterprise passes through.

overview.zh: 在把殖民者送到附近星系后，船员们来到一个新世界。这里的外星人相貌近似人类，他们漂亮、健康，还拥有古铜肤色。
overview.en: Stardate: 41255.6. Picard is forced to choose between friendship and the Prime Directive when Wesley Crusher is sentenced to death for accidentally breaking the law on Rubicon III.

overview.zh: 在连续三天等待会面请求的回应后，皮卡德舰长得知佛瑞吉人发现了他过去的飞船观星号。
overview.en: Stardate: 41723.9. The Ferengi hand over an old ship which Picard once captained, the U.S.S. Stargazer. The Ferengi have installed a mind altering device that alters Picard's mind to make him think that he is reliving a past battle, and the target is the Enterprise.

overview.zh: Q 打断了一项紧迫的企业号任务，并以赋予瑞克非凡的能力对其进行诱惑。
overview.en: Stardate: 41590.5. Q places the senior crew of the Enterprise in a war game that pits them against a boar-faced, Napoleonic enemy.

overview.zh: 在名为“避风港”的星球执行任务时，星异见到了她的未婚夫 — 多年前父亲曾给她定下包办婚姻。
overview.en: Stardate: 41294.5. The mother of Deanna Troi, Lwaxana,  pays a surprise visit to the Enterprise and announces the prearranged marriage of Deanna to the son of her mother's late husband's best friend.

overview.zh: 一个外星种族对飞船进行整体扫描，皮卡德舰长和一些船员在全息甲板上落入了致命的圈套。
overview.en: Stardate: 41997.7. Picard, Dr. Crusher and Data are placed in great danger when the holodeck malfunctions while they are running a Dixon Hill program, which pits them against 1940's mobsters.

overview.zh: 企业号到访 Data 诞生的行星，并发现另一个像他这样的机器人。但这两“兄弟”大有不同。
overview.en: Stardate: 41242.4.  While exploring his homeworld, the crew of the Enterprise find android parts that are identical to Data's. When assembled, an 'evil' twin of Data named Lore is revived.

overview.zh: 为了寻找失踪的星联运输船船员，瑞克、星异、Data和塔莎·叶传送到一个女性掌权的星球。
overview.en: Stardate: 41636.9. The Enterprise discovers the male crew of a crashed Federation freighter are hiding as fugitives on the planet Angel One, which is dominated and ruled by women.

overview.zh: 企业号停靠在星际空间站等待维修，一种大脑互联的高科技外星人强占了飞船。
overview.en: Stardate: 41365.9. While undergoing repairs, the Bynar Engineers steal the Enterprise to save their planet from destruction.

overview.zh: 企业号护送星际舰队的一位老将军去进行人质谈判。
overview.en: Stardate: 41309.5. The aging and terminally ill Starfleet Admiral Mark Jameson, who is negotiating the release of hostages, suddenly begins growing younger through an unexplained phenomenon.

overview.zh: 一个隐身数千年的行星突然重新出现，并向企业号发出了一个不寻常的请求。
overview.en: Stardate: 41509.1. The children of the Enterprise, including Wesley Crusher, are abducted by a race of sterile people who are unable to have children of their own.

overview.zh: 船员来到薇莱拉三号星球，这里有一群水晶体智慧生物，他们正将看似不毛之地的星球变成可供生命生存的地方。
overview.en: Stardate: 41463.9. The members of an away team investigating the death of an engineer encounter vengeful microscopic life forms.

overview.zh: 卫斯理·克拉夏参加星舰学院入学考试，皮卡德舰长和企业号受到星际舰队的调查。
overview.en: Stardate: 41416.2. While Wesley takes the entrance exam to Starfleet Academy, the Enterprise is investigated by the Inspector General's office and Picard's competency is questioned.

overview.zh: 两个克林贡逃犯控制了企业号飞船，武夫必须在忠于星际舰队和遵循克林贡传统之间做出选择。
overview.en: Stardate: 41503.7. Two Klingons, rescued by the Enterprise, try to take over the ship.

overview.zh: 在调查联邦星舰德瑞克号在米诺斯星球失踪一事时，船员们与漂浮的类死星机械舰艇展开大战。
overview.en: Stardate: 41798.2. The crew encounters bizarre phenomena while searching for the missing U.S.S. Drake.

overview.zh: 企业号碰到两拨外星人，一拨人患有瘟疫，另一拨人兜售治疗药物。船员们发现任何事都没有看上去那么简单。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Picard attempts to break an ancient co-dependency between two species on one planet without violating the Prime Directive.

overview.zh: 企业号前去和星异的穿梭机会合，途中怪异的故障让传送器坠毁在维格拉二号星球。
overview.en: Stardate: 41601.3. When Troi's shuttle crashes on an alien planet, a new being is discovered: an entity that thrives on the suffering of others.

overview.zh: 当船员们帮助一位声称打开了通向另一维度之窗的患病科学家时，企业号经历了奇异的时间扭曲。
overview.en: Stardate: 41697.9. Picard meets an old flame, whose husband has created a haywire dimensional experiment.

overview.zh: 皮卡德舰长和一位老友还有几位最优秀的星舰指挥官召开了秘密会议，皮卡德得知联邦星舰何瑞修号已被摧毁。
overview.en: Stardate: 41775.5. The strange behavior of high-ranking officers leads Picard to uncover a twisted alien conspiracy within Starfleet.

overview.zh: 在等待皮卡德舰长从星际联邦会议返回时，企业号船员发现了一颗废弃的 20 世纪地球人造卫星。
overview.en: Stardate: 41986.0. A derelict satellite is found with cryonically frozen humans aboard as the USS Enterprise is sent to investigate the destruction of outposts near Romulan space.

overview.zh: 在第二季中，进取号继续穿越银河系的旅程，并出现了一位新成员。皮卡德再次带领团队，因为未知的文明注意到这艘船，并希望了解更多关于船员和他们的操作。瑞克的生命受到威胁，他与自己对进取号的忠诚作斗争，数据试图变得更人性化，以理解他在进取号上的角色。这一季更深入地探讨了人类与机器的关系，Q 再次试图考验皮卡德对抗一个新的敌人。费伦吉威胁着进取号，全息甲板的神秘使船员们争分夺秒，生命危在旦夕。
overview.en: In season two, the Enterprise continues on its journey across the galaxy with the birth of a new member. Picard once again leads the team as unknown civilizations take notice of the ship and wishes to know more about the crew and their operations. Riker struggles with his loyalty to the Enterprise as his life is threatened and Data tries to become more human to understand his role upon the Enterprise. This season looks closer into the relationship of man vs. machine as Q once again tries to test Picard against a new enemy. The Ferengi threatens the Enterprise and the mystery of the holodeck pits the crew against the clock as lives hang in the balance.

overview.zh: 不明外星生物致使星异受孕。凯萨琳·普兰斯基医生加入企业号成为飞船的新医疗长。
overview.en: Stardate: 42073.1. Troi undergoes a mysterious pregnancy when the Enterprise tries to escape from a system that has recently fallen victim to a deadly plague.

overview.zh: 企业号行至神秘的太空死寂地带，他们希望靠近以便进一步调查，但却被困在这里无法逃离。
overview.en: Stardate: 42193.6. A mysterious life form known as the 'Nagilum' threatens the life of the crew in his attempt to understand humanity.

overview.zh: 船员们难得拥有闲暇时光，拉佛吉用全息甲板编出福尔摩斯解谜游戏，让Data来解谜。
overview.en: Stardate: 42286.3. Data and Geordi become involved with a holodeck program about Sherlock Holmes and his investigations, when they create Sherlock's arch nemesis, Moriarty; however, modifications to the Moriarty character include the capability of out-smarting Data, which leads to some unexpected consequences.

overview.zh: 一艘运输船出了故障，企业号救出其船长，但却被卷入一场世仇纠纷中。
overview.en: Stardate: 42402.7. The Enterprise is placed in a compromising situation when the captain of a disabled starship places the crew in the middle of a love triangle.

overview.zh: 船员们带着一个没有听觉但具有心灵感应能力的调解人来到索雷斯五号星球进行终止内战的谈判。
overview.en: Stardate: 42477.2. A deaf-mute mediator meets with disaster while being escorted by the Enterprise.

overview.zh: 企业号回应了艾拉·葛雷夫博士的医疗援助请求 — 他被认为是宇宙中在世最伟大的人。
overview.en: Stardate: 42437.5. Data is possessed by the consciousness of a brilliant scientist. However, it has a disturbing impact on Data's personality.

overview.zh: 企业号收到联邦星舰兰特号的求救信号。当他们赶到后，却发现所有的船员都已死于衰老。
overview.en: Stardate: 42494.8. A mysterious hyper-ageing sickness kills the crew of a Federation cargo ship, and Dr. Pulaski must race against time to find a cure.

overview.zh: 星际联邦推行军官交流项目，瑞克决定服从安排前往克林贡战舰。
overview.en: Commander Riker participates in an officer's exchange program which lands him an assignment on a Klingon Bird-of-Prey.  Meanwhile, a Bezite ensign has trouble assimilating to the routines of the Enterprise.

overview.zh: Data不愿被技艺不精的科学家拆解用于研究，他决定辞职。
overview.en: Stardate: 42523.7. When Data's rights as a sentient individual are placed under trial, Starfleet forces Riker into a position where he must prove that Data is only an Android.

overview.zh: 企业号受命将年轻女子沙利亚送回母星，这让威斯利·库修饱受痛失初恋之苦。
overview.en: Stardate: 42568.8. Wesley falls in love with a passenger the Enterprise is escorting, who has the secret ability to shape-shift.

overview.zh: 皮卡德舰长和船员回应一个来自 “企业号” 姊妹飞船 “联邦大和号” 的求救呼叫。
overview.en: Stardate: 42609.1. A strange power source disables the Enterprise's computer systems, damages Data's programming and leaves the ship and crew vulnerable to a Romulan attack.

overview.zh: 企业号调查附近星球轨道上的奇怪碎片，他们找到了印有美国国旗的 NASA 飞船残片。
overview.en: Stardate: 42625.4. An away team is trapped in an alien environment based around a novel entitled 'The Hotel Royale.'

overview.zh: 企业号遇到了在太空中漂浮的星际联邦穿梭机，穿梭机失去了动力，但里面仍有生命迹象。
overview.en: Stardate: 42679.2. Picard encounters his double from six hours in the future, whose Enterprise had been destroyed.

overview.zh: 瑞克被任命为联邦星舰战神号的指挥官，他欣喜不已。但当他得知前来帮他准备就职的是他疏远已久的父亲时，喜悦转为了沮丧。
overview.en: Stardate: 42686.4. Riker is promoted to Captain of another Federation ship. Worf must confront his past and his Klingon heritage.

overview.zh: 在行至一处新发现的星团时，船员们发现整片区域并不稳定。
overview.en: Stardate: 42695.3. Wesley must investigate the causes of strange tectonic activity on the planet where Data's pen pal lives.

overview.zh: 为了向皮卡德舰长证明企业号需要自己，Q将企业号带到了 7000 光年外的地方，他们在那里首次遭遇了博格人。
overview.en: Stardate: 42761.3. Q hurls the Enterprise into the Delta Quadrant and introduces the Federation to a powerful new enemy that may destroy the Alpha Quadrant: The Borg.

overview.zh: 皮卡德舰长离舰去做常规手术时，企业号回应了派克勒飞船的求救信号。
overview.en: Stardate: 42779.1. A race known as the Pakleds kidnap Geordi La Forge. Picard must face surgery when he is left in a near-dead state.

overview.zh: 星际舰队接收到地球很早以前发出的求救信号，企业号被派去调查。
overview.en: Stardate: 42823.2. Picard must convince two dying civilizations that they must co-exist on the same planet to survive, however, they have other plans to ensure their survival: in the form of clones of the Enterprise crew.

overview.zh: 当一贯言行离谱的母亲罗珊娜登上 “企业号” 时，特洛伊感到尴尬不已。
overview.en: Stardate: 42859.2. While being escorted to a Federation conference by the Enterprise, Lwaxana hunts for a man to satisfy her needs when her sex-drive is quadrupled during a natural mid-life cycle.

overview.zh: 一名特使从 153 号星际基地出发，企业号接到命令前去与其紧急会合。
overview.en: Stardate: 42901.3. Worf is re-united with his former lover, K'Ehleyr, while the Enterprise is ordered to intercept a Klingon ship whose crew has been in stasis for a century.

overview.zh: 船员们举行了战斗演习，皮卡德舰长对战瑞克。然而佛瑞吉人的出现仍让他们猝不及防。
overview.en: Stardate: 42923.4. Trouble begins when a Ferengi warship stumbles over a war simulation between Riker and Picard, each on different ships, and begins attacking them.

overview.zh: 瑞克执行外勤受伤并感染了所到星球的微生物病菌，他回到船上的医务室后很快陷入昏迷。
overview.en: Stardate: 42976.1. Riker is infected with an alien organism that takes over his mind. Dr. Pulaski must force Riker's mind back to a state where it can access primitive survival skills.

overview.zh: 随着一个联邦殖民地的消失，进取号以曲速行动，去查明是政治原因还是其他更险恶的原因。在他们的旅行中，船员必须护送一名科学家，他可能掌握故障的关键，使船员处于危险之中。当皮卡德被认为是一个原始世界的神时，主要指令被打破了。罗慕伦人继续注意到联邦入侵中立区，并威胁要对进取号发动战争。事情变得更加复杂，因为一个老敌人来了，皮卡德必须决定应该是安抚，还是选择保持敌对以作为预防措施。所有的一切都指向最终回答星际舰队和联邦的动机，企业号继续其探索银河系的使命。
overview.en: With the disappearance of a Federation colony, the Enterprise warp speeds to action to uncover if the reason was political or something much more sinister. Along their travels, the crew must escort a scientist who may hold the key to a malfunction that places the crew in danger. Prime Directives are broken as Picard is taken for a god on a primitive world. The Romulans continue to notice Federation intrusion into the Neutral Zone and threatens war against the Enterprise. Things become much more complex as an old enemy stops by and Picard must decide if he should offer solace or choose to remain enemies as a precaution. All leading up to finally answering the motives of Starfleet and the Federation as the Enterprise continues on its mission to explore the galaxy.

overview.zh: 企业号载着著名科学家保罗·史达布博士来到双星，他们预计在那里会发生剧烈的星球爆炸。
overview.en: Stardate: 43125.8. A system-wide computer malfunction places the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise in grave danger while they are escorting a scientist to a star in the process of exploding.

overview.zh: 静默了一个世纪后，企业号收到一条来自夏利艾克星系的消息，称他们发现了一块人类殖民地。
overview.en: Stardate: 43133.3. A human colony is forced to evacuate a planet when the original inhabitants return and threaten the colonists with annihilation if they do not leave within four days.

overview.zh: 企业号回应了星际联邦殖民地拉纳四号星球的求救信号 — 他们正在遭受一艘不明飞船的攻击。
overview.en: Stardate: 43152.4. The Enterprise discovers a planet that has had all life eradicated, except for two mysterious residents and their home, which has been left in perfect condition.

overview.zh: 一种原始的瓦肯文化将皮卡德舰长视作神灵。为了纪念毕凯，他们准备举行献祭仪式。
overview.en: Stardate: 43173.5. An away team inadvertently breaks the Prime Directive and reveal themselves to a primitive culture on Mintaka III, causing the inhabitants believe that Captain Picard is a God.

overview.zh: 一位女船员在执行任务时丧命，留下一个儿子。一个让人惊异的事情等待着企业号的船员们。
overview.en: Worf and Wesley must help a 12 year old boy cope with the death of his mother; an archaeologist killed during an away mission to a deserted planet.

overview.zh: 企业号收到被摧毁的欧瑞里斯九号星球发来的一个古老的无线电信码。这颗星球 1000 年前曾经历全面战争，已成废墟一片。
overview.en: Stardate: 43205.6. While investigating an ancient ship left adrift in space, the Enterprise accidentally trips the ancient booby trap that disabled the old vessel over 1000 years ago.

overview.zh: 队友们遇到一位罗穆兰战士，而拉佛吉却被落在一颗遭受风暴席卷的星球上。
overview.en: Stardate:43349.2. A blind Geordie is trapped on a hazardous planet with a paranoid and severely injured Romulan. In orbit, a Romulan Warbird is preventing the Enterprise from attempting a rescue mission.

overview.zh: 在企业号主持谈判稳定虫洞的控制权归属问题时，星异爱上了对方的谈判代表。
overview.en: Stardate: 43385.6. The Enterprise hosts the negotiations for the rights to a newly discovered, stable wormhole to the Delta Quadrant. One of the negotiators, Devinoni Ral, becomes attracted to Deanna Troi, but he holds a dubious secret.

overview.zh: 一种以采集为生的种族不断袭扰星际联邦前哨站，企业号船员前去追捕，但他们没有意识到危险正在靠近。
overview.en: Stardate: 43421.9. The Enterprise crew tries to mend the relationship between a race known as the Acamarians and a faction known as the Gatherers.

overview.zh: 一名罗慕伦军官叛逃到星际联邦，并警告他们入侵即将到来。但皮卡德舰长很难决定他是否可信。
overview.en: Stardate: 43462.5. A defecting Romulan warns the Federation about an impending attack by the Romulans, who are secretly establishing bases within the Neutral Zone.

overview.zh: 一颗星球申请加入星际联邦，企业号船员在进行调查时发现了一群曾经当过士兵的居民。
overview.en: Stardate: 43489.2. A potentially new member of the Federation enlists the help of the Enterprise to track down a wanted criminal who has a reputation for his excessive violence. However, the fugitive's actions may not be of his own will.

overview.zh: 在访问一颗处于内战中的星球时，库修医生被该星球政府的反对派劫为人质。
overview.en: Stardate: 43510.7. Dr. Crusher is abducted by a group of terrorists while delivering crucial medical supplies to a planet ravaged by civil war.

overview.zh: Q出现在企业号上。他声称自己被Q连续体排出，并被剥夺了能力，这让皮卡德舰长颇为不快。
overview.en: Stardate: 43539.1. A Calamarian starts attacking the Enterprise while seeking revenge on a powerless Q.

overview.zh: 奈尔·阿普嘉博士是一位备受敬重的科学家，他的遗孀指控瑞克勾引她并杀死了她的丈夫。
overview.en: Stardate: 43610.4. Riker is accused of murder when a scientist is killed in an explosion. Picard must recreate the recent events in the holodeck to prove his commander's innocence.

overview.zh: 失踪已久的企业号 C 进入企业号 D 的时空连续体，时空错位导致历史变更，船员们和克林贡人陷入战争。
overview.en: Stardate: 43625.2. A rift in the space/time continuum brings the U.S.S. Enterprise - C forward into the 24th Century, and alters the timeline. In this future, the Federation is at war with the Klingons, Tasha Yar is on the bridge, Worf did not join the Federation, and only Guinan's unique perception of reality may restore the timeline.

overview.zh: 为了继承发扬创造者的工作，延续自己的种族，Data制造了一个叫洛儿的机器人。
overview.en: Stardate: 43657.0. Data becomes a father when he creates a Soong-type android in the form of a daughter named Lal. Issues are complicated when Lal starts showing signs of a more evolved consciousness, including the ability to feel emotions, which attracts the attention of Starfleet scientists who want to take her away from Data and examine her advanced systems.

overview.zh: 星际舰队发起军官交流计划，一名克林贡指挥官来到企业号上，让船员们很是苦恼。
overview.en: Stardate: 43685.2. Worf is reunited with his long-lost brother when their father is charged with treason for helping the Romulans. Together they make an appeal to the Klingon High Council to challenge the charges, and have them revoked.

overview.zh: 皮卡德舰长被三个不同的外星人绑架并囚禁。一个冒名顶替者取代他登上 “企业号”。
overview.en: Stardate: 43714.1. Picard is secretly abducted and switched with an alien double. The crews' suspicions are raised when he starts exhibiting unusual behaviour, and is relieved of command.

overview.zh: 谈判完成后，大家建议皮卡德舰长放假好好休息一下 — 但他的休假却不停地被打断。
overview.en: Stardate: 43745.2. While on vacation on Risa, Captain Picard encounters two Vorgons from the 27th Century who claim they are searching for a powerful weapon hidden somewhere on the planet.

overview.zh: 星异以前的一位病人前来帮助企业号赶在罗穆兰人之前与一艘不同寻常的外星飞船建立联系。
overview.en: Stardate: 43779.3. The Enterprise encounters a 'living' ship in the Neutral Zone, and risks breaking the Romulan Federation alliance in order to bring it into contact with a Betazoid emissary.

overview.zh: 企业号一位腼腆的船员开始沉迷于全息甲板，因为在这里谈恋爱比在现实生活中更容易。
overview.en: Stardate: 43807.4. A nervous and insecure officer, Lt. Reginald Barclay, places the Enterprise in great danger when he neglects his duties in Engineering, and instead spends his time acting out his fantasies on the holodeck.

overview.zh: 当船员把一种危险的材料运送到 “企业号” 后，一名收藏家展开精心布置的计划以绑架Data。
overview.en: Stardate: 43872.2. The crew are shattered by the apparent death of Data in a shuttle explosion, and are prevented from carrying out a detailed investigation when Starfleet gives them orders for a new mission elsewhere. However, the crew don't realize that he was actually abducted and placed on display as part of a collection of rare and valuable items held by a disreputable character.

overview.zh: 星际联邦传奇大使沙瑞克来到企业号上和雷加拉人完成和平会谈。
overview.en: Stardate: 43917.4. Spock's Vulcan father, Sarek, boards the Enterprise to negotiate political relations with the Legaran. However, Sarek has contract Bendii syndrome, which causes a Vulcan to gradually lose control, and become overpowered with emotions.

overview.zh: 星异的母亲对佛瑞吉人戴蒙对星异爱情攻势嗤之以鼻，戴蒙于是绑架了母女二人。
overview.en: Stardate: 43930.7. Riker and Deanna, both on shoreleave, are unexpectedly joined by Deanna's mother, Lwaxana, on Betazed. Shortly, all three are kidnapped by the Ferengi who want to study Lwaxana's telepathic abilities.

overview.zh: 企业号来到一颗荒凉的星球，并在那里找到一个被击落的飞船上唯一的幸存者。他失去了记忆，但却有不可思议的治愈能力。
overview.en: Stardate: 43957.2. Dr. Crusher becomes attracted to an injured alien with mysterious powers, who is being tracked down by his government like a wanted criminal.

overview.zh: 离星际联邦最远的殖民地之一发来求救呼叫，“企业号” 回应呼叫，抵达殖民地。但他们必须面对一个强大的敌人。
overview.en: Stardate: 43989.1  An Starfleet expert on the Borg, Lt. Cmdr. Shelby, is assigned to the Enterprise to investigate the disappearance of a Federation colony. Picard is abducted by the Borg and assimilated into the Collective, which forces Riker to attempt a rescue mission.

overview.zh: 瑞克试图从一个强大的外星种族手中拯救进取号和地球，皮卡德上尉的生命危在旦夕。船员面对自己的恶魔，必须克服自己的障碍，继续他们的任务。这导致Data回到他的创造者身边，以便更好地理解情感。Worf必须接受他的克林贡血统，面对他以前的家庭。一场权力斗争威胁着联邦，罗慕伦人试图与他们的宇宙和平相处，克林贡人正在处理他们帝国的潜在继承者。一艘流氓飞船袭击了联邦的前敌人，进取号内部的政治关系变得紧张，最终导致了一场内战，进取号的一名成员必须决定他的忠诚到底在哪里。
overview.en: As Riker tries to save the Enterprise and the Earth from a powerful alien race, Captain Picard's life hangs in the balance. The crew faces their own demons and must overcome their own obstacles to continue their mission. This leads Data to return to his creator to better understand emotions. Worf must accept his Klingon heritage and face his former family. A power struggle threatens the Federation as the Romulans try to make peace with their universe and the Klingons deal with a potential successor to their empire. Political relations are strained within the Enterprise as a rogue ship attacks former enemies of the Federation, ultimately leading up to a civil war where one member of the Enterprise must decide where his loyalty lies.

overview.zh: 尽管皮卡德舰长在博格飞船上，但代理舰长瑞克指挥官别无选择，只能向博格飞船全力开火。
overview.en: Stardate: 44001.4. Riker must pull out all the stops in order to save Earth from a Borg invasion being lead by none other than Locutus - otherwise known as Captain Jean-Luc Picard.

overview.zh: 企业号船员回到地球度上岸假期。仍在从被博格人逮捕的打击中恢复的皮卡德和自己的兄弟见了面。
overview.en: Stardate 44012.3. Picard meets with his older brother in France, and contemplates resigning his Starfleet commission after his ordeal with the Borg. Worf's adoptive parents spend time with their son on the Enterprise, and succeed in embarrassing him in front of his crewmates.

overview.zh: 企业号上的一次事故将其中一个孩子置于危险之中。Data 控制飞船，并标示了一条驶向不明目的地的航线。
overview.en: Stardate: 44085.7  While escorting a seriously ill boy to the closest Federation Starbase for treatment, Data mysteriously takes control of the Enterprise and takes it to a distant planet. He learns that his creator has summoned him for an important meeting that could change his life. However, Dr. Soong unknowingly summoned Data's twin brother Lore, into the bargain.

overview.zh: 在执行泰拉利海难救援任务时，企业号团队发现其中一个外星船员是个年轻的人类。
overview.en: Stardate: 44143.7. A custody battle between Picard and a child's adoptive father arises when a boy showing evidence of abuse is discovered.

overview.zh: 被困平行世界后，失去爱人和朋友让库修医生的焦虑症状愈发严重。
overview.en: Stardate: 44161.2. Dr. Crusher begins to question her sanity when members of the crew start disappearing one by one, and all evidence of their existence is erased.

overview.zh: 企业号船员驶入前船员同事塔莎·叶的母星的轨道，在那里遇到了塔莎的妹妹。
overview.en: Stardate: 44215.2. The Enterprise is caught in the middle of a civil war when they encounter Tasha Yar's long-lost younger sister, Ishara.

overview.zh: 克林贡高级议会会长去世，会长职位的空缺引发明争暗斗。皮卡德舰长发现自己被卷入了斗争之中。
overview.en: Stardate: 44246.3. Picard is asked to choose between two candidates to succeed the current Chancellor of the Klingon High Council as the new ruler of the Empire. Worf is disturbed by unexpected news when he is paid a visit by his former lover.

overview.zh: 一颗被认为无人居住的星球上发现了罗穆兰秘密基地，瑞克不得不提前离开自己的生日派对，带领外勤队前去调查。
overview.en: Stardate: 44286.5. Riker awakens one morning to discover he is suddenly 16 years in the future as the captain of the Enterprise, and negotiating a peace treaty with the Romulans with no recollection of how he arrived at that point in time, or of any recent events.

overview.zh: 在离开星舰学院之前，威斯利·库修陪同皮卡德舰长参与协调采矿纠纷。
overview.en: Stardate: 44307.3. Wesley must keep Captain Picard alive on the eve of his entrance exam to Starfleet Academy when their shuttle crashes on a barren moon.

overview.zh: 在企业号与神秘生命体进行对抗时，星异莫名失去了移情能力。
overview.en: Stardate: 44356.9. Troi loses her empathic abilities when the Enterprise is caught in the gravitational pull of a black hole.

overview.zh: 欧布莱恩和惠子即将步入婚姻，Data试着理解他们二人之间的复杂感情。
overview.en: Stardate: 44356.9. A Vulcan Ambassador being escorted by the Enterprise starts exhibiting suspicious behavior. Miles O'Brien marries his fiancée, Keiko Ishikawa in Ten-Forward.

overview.zh: 卡达西指挥官声称星际联邦攻击了他们的一个前哨站，毕凯舰长争分夺秒寻找事实真相。
overview.en: Stardate: 44429.6. When the Cardassians start re-arming themselves, a Federation Captain takes it upon himself to remove a potential threat before it escalated. Now, Picard must fight for the Cardassians and stop the renegade from slaughtering innocents.

overview.zh: 在回应求救信号时，皮卡德舰长遇到一个人，他自称是这颗星球上的恶魔。
overview.en: Stardate: 44474.5. The crew of the Enterprise must defend the planet Ventax from a mythological Devil who re-appears when a 1000 year long era of peace comes to an end.

overview.zh: 穿过虫洞后，船员们发现一些线索说明他们至少昏迷了 30 秒钟。
overview.en: Stardate: 44502.7. Picard orders a secret investigation when the crew suspects Data of lying about the discovery of a wormhole.

overview.zh: 一个做过整容手术的赖克人化名执行文化适应任务，然而一次严重受伤让他面临暴露身份的危险。
overview.en: Riker is abducted by a xenophobic race of aliens during a first contact mission. They believe the Enterprise is a scout for an invasion.

overview.zh: 企业号停在星际基地时，一个特殊的客人 — 才华横溢的工程设计师莉雅·布拉姆斯博士前来拜访拉佛吉。
overview.en: Stardate: 44614.6. Geordi must work with the real Leah Brahms when she arrives on the Enterprise when a space-borne alien life form thinks the ship is its mother. Tensions rise when she learns that Geordi created a holographic version of her several months before in order to save the ship from danger.

overview.zh: 企业号终于找到了失踪的联邦星舰布拉顿号，但船上的生活让星异有点烦恼。
overview.en: Stardate: 44631.2. Troi faces a recurring nightmare when the Enterprise is caught in a rift in space. Soon, the crew begins to slip into insanity through dream deprivation.

overview.zh: 拉佛吉的朋友雷杰坦对前同事们的下落颇为担心。不久后，他们两人开始出现令人不安的病状。
overview.en: Stardate: 44664.5. Geordi and a former crew mate begin evolving into bizarre creatures when they return to a planet both of them were on during an Away Mission five years earlier.

overview.zh: 接到调查不明探测器的任务时，巴克礼上尉不知为何信心大增，知识储备也大大增加。
overview.en: Stardate: 44704.2. An alien probe transforms Barclay from a shy, awkward character into an arrogant super-genius who is able to interface with the Enterprise's computer through the holodeck.

overview.zh: 正当皮卡德舰长准备举办大型活动招待星际联邦考古学评议会时，一位昔日情人的到来引发了意想不到的戏剧性事件。
overview.en: Stardate:44741.9. Q places Vash and the senior Enterprise crew in a recreation of Robin Hood and his merry men.

overview.zh: 一位退休的上将登上企业号调查一起可能的恶意破坏行为，并将皮卡德舰长置于尴尬境地。
overview.en: Stardate: 44769.2. Picard is accused of treason when an explosion aboard the Enterprise is investigated by a ruthless and paranoid Starfleet Admiral.

overview.zh: 星异的妈妈来到企业号，她爱上了一个男人，但这个人的文化传统迫使他参加一个名为“决心”的自杀式仪式。
overview.en: Stardate: 44805.3. Lwaxana Troi falls in love with a man who must return home to commit suicide, as is customary for their race when they reach a certain age.

overview.zh: 库修博士爱上了一位来访大使，结果发现他并非自己所想象的那样。
overview.en: Startdate: 44821.3. Dr. Crusher falls in love with a Trill Ambassador, until she discovers the Trill's symbiotic relationship.

overview.zh: 鹰眼受罗穆兰人洗脑，并接到暗杀克林贡大使的命令。
overview.en: Stardate: 44885.5. While en route to Risa for shore leave, Geordi is abducted by the Romulans and brainwashed into becoming an assassin.

overview.zh: 一个女船员迷上了Data，Data决定试着和她谈谈恋爱。
overview.en: Stardate: 44932.3. Data experiences the complexities of love when a fellow crewmate becomes attracted to him.

overview.zh: 克林贡帝国爆发内战，皮卡德舰长和沃夫上尉必须决定他们的当务之急是做什么。
overview.en: Stardate: 44995.3. Worf must choose between his people and the Federation when a civil war threatens to destroy the Klingon Empire.

overview.zh: 在第五季中，星际舰队卷入了克林贡内战中的一场巨大阴谋，迫使进取号不情愿地成为对抗罗慕伦人的棋子，因为星际舰队的动机尚不清楚。这导致皮卡德和Data开始了一段寻找一个神秘成员的旅程，他试图在罗慕伦人和瓦肯人之间建立和平。与此同时，一位来自未来的访客来到了企业，因为狼与自己的残疾作斗争。当一名受伤的敌人到来时，船员们变得更加矛盾。和平即将到来，但代价是什么？
overview.en: In season five, Starfleet becomes involved in a vast conspiracy amidst a Klingon civil war which forces the Enterprise to become an unwilling pawn against the Romulans as Starfleet's motives are unknown. This leads Picard and Data to undertake a journey to seek out a mysterious member who is trying to make peace between the Romulans and the Vulcans. Meanwhile, a visitor from the future arrives on the Enterprise as Wolf struggles with his own handicap. The crew becomes even more conflicted as an injured enemy arrives. Peace is seen on the horizon but at what cost?

overview.zh: 沃夫加入克林贡内战当中，皮卡德舰长和船员必须帮助他们的傀儡赢下战争，阻止罗慕伦人。
overview.en: Stardate: 45020.4. Picard suspects a Romulan influence in the recent Klingon civil war, and must force the Federation to intervene before the Empire collapses.

overview.zh: 一个外星种族的语言和通用翻译器不兼容，皮卡德必须找到办法与他们沟通。
overview.en: Stardate: 45047.2. Picard must find a way to communicate with the newly discovered Tamarians, who speak entirely in metaphors, when a Tamarian Captain is brutally killed.

overview.zh: 新来的军官罗少尉被召去追查一队贝久恐怖分子。然而罗少尉自己就是贝久人，她必须先取得船员们的信任。
overview.en: Stardate: 45076.3. Picard exposes a planned genocidal attack on the Bajorans with the help of a new officer, Ensign Ro Laren.

overview.zh: 在被电子风暴击中后，赖克、Data、克拉夏和其他船员在一颗类似地球的行星上建起了殖民地。
overview.en: Stardate: 45122.3. Picard attempts communications with the Crystalline Entity - a life form responsible for hundreds of deaths throughout the Alpha Quadrant. However, a scientist on board the Enterprise has plans of revenge over the death of her only son at the hands of the Entity.

overview.zh: 企业号撞上量子纤维带后飞船系统受损，皮卡德舰长被困在涡轮电梯中，特洛伊成为临时指挥官。
overview.en: Stardate: 45156.1. A natural disaster leaves Troi in command of the Enterprise, Picard stuck in a turbo lift with three small children and Keiko O'Brien stuck in Ten-Forward giving birth with an anxious Worf.

overview.zh: 卫斯理·克拉夏休假完毕，从星舰学院回到企业号上，却发现船员表现得十分诡异。
overview.en: Stardate: 45208.2. An addictive game is distributed among the crew of the Enterprise, however, it appears that this game interferes with a person's logic and reason, which leaves the crew open to manipulation. Only a young Ensign and a vacationing Wesley Crusher are able to think for themselves, and must find a way to reverse the damage before the ship falls into the wrong hands.

overview.zh: 皮卡德舰长和 Data 冒着危险跟踪史波克来到罗慕伦人的地盘。
overview.en: Stardate: 45233.1. Ambassador Spock has disappeared and intelligence finds him on Romulus.  Captain Picard is sent to Romulus to find Spock.  Meanwhile Riker and the rest of the crew investigate the fragments of a Vulcan ship discovered in the wreck of a Ferengi vessel.

overview.zh: 参议员帕代克在罗慕伦星球发现皮卡德舰长，并带他去见史波克大使。史波克谈到了瓦肯人和罗慕伦人统一的可能性。
overview.en: Stardate: 45245.8. Picard and Data find Spock and discover the reason behind the secret meetings. However, a darker scheme planned by the Romulans is also uncovered in the process.

overview.zh: 一颗小行星给潘塞拉四号星球造成灾难性破坏，企业号船员试图到那里拯救该星球。
overview.en: Stardate: 45349.1. While on a mission to help a planet recently struck by an asteroid, the Enterprise is paid a visit by a man who claims to be from the future.

overview.zh: 沃尔夫的妈妈带着沃尔夫的儿子一起登上企业号，告诉他沃尔夫的人类父母不再替他照顾儿子了。
overview.en: Stardate: 45376.3. Worf's son, Alexander, unexpectedly arrives on the Enterprise to stay with his father. However, Alexander wants to stay permanently.

overview.zh: Data 救了一个男孩。为了抑制自己的痛苦，男孩开始模仿 Data 的个性。
overview.en: Stardate: 45397.3. The Enterprise investigates the cause of an explosion that destroyed a small ship and its entire crew, except for a small boy.

overview.zh: 在护送三位具有心灵探测能力的尤里安历史学家时，企业号船员受到阻挠，一些船员陷入昏迷。
overview.en: Stardate: 45429.3. While escorting a group of telepaths, crew members on board the Enterprise suddenly start to slip into comas.

overview.zh: 企业号前往莫阿布四号上的人类殖民地，警告他们巨大的行星碎片正靠近该星球。
overview.en: Stardate: 45470.1. A natural disaster in the core of a system's sun threatens to destroy a colony of genetically engineered people on an otherwise desolate planet. However, the crew's intervention may cause more harm than good.

overview.zh: 一艘靠近企业号的外星飞船抹去了船员们的记忆，船员们努力拼凑线索，试图弄明白发生了什么。
overview.en: Stardate: 45494.2. The Enterprise crew unknowingly receives a new first officer who claims that the Federation is at war with another species.

overview.zh: 一艘失踪已久的飞船在一颗星球被找到，那里的宇宙风暴导致该飞船 200 年来未被探测到。
overview.en: Stardate: 45571.2. While en route to the source of a subspace distress signal coming from a desolate moon, Data, Troi and O'Brien take over the bridge and force the ship to change course.

overview.zh: 一起事故导致沃尔夫失去行走能力，沃尔夫让赖克帮他自杀。
overview.en: Stardate: 45587.3. When Worf is paralysed in an accident he must undergo drastic back surgery. However, this experimental technique may cost him his life.

overview.zh: 赖克爱上一个雌雄同体的外星人，他的一些族人在一个地图上没有标示的宇宙空间走失。
overview.en: Stardate: 45614.6. While investigating the disappearance of a J'naii shuttlecraft, the crew finds reason to believe the missing ship is stranded in an abnormal pocket called "null space." Riker and Soren, a member of the J'naii race, begin preparing to rescue the craft, and the two strike up a friendship. Their relationship develops quickly as the pair question each other about mating habits, since the J'naii are androgynous and do not identify themselves as either male or female. Despite this difference, sparks begin to fly between them.

overview.zh: 企业号陷入时空循环，最终总是以飞船彻底毁灭为结局。
overview.en: Stardate: 45652.1. While exploring the Typhon Expanse, the Enterprise is caught in a time warp in which they are repeatedly destroyed while colliding with another starship.

overview.zh: 卫斯理·克拉夏的小分队在星际舰队学院发生事故。皮卡德舰长主动帮助星舰调查事故的原委。
overview.en: Stardate: 45703.9. Wesley is involved in a cover-up at Starfleet Academy when a cadet is killed and five shuttles are destroyed during a forbidden maneuver performed by Starfleet Academy's best cadets.

overview.zh: 正当企业号的船员为一场意外的婚礼做准备之际，飞船开始遇到奇怪的故障。
overview.en: Stardate: 45733.6. Deanna's mother pays a surprise visit to the Enterprise with even more surprising news: she plans to marry a man she has never met. After destroying an asteroid, the ship becomes infected with parasites that eat away at the ship's hull.

overview.zh: 企业号曾无意中给一个外星种族送了份独特的礼物：一个具有移情能力的美女。她唯一的生活目标就是取悦她的配偶。
overview.en: Stardate: 45761.3. The Ferengi try to abduct an empathic Metamorph who could bring peace between two warring worlds.

overview.zh: 一个最近上船的孩子开始和想象中的朋友一起玩，但他异想的朋友却影响到了飞船的运行。
overview.en: Stardate: 45852.1. While exploring a strange form of energy in a region of space, a little girl's imaginary friend becomes real and places the Enterprise in great danger.

overview.zh: 企业号发现一个落单的博格个体，并将他带上了船。
overview.en: Stardate: 45854.2. An injured Borg is discovered and brought back to the Enterprise where he is 'repaired' by Dr. Crusher and befriended by Geordi, who names him 'Hugh.' Soon, Hugh starts showing signs of individuality while Picard must choose between destroying him or returning him to the collective.

overview.zh: 当“企业号” 回应来自一艘罗慕伦飞船的求救呼叫时，罗少尉和拉弗吉在一次传送故障中失踪。
overview.en: Stardate: 45892.4. While the Enterprise helps a Romulan science vessel, an accident occurs which forces Geordi LaForge and Ro Laren slightly out of 'phase', causing them to become undetectable to everyone but each other. As a result, the crew thinks they are dead and make arrangements for their funerals, even though they are closer than the crew realise.

overview.zh: 皮卡德一觉醒来，发现自己身处一个村庄里，并且是一名德高望重的人物，而飞船舰长的身份只是他的幻觉。
overview.en: Stardate: 45944.1. Picard awakes to find himself living in a small village where he is a well-known member of the community who is suffering from a delusion of being a starship captain.

overview.zh: 外星人在 19 世纪末期造访地球的证据被发现，科学家们要求企业号返回地球。
overview.en: Stardate: 45959.1. Data's head is uncovered in an archaeological dig on Earth, where evidence is also found that aliens may have been on Earth as early as the 19th Century. Using modified technology, an away team follows Data into the late 1890s to investigate.

overview.zh: 在第六季中，船员们将面对一个来自过去的熟悉面孔，他坚持认为机器无法取代人类的经验。这在Data中引起了冲突，Data质疑自己与进取号的关系，而不是为了感受自己的第一种情感而加入一个强大的敌人。Worf开始寻找他的父亲，作为最终接受他的克林贡血统和恢复他的家庭荣誉的一种手段。随着银河之旅的继续，皮卡德被一个反叛的外星指挥官绑架，瑞克扮演船长的角色，解救皮卡德，恢复进取号。令瑞克惊讶的是，一个老敌人回来了，并为营救皮卡德提供了帮助。最后，进取号面临着最令人震惊的惊喜。
overview.en: In season six, the crew is faced with a familiar face from the past who insists that machines cannot replace human experience. This causes conflict in Data who questions his affiliation with the Enterprise vs. joining a powerful enemy in order to feel his first emotion. Worf begins a quest to find his father as a means to finally accept his Klingon heritage and to restore honor upon his family. As the journey continues through the galaxy, Picard is kidnapped by a rebel alien command and Riker takes on the role of Captain to free Picard and restore the Enterprise. To Riker’s surprise, an old enemy returns and offers assistance with Picard’s rescue. All finishing with the Enterprise facing its most shocking surprise.

overview.zh: 为了把 Data 带回来，皮卡德舰长和船员跟随 Data 回到 19 世纪，却发现疑似外星来客在那段时期对地球人进行了屠杀。
overview.en: Stardate: 46001.3. The away team's investigations are hampered by a nosy Samuel Clemens. Picard discovers that he originally met Guinan in the 1890s on Earth.

overview.zh: 为了克服自己对传送机的恐惧，巴克利中将加入一支远征队，但却在幻觉中看到有什么东西和他一起进入了传送机。
overview.en: Stardate: 46041.1. Lt. Barclay's fear of using transporters is eerily justified when he sees bizarre aliens within the transporter beam.

overview.zh: 企业号前去营救一位大使和他的母亲，特洛伊发现自己被大使迷住了。
overview.en: Stardate: 46071.6. Deanna becomes attracted to an alien ambassador. Shortly thereafter, she starts ageing rapidly and starts becoming violent.

overview.zh: 企业号偶然发现一颗第松球体，并有一艘飞船坠毁在球体外表面。
overview.en: Stardate: 46125.3. Montgomery 'Scotty' Scott is discovered suspended in a transporter beam 75 years after he disappeared. After the Enterprise crew re-materialise him, he has a hard time adjusting to the new society.

overview.zh: 指挥官赖克和其他一些船员发觉自己无法安稳休息，企业号船员开始寻找这种神秘现象产生的原因。
overview.en: Stardate: 46154.2. Members of the crew are secretly abducted from the Enterprise to be used in bizarre experiments where they are dismembered and re-assembled without anyone's knowledge - including their own. The only signs that anything is wrong is a strange form of tiredness and no recollection of having slept well the night before.

overview.zh: 一个医学优等生被分到企业号上当实习生，她开始展示出和 Q 一样的能力。
overview.en: Stardate: 46192.3. A young intern visiting the Enterprise captures the interest of Q when she starts displaying Q-like powers.

overview.zh: 穿梭机在一个能量场被捕获后，皮卡德舰长和另外三人被传送回飞船 — 然而当传送完成后，他们却变成了孩子。
overview.en: Stardate: 46235.7. A transporter accident transforms Picard, Ro Laren, Guinan and Keiko O'Brien into small children who appear to be about 12 years old. Matters are complicated when the Ferengi seize the Enterprise.

overview.zh: 急需休息的船员们难得停工一会，沃尔夫带儿子在全息甲板上体验古老的西部探险。
overview.en: Stardate: 46271.5. Worf and his son, Alexander, become trapped in the holodeck when their Wild West program malfunctions. However, they must find a way to defeat the holographic bandits who have Data's appearance and abilities.

overview.zh: 当拉弗吉被派去调查一处新开发的矿区时，法拉伦博士用一种叫艾索康的新机器人修复能量栅格。
overview.en: Stardate: 46315.2. Data discovers that the maintenance robots built by Dr. Farallon may have become sentient.

overview.zh: 企业号换了新舰长，以便皮卡德、沃尔夫和克拉夏能执行秘密任务，进入卡达西人的领空。
overview.en: Stardate: 46357.4. Picard resigns as Captain of the Enterprise to lead a top-secret espionage mission into Cardassia with Worf and Dr. Crusher.

overview.zh: 毫无幽默感的杰里科舰长带领船员竭力阻止卡达西人入侵。皮卡德舰长被俘虏，并受到审讯专家的严刑折磨。
overview.en: Stardate: 46360.8. Picard is captured and tortured by the Cardassians, while Riker tries to prevent a Federation attack on Cardassia.

overview.zh: 巴克利上尉在诊断全息娱乐程序“福尔摩斯”的异常时，意外唤醒了其中的莫里亚蒂教授。
overview.en: Stardate: 46424.1. While performing holodeck maintenance, Barclay accesses the stored hologram of Professor Moriarty, who wreaks havoc on board the Enterprise.

overview.zh: 子空间通讯站的一位船员被确认死亡。企业号上，谋杀阴谋论传得沸沸扬扬。
overview.en: Stardate: 46461.3. Geordie falls in love with a lieutenant who is the prime suspect in a murder case.

overview.zh: 特洛伊醒来后发现自己变了模样，看起来像个罗慕伦人。她不知道自己被卷入一场猫鼠游戏，成为了罗慕伦人的情报员。
overview.en: Stardate: 46519.1. Troi is abducted and surgically altered by the Romulans as part of a ploy to smuggle intelligence operatives into the Federation.

overview.zh: 皮卡德舰长在战斗中身受重伤，他的人工心脏严重受损。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. A mortally wounded Picard is forced into re-living a time of his life when he was back in Starfleet Academy, with the intervention of Q.

name.zh: 与生俱来的权利：第 1 部分

overview.zh: 一个尤里迪安人告诉沃尔夫他的父亲没有死于战争中，而是被关押在罗慕伦战俘营，并为他提供了坐标。
overview.en: Stardate: 46578.4. While visiting Deep Space Nine, Worf learns that his father is still alive and being held captive in a secret Romulan prison camp.

name.zh: 与生俱来的权利：第 2 部分

overview.zh: 沃尔夫在基度玛营里发现了罗慕伦袭击事件中的幸存者。尽管沃尔夫自己身陷牢狱，但他不愿与这些人为伍。
overview.en: Stardate: 46759.2. Worf is captured by the Romulans where he learns why the other captives did not attempt an escape years before.

overview.zh: 飞船停靠接受检修，困在船上的皮卡德舰长可能有生命危险。
overview.en: Stardate: 46682.4. The crew evacuates the Enterprise when the ship needs to be cleaned of particles that have built up over the ship's hull. However, Picard accidentally stumbles over a terrorist group who plan on destroying the ship. He only has a short time to stop their attempts before the ship is swept by a beam of radiation to remove the particles that is lethal to all forms of life.

overview.zh: 皮卡德舰长爱上了星体科学部的新负责人。当不得不派她执行危险任务时，皮卡德舰长有些担忧。
overview.en: Stardate: 46693.1. Picard must choose between love and command when he must make a decision that could place the woman he loves in a potentially deadly and high-risk mission.

overview.zh: 企业号船员希望揭开一个考古学秘密，然而这件事也吸引了克林贡和卡达西人的注意，船员们必须争分夺秒。
overview.en: Stardate: 46731.5. Picard's old archaeology professor is found murdered, the crew try to complete his research. Soon, the crew must compete with Romulans and Klingons and Cardassians to uncover the truth behind his discoveries.

overview.zh: 赖克发现自己身处精神病院，而企业号上的一切可能都是幻觉。他开始质疑现实的真伪。
overview.en: Stardate: 46778.1. Riker questions his sanity when his reality seems to shift between an alien psychiatric hospital and a play he is performing with other members of the crew.

overview.zh: 为了证明一个科学家的新屏蔽技术理论，克拉夏医生赌上自己的职业生涯，而该科学家也可能在实验过程中丧命。
overview.en: Stardate: 46830.1. Dr. Crusher puts her career on the line when she tries to clear the name of a murdered scientist whose invention could allow starships to pass through a sun's corona.

overview.zh: 沃尔夫执勤时注意力不集中，于是被放了个假，去打理个人事务。
overview.en: Stardate: 46852.2. While on a quest to summon a vision of Kahless, Worf questions his faith when the real Kahless rises from the dead to lead the Empire.

overview.zh: 企业号回到每八年才开放一次的废弃前哨站，并在这里发现了一张熟悉的面孔。
overview.en: Stardate: 46915.2. Riker discovers that eight years ago, an exact clone of him was created when he beamed through a planet's surface while returning to his starship. This clone, named Thomas Riker, has secretly remained on the planet for the past eight years, and still has romantic feelings for Troi.

overview.zh: 皮卡德舰长、拉弗吉、Data 和特洛伊经历了奇怪的现象 — 他们中似乎有人遭遇了时间停滞。
overview.en: Stardate: 46944.2. Picard, Geordi, Troi and Data return from a Federation conference to find the Enterprise frozen in time and under attack from a frozen Romulan Warbird.

overview.zh: 在与博格人会面的过程中，Data 第一次产生情绪体验，这种生物机械种族让他感到愤怒。
overview.en: Stardate: 46982.1. The Borg return to threaten the Federation under the new leadership of Lore. Data experiences a disturbing facet of human emotions - he feels pleasure after killing a Borg drone.

overview.zh: 在第七季也是最后一季中，瑞克作为卧底，在一艘外星飞船上发现了伪装成雇佣兵的皮卡德。他们一起启动了一个寻找致命神器的计划。船员们努力处理数据的新发现的人为因素，这给船员造成了几次创伤。当皮卡德被外星种族囚禁时，他开始接受过去的情感。瑞克再次在他对皮卡德的忠诚和对星际舰队和联邦的义务之间产生矛盾。由于船员的生命受到威胁，皮卡德被带到过去，现在和未来的旅程，看看他的行为的结果。
overview.en: In the seventh and final season, Riker goes undercover and rediscovers Picard posing as a mercenary on an alien ship. Together they initiate a plan to find a lethal artifact. The crew struggles to deal with Data's new found human elements which cause several traumatic episodes for the crew. As Picard is imprisoned by an alien race, he comes to terms with past emotions. Riker is once again conflicted between his loyalty to Picard and his obligation to Starfleet and the Federation. As the lives of the crew members are endangered, Picard is taken on a journey to the past, present, and future to see the results of his actions.

overview.zh: 在被洛雷囚禁后，皮卡德舰长、拉弗吉和特洛伊尝试越狱。
overview.en: Stardate: 47025.4. Data abducts Picard, Troi and Geordi and holds them prisoners of the Borg, while he derives pleasure from being evil. Dr. Crusher is left in command of the Enterprise as it comes under attack from a Borg vessel.

overview.zh: 一项外交任务让皮卡德舰长头疼不已。与此同时，两位大使让企业号的日子很不好过。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. During an exchange program, Picard's shuttle crashes on an unknown planet where he is rescued by the sole survivor of another crash.

overview.zh: 拉弗吉用新远程探测技术寻找被击落的飞船。但一想到母亲失踪的消息，拉弗吉就无法集中注意力。
overview.en: Stardate: 47215.5. Geordi defies direct orders from Captain Picard in an attempt to rescue his mother who had recently been reported as missing.

overview.zh: 在调查皮卡德舰长的死亡事件时，赖克被一伙星际古董盗贼绑架。
overview.en: Stardate: 47135.2. An away team investigates the apparent death of Jean-Luc Picard who was supposedly killed in a bar fight. When Riker is abducted by a band of criminals who loot archaeological digs, he is shocked to find Picard alive and well, and undercover as a renegade archaeologist.

overview.zh: 皮卡德和赖克必须弄明白为什么星际黑帮要抢劫考古遗址。
overview.en: Stardate: 47160.1. Picard and Riker covertly work together in an attempt to find out why the criminals are looting archaeological digs.

overview.zh: Data 受到令人费解的噩梦困扰，而企业号则需解决新曲速核未能如期正常工作的问题。
overview.en: Stardate: 47225.7. Data's new dream subroutine causes him to experience nightmares which provide a unique insight into strange events that are occurring on board the Enterprise.

overview.zh: 在和一种叫凯林人的外星种族建交时，迪安娜的母亲精神崩溃并陷入昏迷。
overview.en: Stardate: 47254.1. Lwaxana Troi collapses with a repressed memory related illness. Her only chance for survival is if Deanna can probe her subconscious and find out what is killing her. However, the secret Lwaxana holds is deeper than Deanna imagined.

overview.zh: 在被外星人俘获后，皮卡德舰长和克拉夏医生对彼此的了解更进了一步。
overview.en: Stardate: 47304.2. While on a a diplomatic mission, Dr. Crusher and Picard are captured and imprisoned. As a result, they are linked together via a telepathic device.

overview.zh: 附近星球的科学家主动联系企业号，声称长期暴露在曲速能量下会对宇宙空间造成损害。
overview.en: Stardate: 47310.2. The Enterprise is drawn to a region of space where many starships have been mysteriously disabled. They soon learn that a brother and sister team has been working together to bring attention to the fact that frequent high-warp travel is damaging the very fabric of space/time.

overview.zh: 在星际联邦的阿特雷亚四号星球，Data 遇到一个自称是他母亲的人，她说自己是 Data 制造者的妻子。
overview.en: Stardate: 47410.2. Data is disturbed by the claims of a woman who says she is Noonien Soong's ex-wife.

overview.zh: 在从克林贡帝国举办的飞刀比赛归来后，沃尔夫注意到企业号船员有些不同。
overview.en: Stardate: 47391.2. Worf returns from a Klingon competition to find that he is shifting through different realities.

overview.zh: 赖克发现天马座号飞船的前指挥官收到过许多命令，而其中很多事情皮卡德舰长根本不知道。
overview.en: Stardate: 47457.1. Riker is placed on a covert mission to find the missing starship he was once a member aboard, but the mission holds a secret that could destroy the peace treaty between the Federation and the Romulans.

overview.zh: 为了拯救一群遭遇致命风暴袭击的人，沃尔夫的人类兄弟违背了最高指导原则。
overview.en: Stardate: 47423.9. Worf's adoptive brother violates the Prime Directive to save an alien society whose planet is dying.

overview.zh: 在为已故祖母料理后事时，克拉夏医生见到了祖母过去生活中的一个人。
