overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Dr. Crusher attends her grandmother's funeral, to find that she had been in romantic encounters with a mysterious man who had been haunting the Howard family women for generations.

overview.zh: 低级军官中有些人对企业号指挥部的行动产生质疑，他们对也对自己的责任与荣誉感产生了疑问。
overview.en: Stardate: 47566.7. Four young ensigns compete for a promotion that only one of them will receive. However, they are soon placed on a top secret mission that places some of their lives in danger.

overview.zh: Data 被派去追踪一枚偏离轨道坠毁在原始星球的探测器，但他却同样坠毁在星球上并且丧失了记忆。
overview.en: Stardate: 47611.2. Data find himself mysteriously stranded on a planet with no recollection of who he is or how he arrived there. Soon he is accused of spreading a plague among the inhabitants. Troi takes the bridge officer's test in an attempt to gain the rank of Commander.

overview.zh: 一个外星资料库将企业号转变为自己的古代社会，Data 也被来自这个已灭绝文明中的人格所附身。
overview.en: Stardate: 47615.2. The Enterprise is slowly transformed into an ancient alien temple when Data discovers an alien archive full of information about an ancient culture. Shortly after opening the archive, Data becomes possessed with several different personalities.

overview.zh: 在调查一名船员的自杀案时，特洛伊受困于不断出现的奇怪幻觉。与此同时，她和沃尔夫的关系加深了。
overview.en: Stardate: 47622.1. While investigating the mysterious suicide of a crew member, Troi and Worf begin to show romantic feeling towards one another.

overview.zh: 皮卡德舰长和 Data 返回企业号，却发现全体船员处于各种退化状态。
overview.en: Stardate: 47653.2. Upon returning from an away mission, Picard and Data find the ship drifting in space, and the crew de-evolving into their animal ancestors.

overview.zh: 卡达西人允许星际联邦进入多万五号星球。在那里，皮卡德舰长必须重新找到移居此地的土著印第安人。
overview.en: Stardate: 47751.2. Under the terms of the new Federation/Cardassian alliance, Picard is ordered to evacuate a colony of native Americans, but protests from Wesley hamper the process. Wesley's destiny is finally revealed to him when the Traveler returns.

overview.zh: 沃尔夫带他的儿子参加一个克林贡节日，并鼓励他接受自己族人的文化传统并成为一个战士。但一场意外在等着他们。
overview.en: Stardate: 47779.4. A disinterested Alexander must face his first Right of Ascension passage, but a mysterious warrior by the name of K'Mtar brings with him a disturbing request.

overview.zh: 皮卡德舰长竟然有个自己所不知道的儿子 — 他必须抢在佛瑞吉人之前找到这个儿子。
overview.en: Stardate: 47829.1. Picard tries to save his newly-discovered son from the retaliation of a vengeful Ferengi whose only son was killed by Picard during the Battle of Maxia many years before.

overview.zh: Data 和其他船员发现飞船电脑开始产生自我意识，并做出一些奇怪的行为。
overview.en: Stardate: 47869.2. The Enterprise's computer systems starts having repeated malfunctions, leading the crew to believe that it may be evolving into a new life form.

overview.zh: 罗少尉被派到马奇反抗军当卧底，她在忠于星际舰队与同情马奇反抗军之间左右为难。
overview.en: Stardate: 47941.7. Fresh from Starfleet's Advanced Tactical Training course, Ro Laren is assigned to infiltrate the Maquis. However, over time she begins to sympathize with them, which forces her to choose between her loyalty to the Federation, and her new friends in the Maquis.

overview.zh: 皮卡德发现自己在不断过去、现在、未来三个时间周期中切换，他必须找到是什么在威胁人类的生存。
overview.en:
Stardate: 47988.0. Shortly after Picard is diagnosed with a long-term, potentially debilitating brain disorder, he starts experiencing bizarre shifts into three main time periods: 25 years into the future, a few days before the Enterprise-D is sent on its mission to Farpoint station, and the present. Picard realizes that Q is behind these shifts through time.

Stardate:  47988.1. After his encounter with Q, Picard assembles the senior staff, and wonders if Q is actually giving him a chance to save humanity by showing him that the spatial anomaly also exists in the past. As they talk, the ship reaches the Neutral Zone, then Picard returns to the future, where Beverly's ship is also on the edge of the Neutral Zone. He convinces a reluctant Worf to accompany the group into Klingon territory, and then travels to the past, where he orders the crew into the Devron system.

overview.zh: 《星际迷航：深空九号》（Star Trek: Deep Space Nine，简称「DS9」）是第三代星际迷航系列剧集，从1993年至1999年总共播出了七季，该剧共获得3项艾美奖，9项其他各类奖和42项各类提名。它不以「星舰进取号」及其船员为主角，而以记述围绕在「深空九号」（Deep Space Nine）太空站周遭所发生的事件为主。　　故事发生在2369 年，深空九号太空站本来是卡达西人占领贝久后所建造的采矿太空站﹝原名「Terok Nor」﹞，一直到资源全被卡达西人掏空后，卡达西人留下了这个采矿站离开，贝久人因为资源不足无法重建自己的家园，只好向星际联邦求助。太空站由星际联邦与贝久星共同管理，并更名为「深空九号」，于是它变成了联邦最偏远的太空站。 在第一集里太空站附近发现一个稳定的虫洞，可以迅速地往返遥远的Gamma象限。这个发现瞬间让这个太空站成为星际联邦最有价值的太空站，也成为进入这个广大未开拓宇宙空间的重要商业中心和军事重地。　　虽然电视指南（TV Guide）认为《深空九号》在「演、编、制以及整体而言都是最好的星舰系列剧集」，然而很多传统星舰迷一开始并不能完全接受它，有人说它背弃了星舰原创人吉恩·罗登贝瑞的原始构想，不过根据报导，罗登贝瑞在死前认可了这个剧集的概念。　　「DS9」颠复了以往Star Trek系列对未来世界过分理想化的描述，它是由一个废弃的采矿站加上默契欠佳的成员所组成的，而且由于深空九号太空站的地理位置和特殊的外交，站长偶尔就必须在有意无意间忽视或违背星际联邦的「最高指导原则」，在这许多不完美的条件下，发展出新的风格和管理的方式。「DS9」里所刻划的星舰时空是一个介于银河里各个大国之间的强权政治时代，基本上「DS9」偏重于探讨战争、宗教、政治妥协以及其他现代议题等等，很多人性的黑暗面都会在剧集中表露无疑，然而对于外来种族执意的侵略，为了保护联邦无辜的公民，星际联邦只好让战争在边境发生，这场战争打了四年，「DS9」后期的剧情就以这场「自治同盟战争」为主轴，主角们也渐渐获得成长，和一开始成员间的不协调已经完全不同了。
overview.en: At Deep Space Nine, a space station located next to a wormhole in the vicinity of the liberated planet of Bajor, Commander Sisko and crew welcome alien visitors, root out evildoers and solve all types of unexpected problems that come their way.

The Provisional Government of Bajor invites Starfleet to help them rebuild after the Cardassian Occupation. Commander Benjamin Sisko is selected to take command of their space station, formerly known as Terok Nor that is then designated by Starfleet as Deep Space 9. As part of the agreement between the Federation and Bajor, Starfleet will help them to become a member of the Federation.

overview.zh:
本杰明第一次见了他的副站长卡拉少校；一个贝久星女子。

先知族给贝久星创造了通往伽玛象限的虫洞, 却引起卡达西人的觊觎。
overview.en:
Stardate: 46379.1.  Commander Benjamin Sisko and a new crew of Starfleet and Bajoran officers take command of an abandoned Cardassian space station and make an incredible discovery that will change the galaxy and Sisko's future.

A new crew is assigned to a former Cardassian space station: Deep Space Nine. It is a joint Federation/Bajoran force, with Commander Sisko in charge, but his life is dramatically changed when he is declared the Emissary to the Prophets by a Bajoran priest.

overview.zh: 一个贝久星卡拉少校的反抗军旧日同僚抵达DS9星站，却被卡达西当恐怖分子追捕。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown.  Kira finds her loyalties divided when a Bajoran extremist wanted by the Cardassians comes to the station with questionable intentions.

overview.zh: 奥度(Odo) 被控告为杀人犯。
overview.en: Stardate: 46421.5.  When the return of a man Odo sent to prison years earlier leads to his murder aboard the station, Odo becomes the prime suspect and a target for harassment.

overview.zh: 神秘病毒在站上传开, 让人失去说话能力。
overview.en: Stardate: 46423.7.  A deadly virus created by the Bajorans 18 years earlier inadvertently breaks loose aboard the station, and prompts a race against the clock to find a cure.

overview.zh: 奥布赖恩照顾一个伽玛象限闯来的外星人，但该外星人却是一种打猎游戏的猎物。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown.  When O'Brien befriends the station's first visitor from the Gamma Quadrant, he learns that the mysterious alien is on the run from determined pursuers.

overview.zh: 贵族连续体Q 和瓦许到达星站。 瓦许却一直想赶走Q。
overview.en: Stardate: 46531.2.  Vash arrives from the Gamma Quadrant as Q plagues the station and an unknown force threatens to destroy it.

overview.zh: 佳吉雅戴克斯 为了她的共生体上一世做的杀人案而被告。
overview.en: Stardate: 46910.1.  Jadzia Dax is charged with a murder that her symbiont's previous host Curzon allegedly committed. Now an extradition hearing may decide whether Jadzia can be held responsible for the actions of a previous life.

overview.zh: 一个邪恶罪犯的意念波潜伏在某人身上。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown.  A dangerous killer dies in an apparent accident, but the security officer providing his transport to prison believes the criminal's consciousness may have yet survived.

overview.zh: 夸克遇到了爱玩游戏的外星族Wadi, 却因作弊而被迫加入外星人的另一种游戏。
overview.en: The Wadi from the Gamma Quadrant are to make first contact and decide to visit DS9. When they catch Quark cheating they let him off by playing a special game.

overview.zh: 夸克意外当上了佛伦基人的首领(那格斯)却发现被一群敌人虎视眈眈。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown.  Grand Nagus Zek, the leader of Ferengi society, comes to DS9 to oversee the introduction of a Ferengi business presence in the Gamma Quadrant and announce Quark as his successor.

overview.zh: 奥度从一个太空站旅客身上找到了能在伽玛象限寻找自己同类的希望。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown.  A wanted man from the Gamma Quadrant with questionable motives reveals to Odo stories about other "Changelings," which may hold clues to Odo's mysterious origin.

overview.zh: 贝久星精神领袖,凯王欧帕咖, 与西斯可一起去伽玛象限旅行却想留在一个人都不会死的星球。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown.  Sisko, Kira, and Bashir take Kai Opaka through the wormhole for a brief excursion in the Gamma Quadrant. But when they crash-land on a desolate planet, they find a divided, warring penal colony where no one ever dies.

overview.zh: 奥布赖恩意外当上了一个迷信村子的传说英雄，要帮他们打退一种云型怪物。
overview.en: Stardate: 46729.1.  When O'Brien and Bashir beam down to a Bajoran village, the community selects O'Brien as their next Sirah - expecting him to save them from a menacing entity.

overview.zh: 卡拉少校要去说服一个开发区的顽固农夫搬家。
overview.en: Stardate: 46844.3.  Kira finds herself in a difficult moral situation when her job demands she force an adamant Bajoran man from his home in the name of progress.

overview.zh: DS9陷入大危机 因为站员的妄想突然都实现。
overview.en: Stardate: 46853.2.  The DS9 crew's own imaginations cause mysterious beings with unknown intentions to appear on the station.

overview.zh: 联邦一个小星球的大使罗伊来访,却爱上了奥度。
overview.en: Stardate: 46925.1.  Odo and Lwaxanna Troi come to a mutual understanding when a computer malfunction causes them to become trapped in a turbolift.

overview.zh: 一艘克林贡船突然无理由的爆炸。
overview.en: Stardate: 46922.3.  An alien "telepathic matrix" causes the DS9 crew to re-enact an ancient power struggle, leading Kira to attempt mutiny and overthrow Sisko.

overview.zh: 一个卡达西旅客被发现是占领时期的战犯 卡拉坚决要处死他。
overview.en: A Cardassian suffering from Kalla-Nohra, a disease that indicates he served in a labor camp, visits DS9. Kira is determined to convict him as a war criminal.

name.en: In the Hands of the Prophets

overview.zh: 凯王来访发现站上的学校所教课程不符合贝久信仰，逐步引发一场群众骚乱。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown.  The Federation and Bajoran people of DS9 fall into conflict when a Bajoran religious extremist comes to the station and challenges the secular teachings of Keiko O'Brien's school.

In their second year together, the crew of Deep Space 9 face problems that will affect the galaxy forever. A Bajoran extremist group attempts to force the Federation out of the Bajoran system. The Cardassians are secretly supplying them with weapons, hoping to return to reclaim the planet and hold the Bajoran wormhole for the Cardassian Union. However, the greatest enemy of all is lurking beyond it.

overview.zh: 卡拉前往卡达西领土营救一个贝久囚犯。同时圆桌会意图在贝九星夺权。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Word that a previously thought dead Bajoran resistance legend is still alive sends Kira and Chief O'Brien to Cardassia IV to rescue him; meanwhile "The Circle", a sect of the Bajoran provisional government that is intent on wiping out alien influence, is sneaking into power.

overview.zh: 圆桌会想颠覆政府。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Kira spends time with Vedek Bareil on Bajor just as "The Circle" begins arming themselves from a mysterious source.

overview.zh: 本杰明和卡拉意图阻止圆桌会拿下太空站。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. As a "Circle"-led Bajoran military tries to occupy the station, a skeleton crew led by Sisko fight to reveal "The Circle's" big secret before they are forced to evacuate themselves. Meanwhile, Kira and Dax lead a mission to reveal the truth about "The Circle" on Bajor.

overview.zh: 一个昔日在共生体竞争考试中的戴克斯对手；攻下太空站想抢她的共生体。
overview.en: Stardate: 47182.1. A jealous Trill, who had waited his entire life to receive a symbiont but never had, decides to steal one. . . Dax's!

overview.zh: 加拉克调查一个被留在贝久星的卡达西孤儿身世。
overview.en: Stardate: 47177.2. Political heat rises on the station as Bajorans enter the station with orphaned Cardassians they have adopted.

overview.zh: 巴舍帮助一个新报到的外星人组员。因为她的种族只习惯生活于低重力环境。
overview.en: Stardate: 47229.1. A new arrival to the station with a special gravity-based disability appeals to Bashir's heart; meanwhile an old associate of Quark's comes to the station to kill the barkeep.

overview.zh: 大国王那格斯突然造访夸克商讨未来如何掠夺伽玛象限的商业利益。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. A female Ferengi, posing as a male to be available to participate in business (a rule STRICTLY forbidden by the Ferengi government), falls for Quark during very important negotiations between the Ferengi and a Gamma Quadrant race.

overview.zh: 夸克和奥杜扯入一件5年前的谋杀案。
overview.en: Stardate: 47282.5. Odo relives some terrible and tragic memories of a past investigation when he was the constable on Cardassian-occupied Deep Space Nine, then named Terok Nor.

overview.zh: 一个神秘女子引起了本杰明注意。
overview.en: Stardate: 47329.4. While noted scientist Gideon Seyetik is preparing for an ambitious project, re-igniting a star, Sisko is intrigued by a woman who keeps disappearing.

overview.zh: 一大群伽玛象限的难民执意定居在贝久星上。
overview.en: Stardate: 47391.2. A race that has been conquered twice over, one of the conquerors being the mysterious Dominion, comes to the station seeking aid and a new home.

overview.zh: 突然有个奸诈小人开了一家酒吧和夸克竞争生意。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Quark meets his match when a new rival opens a casino opposite Quark's Bar on the Promenade; meanwhile the station is suffering issues of high improbability.

overview.zh: 一个科学家发现了疑似奥杜的族人。
overview.en: Stardate: 47391.7. Odo and Dr. Mora Pol, Odo's 'father', discover a life form similar to Odo on a Gamma Quadrant planet.

overview.zh: 奥布赖恩和巴舍帮助一个停止内战的星球销毁生化武器却被暗算攻击。
overview.en: Stardate: 47529.4. Chief O'Brien, who still doesn't like the good Doctor Bashir, must rely on him when the two are stranded on a planet and O'Brien is infected with a deadly, fast moving disease.

overview.zh: 奥布赖恩感到大家突然对他窃窃私语。
overview.en: Stardate: 47581.2. Chief O'Brien's world is turned upside down when for no reason whatsoever he is being ignored by his family and friends and is being closed out of every essential job on the station.

overview.zh: 本杰明和奥布赖恩遇到一群坠机生还者。他们习惯了过无科技的落后生活。
overview.en: Stardate: 47573.1. Sisko and Chief O'Brien discover a colony that lives without technology.

overview.zh: 奥杜和戴克斯调查一个城市的人口莫名消失的现象。
overview.en: Stardate: 47603.3. Odo and Dax investigate the mysterious disappearance of people from a village. Kira tries to keep a close eye on Quark, while Vedek Bareil unexpectedly visits.

overview.zh: 太空站组员无意间在虫洞发现一个胚胎宇宙。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. A Trill named Arjin comes to DS9 to learn what it is to be a Trill with a symbiont but finds his teacher, Dax, to be less than he expected.

overview.zh: 夸克找到了旧日情人。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. A Cardassian woman, who was once a former flame of Quark's, visits the station under dubious circumstances.

overview.zh: 戴克斯决定履行一个前任宿主的契约，跟一群老克林贡战士去复仇之旅。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Three legendary Klingons come to DS9 to see if Jadzia Dax will participate in a Blood Oath they made with Jadzia's previous host Curzon.

overview.zh: 联邦和卡达西签定协约割让一块领土，当地星球居民不肯搬迁就组成反抗军。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. The destruction of a Cardassian ship leads Sisko, Dukat, and Sisko's old friend Cal Hudson to the fact that there is an unofficial war between the Maquis and the Cardassians.

overview.zh: 马基叛军逐渐做大。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Sisko tries to resolve the Maquis crisis by preventing a war, freeing Gul Dukat and offering the defected Hudson the chance to return.

overview.zh: 巴舍揭开了一段加拉克的陈年秘密。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Dr. Bashir fights to save Garak's life when a malfunctioning  Cardassian brain implant threatens to kill him.

overview.zh: 卡拉少校和巴舍医生进入镜像宇宙冒险。
overview.en: Stardate: 47879.2. Kira and Bashir find themselves in an alternate universe.

overview.zh: 凯王温利用贝久星占领期间的一段内奸事件当成政治议题来操作。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Vedek Bareil is accused of having betrayed his people to the Cardassians during the occupation, and Major Kira is desperate to prove his innocence.

overview.zh: 奥布赖恩被卡达西抓去审判。然而卡达西司法中人人都是有罪，因为他们认为震摄效果重于事实真相
overview.en: Stardate: 47944.2. Chief O'Brien goes through the horrific Cardassian judicial system when he is charged for an unknown crime.

overview.zh: 本杰明, 杰克, 诺格,夸克四人一起去郊游却首次遭遇了自治同盟的军队。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Sisko and Quark and a strange telepathic woman are arrested by Jem'Hadar, soldiers of the Dominion.

Season 3 of Deep Space Nine marks a turning point for the series, as it introduces the USS Defiant, a powerful starship that allows the crew to explore the Gamma Quadrant and face the threat of the Dominion, a vast and ruthless empire ruled by the shape-shifting Founders.

overview.zh: 本杰明将军驾驶新型船舰勇抗号进入伽玛象限搜寻自治同盟的神秘领袖, 以避免战争。
overview.en: Stardate: 48213.1. Instead of waiting for the Jem'Hadar to attack, Sisko wants to try a different approach. He wants to take a new class starship to try to find the Founders.

overview.zh: 奥杜发现自己族人就是自治同盟领袖，开始居中斡旋和平的可能性。
overview.en: Stardate: 48213.1. Odo has found his home and is introduced. Meanwhile Sisko finds out peace talks between the Dominion and the Federation have already started.

overview.zh: 夸克误杀了一个克林贡人，一串阴错阳差后他要继承他的家族头目地位。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Quark tries to boost his reputation by taking credit for the accidental death of a Klingon in his bar, but lands himself in the middle of a Klingon political struggle.

overview.zh: 戴克斯的前任宿主隐藏记忆突然引发一种疾病。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. The Trill homeworld is the setting, as Sisko and Bashir take Jadzia home for treatment when she begins experiencing hallucinations after playing a tune she can't recall.

overview.zh: 卡拉被卡达西人绑架, 并被告知她其实是一个洗掉记忆的卡达西间谍整容成贝久人。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Kira finds herself on Cardassia as a Cardassian. She is told she is called Iliana Ghemor and was a Cardassian spy.

overview.zh: 奥杜捡到了一个詹哈达婴儿，也解开了一个秘密。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Odo tries to bond with an alien child Quark finds in a load of salvage, while Sisko tries to break his son's relationship with a 20 year old Dabo girl.

overview.zh: 奥布赖恩, 杰克, 本杰明三人意外启动了卡达西留在站上的一套紧急镇压暴动程式。导致DS9陷落
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. The station goes into lockdown and the crew is endangered when an old Cardassian security program is accidentally activated.

overview.zh: 戴克斯爱上了一个快消失的人。
overview.en: Stardate: 48423.2. Dax falls in love with one of the residents of a multi-dimensional planet, while on DS9 an alien requests a holosuite program of Kira from Quark.

overview.zh: 一个马基叛军假冒名将赖克偷走了勇抗号。
overview.en: Stardate: 48467.3. The DS9 crew welcomes a visit from William Riker of the Enterprise, but the lieutenant’s hidden agenda leads to a tense standoff deep in Cardassian space.

overview.zh: 罗伊再次来找奥杜，她身上却有一重病毒能让人发情。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. As Lwaxanna Troi visits the station for a Bajoran festival, the crew is stricken with intense romantic attractions to one another.

overview.zh: 一场时空意外把本杰明, 巴舍,戴克斯三人带回地球落后的年代。
overview.en: Stardate: 48481.2. Sisko, Bashir and Dax are accidentally sent to San Francisco in the 21st century due to a transporter malfunction, and must figure out how to get back without changing the time line.

overview.zh: 本杰明必须在不改变历史的情况下回到自己的时代。
overview.en: Stardate: 48481.2. Sisko is forced to take the place of a key historical figure on Earth in 2024 in order to preserve the timeline.

overview.zh: 巴舍测试一种实验疗法强行维持住出了意外的巴瑞力生命，以让他完成心愿中的政治活动。
overview.en: Stardate: 48498.4. Dr. Bashir must use extraordinary measures to prolong Vedek Bareil's life long enough to allow Bareil to complete sensitive peace negotiations between the Bajorans and the Cardassians.

overview.zh: 卡拉跟奥杜出任务时误踩一种结晶石，把她整个人包住。
overview.en: Stardate: 48521.5. After chasing a fugitive into a cave, Kira gets stuck and is slowly encapsulated by a growing crystal stone while Odo tries to figure out how to free her.

overview.zh: 本杰明不顾预言的警示要和三个卡达西工程师一起进行虫洞通讯实验。
overview.en: Stardate: 48543.2. Sisko faces a conflict between his Starfleet duties and his role as the Bajoran Emissary when an ancient Bajoran prophecy predicts that a joint Federation-Cardassian project will lead to the destruction of the wormhole.

overview.zh: 佛瑞吉领袖纳格斯突然拜访夸克，透露他正在改写“利润守则”。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Grand Nagus Zek is acting bizarre by giving away money and rewriting the Rules of Acquisition. Quark attempts to get the old Nagus back.

overview.zh: 奥布赖恩在时空意外中来到罗慕兰和克林贡同盟管理太空站的一个平行世界。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. While a Romulan delegation tries to get information about the Dominion, O'Brien gets visions of unpleasant things that are about to happen in the future.

overview.zh: 一种心灵攻击使巴舍年龄加快老化。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. After being attacked in the infirmary, Dr. Bashir has a dual mystery on his hands: what has happened to the station while he was out and why is he aging so rapidly now?

overview.zh: 本杰明被镜像宇宙的奥布赖恩绑走，要他拯救那个世界。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Sisko is kidnapped to impersonate his deceased, mirror universe self to gain Jennifer Sisko's loyalty in the Rebel Alliance.

overview.zh: 加拉克的裁缝店爆炸, 奥杜展开调查。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. After an attempt is made on Garak's life, Odo conducts the investigation on who tried to murder the Cardassian tailor - and why.

overview.zh: 加拉克对奥杜逼供。同时间卡达西和罗慕伦的秘密联军意图前往攻打自治同盟总部。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Now rejoined with his former mentor, Garak is ordered to interrogate Odo about the secrets of his people, while the joined Romulan/Cardassian attack fleet moves towards the Founders' home world on a mission of destruction.

overview.zh: 本杰明造了老式的贝久太阳帆宇宙船，想和杰克来一场探险之旅顺便印证历史。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Sisko rebuilds an ancient Bajoran space vessel from the blueprints, and he and Jake take the ship on a trip, attempting to prove that the ancient Bajorans went beyond their solar system without warp drive.

overview.zh: 夸克发现他妈妈违反弗朗基女性不得经商的风俗。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Quark and Rom return to the Ferengi home world because their mother has broken the law - by wearing clothes and earning profits, forbidden for women in Ferengi society.
Stardate: Unknown. News arrives that Kai Winn has also become Bajor's political leader. She asks Kira to negotiate with an old resistance friend about returning soil reclamators.

overview.zh: 达克斯利用一种仪式和所有前任宿主们的意念波重逢。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Dax asks the crew to join her Zhian'tara ritual. The memories of her former hosts will take over their bodies. Nog is preparing for Starfleet Academy.

overview.zh: 一个变形人潜入勇抗号破坏，意图掀起阿尔发象限内战，奥杜要阻止他。
overview.en: Stardate: 48959.1. The Defiant is off to show the Federation's presence to the new Tzenkethi government. While underway the ship malfunctions and Bashir is suspected of sabotage.

Season 4 of Deep Space Nine marks a major shift for the series, as it introduces a new conflict between the Federation and the Klingon Empire, sparked by the latter's distrust of the shape-shifting Founders. Worf, the former security chief of the USS Enterprise-D, joins the station's crew as Sisko's strategic operations officer, and faces challenges in his loyalty, honor, and family.

overview.zh: 克林贡突然撕毁和联邦的同盟协约。沃尔夫尝试斡旋。
overview.en: Stardate: 49011.4.  When the Klingons bring a task force to DS9, Captain Sisko sends for Starfleet's lone Klingon officer, Worf, to uncover the mysterious intentions of their presence.

overview.zh: 老年杰克用回述法讲述一段奇异冒险。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Melanie, an aspiring writer, wants to know why Jake Sisko stopped writing at 40. Jake tells how his father died in an accident and then suddenly reappeared.

overview.zh: 巴舍医生尝试研究疗法救一群叛逃的詹哈达兵摆脱白粉控制。
overview.en: Stardate: 49066.5. Bashir is asked to help a group of renegade Jem'Hadar break their addiction to ketracel white. Meanwhile Worf is dissatisfied with the way Odo runs security.

overview.zh: 卡拉和杜卡被迫一起出一趟寻人任务。但是背后杜卡却隐瞒一个陈年秘密。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Kira and Gul Dukat go after the lost prison ship Ravinok. Dukat has a secret. Meanwhile Kasidy Yates tries to find work near Bajor, leaving Sisko uncomfortable.

overview.zh: 达克斯遇到另一个前任宿主的情人。该人也是一个宿主并且这一世同为女性。
overview.en: Stardate: 49195.5. Lenara Kahn, the new host of the wife of Dax's former host Torias, comes to the station. While they're not allowed to renew their relation, there's still a spark.

overview.zh: 夸克,罗姆和诺格的船出了时空意外坠毁在1947年的新墨西哥罗斯威尔。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Quark and Rom take Nog to Earth and Starfleet Academy, but a malfunction with the ship takes the crew back in time, to Roswell New Mexico in 1947.

overview.zh: 挑战者号中了圈套被迫在星云中迎战詹哈达。
overview.en: Stardate: 49263.5. A damaged Defiant must play a dangerous game of cat-and-mouse with two Jem'hadar ships inside a gas giant.

overview.zh: 沃尔夫、戴克斯遇到一位老克林贡战士, 一起出发寻找传说中的圣剑以重新团结克林贡帝国。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Worf, Dax and the Klingon Dahar master Kor set out to find an ancient lost relic: the Sword of Kahless.

overview.zh: 巴舍医生在玩 1960年代的间谍游戏全象甲板 却突然出了意外被困其中。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. When an transporter emergency turns the command crew into holosuite characters, Bashir's James Bond fantasy takes on a deadly reality.

overview.zh: 本杰明和奥杜回地球调查变形人渗透星舰总部的情形。
overview.en: Stardate: 49170.65. Sisko travels to Earth when a bombing at a Federation conference is determined to be the work of Changelings.

overview.zh: 本杰明发现星联中的鹰派意图利用自治同盟战争的借口夺取政治利益。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. When Starfleet institutes martial law to combat the Changeling Menace, Sisko begins to question if the Dominion is the real threat.

overview.zh: 奥杜发现贝久星总统也爱上卡拉，自己只好黯然退出。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. First Minister Shakaar visits the station, despite a threat of assassination. He falls in love with Kira much to Odo's dismay.

overview.zh: 杜卡想借由卡拉帮助重新夺回他的国内地位。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Dukat returns, stripped of his prestige, to escort Kira to a Cardassian conference about the Dominion. But an attack by a Klingon raider may give Dukat a chance to redeem himself in the eyes of his government.

overview.zh: 沃尔夫的兄弟找上门，寻求一死，因为沃尔夫的背叛害家族在帝国内被批斗。
overview.en: Stardate: 49556.2. Worf's brother Kurn asks him to perform a death rite to regain his lost honor. Meanwhile Kira and O'Brien investigate Klingon activity near the Bajoran border.

overview.zh: 罗姆组织酒吧工人组成工会，对抗哥哥的资方压榨。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Unfair working conditions and pay cuts cause Rom to organize a union of the employees of Quark's Bar. Meanwhile Worf still finds it hard to settle on the station.

overview.zh: 一个两百年前的人穿越虫洞到来，并挑战本杰明的使者地位。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. A man claiming to be the emissary comes through the wormhole. Sisko is happy to give up his position. Meanwhile Keiko returns and O'Brien stops spending time with Bashir.

overview.zh: 沃尔夫被控告战争中滥杀无辜。而他坚称清白。
overview.en: Stardate: 49665.3. When Worf destroys a civilian shuttle during an engagement with the Klingons, an extradition hearing is held to see if he must face charges.

overview.zh: 奥布赖恩误触一个星球的法律，脑中被植入自己坐了20年牢的假记忆当惩罚。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. O'Brien tries to re-integrate to life on the station after serving 20 years in a virtual prison.

overview.zh: 本杰明被镜像宇宙的人设计扯入他们的战争。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. When the Mirror Universe counterpart of Sisko's deceased wife lures Jake to the other side, Sisko must follow and help the human resistance against the Alliance's forces.

overview.zh: 杰克被一个能心灵控制灌输写作灵感的外星人迷惑。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. A mysterious woman approaches Jake about his future as a writer. Odo promises to do whatever it takes to help Lwaxana Troi keep her baby over the father's wishes - even if it means marrying her himself.

overview.zh: 本杰明怀疑他的新女友是马基叛军的卧底。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Sisko must face betrayal when evidence surfaces that Kasidy is smuggling for the Maquis. Meanwhile Garak makes acquaintance with Ziyal.

overview.zh: 本杰明和勇抗号组员被迫与一队詹哈达军合作打击叛变的詹哈达。
overview.en: Stardate: 49904.2. A renegade group of Jem'Hadar plunders Deep Space Nine. Sisko agrees to a combat operation with loyal Jem'Hadar to prevent the renegades completing a planetary gateway.

overview.zh: 卡拉少校、戴克斯、巴舍医生帮助一个伽玛象限的可怜星球对抗自治同盟散布的遗传疾病。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Bashir tries to help a planet in the grips of a Dominion-engineered plague that guarantees a painful death.

overview.zh: 夸克被诊断出得绝症。他想卖掉自己骨灰让死后还能赚最后一笔。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Quarks hears on Ferenginar he is going to die. Rom convinces him to sell his remains. After an accident, Bashir has to move Keiko's baby to Kira's womb.

overview.zh: 奥杜被族人抓住, 审判他杀死同类的罪。
overview.en: Stardate: 49962.4. Odo is suddenly struck by illness. He is barely able to hold shape. Bashir and Odo see no other alternative then going to the Founders. Garak wants to come along.

Season 5 of Deep Space Nine begins the Dominion War arc that will dominate the rest of the show. The Federation and its allies face a new enemy in the form of the Cardassian-Dominion alliance, which threatens to conquer the Alpha Quadrant.

overview.zh: 本杰明等人渗透进克林贡首都抓出变形人假冒的内奸。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. With the war between Klingons and Federation intensifying, Sisko must make a plan to expose Gowron as a changeling. Odo is still having trouble with becoming a solid.

overview.zh: 一艘詹哈达的船坠毁后被本杰明寻获。
overview.en: Stardate: 50049.3. The crew find a crashed Jem’Hadar ship and work to repair it and capture it for the Federation, but are confronted by a Dominion force determined to recover the ship’s cargo.

name.en: Looking for par'Mach in All the Wrong Places

overview.zh: 沃尔夫追求夸克的前妻失败，却发现戴克斯爱上他。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. While Worf helps Quark to pursue his former wife Grilka, O'Brien and Kira grow uncomfortably close to each other.

name.en: Nor the Battle to the Strong

overview.zh: 杰克在一次战地记者经验中学习战争的残酷。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Jake, reporting from the front lines, sees what war truly is.

overview.zh: 奥布赖恩的太太被先知族的远古死敌恶魔附身。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. An alien entity has possessed Keiko's body and is holding it hostage until O'Brien completes an assignment for it.

overview.zh: 本杰明和组员被时间宝球带回到柯克舰长时代找一枚炸弹。(星旅系列30年特别节目)
overview.en: Stardate: 4523.7. In this celebration of the 30th anniversary of The Original Series, the disgraced Klingon spy Darvin travels back in time to undo his century-old defeat by James Kirk. The DS9 crew must track him down and stop him, while blending in with the crew of the original Enterprise NCC-1701.

name.en: Let He Who Is Without Sin...

overview.zh: 一个卫道人士认为联邦度假胜地理沙星让人变得放纵又软弱。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. While vacationing on Risa, Worf and Dax meet a group of fundamentalist protesters who claim that the Federation has gone soft.

overview.zh: 本杰明, 奥杜, 戴克斯, 加拉克四人突然穿梭时空回到占领时期的DS9。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Sisko, Dax, Odo and Garak find themselves in the past when the Cardassians controlled the station, and a crime that Odo investigated may be the key.

overview.zh: 夸克和奥杜坠毁在荒星，要合力爬一座超级高山去发出求救讯号。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. When Odo and Quark crash land, they must put aside their differences to climb a mountain to signal for help. Jake and Nog try to be roommates, but their different styles clash.

overview.zh: 一次意外导致本杰明有看见未来的能力。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. After a brain injury, Sisko begins experiencing powerful visions through time. He dives fully into the role of the Emissary, while becoming obsessed with finding a legendary Bajoran ruin.

overview.zh: 卡拉上校的反抗军旧日朋友一个个被杀。
overview.en: Stardate: 50416.2. A mysterious assassin begins wiping out all the members of Kira's old resistance cell.

overview.zh: 夸克找到一个变形人婴儿, 把他卖给奥杜扶养。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. The discovery of an infant Changeling gives Odo a chance to put right the trauma of his own upbringing, while his “father” Dr. Mora insists on a more clinical approach.

overview.zh: 爱丁顿突然回来攻击，本杰明狂热于复仇式的追捕他。
overview.en: Stardate: 50485.2. When the traitorous Eddington returns, Sisko will go to any lengths to capture him.

overview.zh: 沃尔夫和加拉克一起在伽玛象限追踪一个可疑的卡达西信号。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. A coded message from the Gamma Quadrant leads Garak to believe his mentor, Enabran Tain, is still alive. He and Worf seek him out, only to discover something much worse: a Dominion invasion fleet poised to attack the Alpha Quadrant.

overview.zh: 杜卡让卡达西加入自治同盟。 同时站上还被变形人内奸入侵。
overview.en: Stardate: 50564.2. The station readies for a Dominion attack. Worf and Garak meet some unexpected friends in a Dominion Prison camp.

overview.zh: 巴舍医师被选为医疗全象程式的范本却意外揭开他的秘密。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Dr. Bashir is selected to be the model for the next-generation of Emergency Medical Hologram (EMH). But he balks when his parents are invited to the station to be interviewed by the EMH programmer, Dr. Zimmerman. There is a dark secret in his family that he's afraid that his parents will reveal.

overview.zh: 奥杜爱上一个猎户座海盗团的女子。
overview.en: Odo helps a woman hiding on the station from organized criminals, but quickly develops a personal interest in the case.

overview.zh: 夸克开始作军火生意却面临良心谴责。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Quark must wrestle with his conscience when he becomes involved with arms merchants.

overview.zh: 吉墨到达太空站并告知患了绝症来日无多。
overview.en: Stardate: 50712.2. When a Cardassian official that thinks of Kira as his daughter is dying, he agrees to reveal all he knows to her. But the experience dredges up Kira's memories of her own father's death.

overview.zh: 夸克发现他妈妈的秘密情人。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Quark doesn't know whether to be panicked or overjoyed when he learns that his mother is the new lover of the Grand Nagus.

overview.zh: 马土克、沃尔夫和戴克斯前往指挥一艘克林贡战鸟。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Dax and Worf accompany Martok on his first command since being held by the Dominion. But the ship they are given hasn't seen victory in months and the crew is near mutinous.

overview.zh: 宇宙异象让勇抗号上的西斯可等人看见自己200年后的后代子孙。
overview.en: Stardate: 50814.2. The DS9 crew discovers a colony that, due to a time travel accident, turns out to be inhabited by the crew's own descendants.

overview.zh: 马基叛军想把联邦卷入对卡达西战争中。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Sisko learns that the Maquis are planning a devastating attack on Cardassia, and must rely on the traitor Eddington to help him prevent it.

overview.zh: 奥布赖恩带一队人去DS9的废弃姊妹站找零件,却被不明生物追杀。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. While salvaging components from DS9's sister station, the crew run afoul of a "surprise" left behind by the Cardassians.

overview.zh: 杰克想送本杰明一张古董棒球卡却意外激励了站上全部士气。
overview.en: Stardate: 50929.4. Jake has his heart set on a vintage Willie Mays baseball card as a present to cheer up his father, whose spirits are flagging from the ongoing conflict.

overview.zh: 自治同盟全面入侵阿尔发象限，本杰明想用地雷阵封住虫洞出口.
overview.en: Stardate: 50975.2. Sisko decides to mine the wormhole to prevent further Dominion ships crossing into the Alpha Quadrant. This provokes an attack by the Dominion and the Cardassians, and a desperate last stand on Deep Space Nine.

Season 6 of Deep Space Nine marks the height of the Dominion War arc, as it depicts the Federation and its allies in a desperate struggle against the Cardassian-Dominion alliance, which has occupied Deep Space Nine and the Bajoran system.

overview.zh: 全面开战后三个月,联邦损失甚大而DS9却还是在自治同盟控制下。 本杰明西斯可将军决定深入敌后摧毁自治同盟后勤白粉工厂。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. As the war between the Federation and the Dominion continues, Sisko and his crew are reassigned from the Defiant, while Kira and Odo cope with the bureaucracy of the station's occupation.

overview.zh: 本杰明组员坠毁在一星球上遇到另一群也坠毁的詹哈达军。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Sisko and his crew are marooned on a barren planet with a squadron of Jem'Hadar soldiers and their wounded Vorta overseer. But when the Vorta seeks out Sisko to make a deal, can he be trusted? And should Sisko accept the treacherous proposal?

overview.zh: 沃尔夫的儿子突然出现在他战舰上的补充兵之列。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Worf and his son Alexander must come to terms with one another when Alexander is assigned to the Rotarran and voices his intentions to become a warrior. Meanwhile, Kira finds herself between friend and foe when Ziyal returns to the station and reconciles with her father.

overview.zh: 本杰明有一大胆计划攻破自治同盟的侦测阵列, 站上的卡拉小组同时也在寻求敌后破坏的机会。
overview.en: Stardate: 51145.3. Odo finds his priorities at odds with Kira's resistance efforts when the Female Changeling comes to him and offers to guide him in learning about the Great Link.

overview.zh: 自治同盟一千架战舰要穿过虫洞杀来,本杰明要拟定作战计划趁地雷阵被破解之前攻下DS9。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. On the eve of Dukat successfully disabling the minefield, Sisko coordinates a massive assault to retake Deep Space Nine.

overview.zh: 本杰明坐镇勇抗号率领600 艘星联大舰队配合卡拉的敌后破坏一举进攻DS9。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. The Federation's only hope of stopping massive Dominion reinforcements from entering the Alpha Quadrant relies on Sisko's suicide mission to reach DS9 before the minefield is destroyed.

overview.zh: 沃尔夫和戴克斯的婚礼要举行了，却受到习俗不同的破坏。
overview.en: Stardate: 51247.5. Dax and Worf find their wedding plans threatened when Martok's wife challenges Jadzia's worthiness to be admitted into their house.

overview.zh: 镜像宇宙的卡拉少校爱人巴瑞力的分身人意外来到, 让她回忆起往日情怀 却正掉进一个大阴谋。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Kira finds herself falling in love with the mirror-universe version of Bareil, who has crossed the reality plane to begin a new life.

overview.zh: 巴舍医生带领一群跟自己一样的基因改造人做治疗，想让他们学以致用，开始成为星联的战略智库。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Bashir agrees to counsel a group of eccentric, genetically enhanced humans ... and finds himself reevaluating his own enhanced nature when they calculate a disastrous prediction for the outcome of the Dominion War.

overview.zh: 夸克母亲被自治同盟意外抓走, 他召集一支佛瑞吉人的杂牌军前往营救。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. When Quark and Rom's mother is abducted by the Dominion, the two brothers recruit an all-Ferengi team to embark on a dangerous mission to get her back.

overview.zh: 本杰明押送杜卡的途中被攻击, 两人流落荒星，杜卡开始面对他内心的审判。
overview.en: Stardate: 51408.6. After being attacked by Cardassian forces, Sisko gets stranded with a very psychotic Gul Dukat, who was being transported to his trial. Meanwhile the crew of the Defiant races to rescue survivors.

overview.zh: 酒吧常客莫恩突然意外死亡却把遗产都留给夸克。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. A former patron of Quark's bequeaths everything to him.

overview.zh: 本杰明突然昏倒看见幻象，自己化身在1950年代的美国是个被种族歧视的作家，而DS9的所有故事不过是他的小说。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Captain Sisko has a full sensory vision of himself as an under-appreciated science fiction magazine writer in 1950s America.

overview.zh: 戴克斯 奥布赖恩 巴舍三人调查宇宙空间压缩异象时被压缩成10公分的小人，此时勇抗号却被詹哈达攻击。
overview.en: Stardate: 51474.2. An attack by the Dominion on Sisko's ship endangers Dax and her crew aboard as she leads them into an anomaly that shrinks them to a very minute size. Unfortunately, they were being held stable by Sisko within a tractor beam, which was discontinued during the attack.

overview.zh: 奥布赖恩被星联情报局临时征召，去猎户座海盗团卧底。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Chief O'Brien goes undercover to infiltrate an Orion crime ring.

overview.zh: 戴克斯和沃尔夫去接应一个关键情报在手的卡达西内奸。途中戴克斯却受重伤危急到任务。
overview.en: Stardate: 51597.2. Worf and Jadzia travel to the badlands to procure some information on the Dominion from a traitorous Cardassian. Bashir wants to engage in a holo-suite spy simulation, but O'Brien prefers to brush up on his tongo game after watching Jadzia lose to Quark.

name.en: Wrongs Darker Than Death or Night

overview.zh: 杜卡告知卡拉，她妈妈当年也是叛国贼之一还成为他的情妇，卡拉决意调查。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. After receiving some disturbing information from Gul Dukat, Major Kira seeks Sisko's approval as Emissary to travel back in time to find out the truth about her mother. Meanwhile, Chief O'Brien and Dr. Bashir discuss a holosuite program surrounding the Battle of the Alamo.

overview.zh: 巴舍医生突然被控告是内奸。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Dr. Bashir's plans to attend a medical conference at a breezy resort are canceled when Starfleet Intelligence boards DS9, suspecting the doctor of treason.

overview.zh: 本杰明无法忍受星联持续的战争挫败和死伤，决定联合加拉克设奸计把罗慕伦人卷入战争。
overview.en: Stardate: 51721.3. To save the Federation in a critical scheme, Sisko comes to realize that he must violate its fundamental principles to do so.

overview.zh: 巴舍医生展示了他的新全象程式人物一个60年代的赌城歌手伏塔尼，该人物真实到比人还懂人生。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Odo is schooled in the ways of romance by a holographic programmed lounge singer.

overview.zh: 本杰明发现的一块贝久远古记事板引发一位先知族和一位古代恶魔的决斗。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Sisko runs afoul of Kai Winn when he removes a Bajoran artifact from an archaeological dig after he receives a vision from the Prophets.

overview.zh: 杰克和诺格意外中上了一条勇抗级星舰英勇号，发现上面全是星舰学院精英学生会在驾驶。
overview.en: Stardate: 51825.4. Jake and Nog's runabout comes under attack from the Jem'Hadar. They are rescued by the Valiant, a ship manned by Red Squad, a elite group of young Starfleet cadets.

overview.zh: 夸克要帮助那格斯和妈妈一起改革弗伦基人的传统。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Quark's mother and the Grand Nagus show up on DS9, announcing a new amendment to the Bill of Opportunities he has instituted on the home planet of Ferenganar, and then follows up with the announcement, that, due to the new amendment, chaos has followed and he has been deposed.

overview.zh: 奥布赖恩的8岁小女儿误触一个时间机器被送回蛮荒时代。回来时已经大了10岁且变成野人
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. The Chief's daughter gets caught in a time displacement and when they get her back, she is considerably older.

overview.zh: 勇抗号接到失踪已久的大使级奥林帕斯号舰长丽莎在荒星发出的求救讯号。
overview.en: Stardate: 51948.3. As the Defiant races to a shipwrecked officer who is days away, the crew keeps in contact with her. Meanwhile, Jake follows Quark's latest scheme for story research.

overview.zh: 星舰总部决定改变防御战略主动进攻自治同盟，戴克斯被杀害。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. When Sisko is picked to head up an attack on the Cardassian homeworld, the Prophets appear to him in a vision, warning him of impending doom if he leaves the station.

Season 7 of Deep Space Nine marks the end of the series, as it concludes the Dominion War arc and the saga of the characters and their relationships. The Federation and its allies face the final showdown with the Cardassian-Dominion alliance, which is aided by the Breen. Sisko and his crew must also deal with the threat of the pah-wraiths, the evil counterparts of the Prophets, who are unleashed by Kai Winn and Dukat.

overview.zh: 本杰明在地球踏上内心寻找之旅，卡拉升为上校暂管太空站，但此时罗慕伦却想利用同盟关系在贝久附近建立基地。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. As Kira begins working with a Romulan presence aboard the station, Sisko looks for answers in a vision he receives from the Prophets, leading him to uncover a family secret.

overview.zh: 本杰明找到了另一个先知族宝球，而此时卡拉上校却要和罗慕伦人开战。
overview.en: Stardate: 52152.6. As Sisko searches for the Orb of the Emissary, Kira prepares a blockade opposing the Romulans near the Bajoran moon Durna. Meanwhile, Worf and Martok lead a suicide mission in Jadzia's name.

overview.zh: 艾丝蕊‧戴克斯回到站上却受困于人际关系的难题。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Ezri Dax finds difficulty in trying to settle into a new life, as Jadzia's memories and relationships provide her with one emotional challenge after another.

name.en: Take Me Out to the Holosuite

overview.zh: 本杰明的瓦肯老友组织一个棒球队前来挑战。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Sisko is challenged by a Vulcan captain to a competitive match in an Earth game of skill known as ... baseball.

overview.zh: 巴舍医生看似治好了一个基因改造人
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Bashir begins falling in love with a genetically engineered patient whom he helped bring out of her state of introversion.

name.en: Treachery, Faith, and the Great River

overview.zh: 一个沃塔突然联络奥杜说要投诚。而奥布赖恩则陷于一个工作大麻烦。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. A clone of Weyoun seeking asylum submits himself to Odo as a prisoner, offering invaluable information about the Dominion.

overview.zh: 沃尔夫陪一个老克林贡勇士走上人生最后的战役。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. With nowhere to turn and old age having made him obsolete, Klingon legend Kor asks Worf to help him find one last glorious battle.

overview.zh: 本杰明指挥勇抗号去AR-558星球帮一个联邦前线热战点运补，却刚好遇到詹哈达兵大举进攻。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Sisko's crew is diverted to the front lines, where, alongside war-torn Starfleet officers, they must make a stand against a Jem'Hadar assault.

overview.zh: 杜卡修好了废弃太空站并在那创立了一个拜远古恶魔的贝久邪教，并绑架了卡拉。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Kira is kidnapped by a Bajoran Pah-wraith cult led by Dukat.

overview.zh: 诺格装了义肢后回来，但还是无法逃离战场阴影，他开始躲在生活大师软件中逃避现实。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Mentally and emotionally scarred by his combat injuries, Nog seeks comfort in the holographic fantasy world of Vic Fontaine.

overview.zh: 艾丝蕊的家族是矿业钜擘。她为了寻找失踪的奥布赖恩不得不拜托家族势力，却也扯入一个秘密。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. A search for O'Brien, who has gone missing somewhere near Ezri's home world, reunites Ezri with her family and their troubles.

overview.zh: 夸克和罗姆进入镜像宇宙去救那格斯大王。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. The Grand Nagus goes missing in the mirror universe, leading Quark and Rom on a mission to track him down.

overview.zh: 有人在站上用狙击枪远距离乱杀人，艾丝蕊被命令展开调查。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. A murder investigation prompts Ezri to confront the repressed memories of Joran, a former Dax host who had killed three people.

overview.zh: 奥度找到了另一个百人队的探索成员，但是那人的价值观完全不同。
overview.en: Stardate: 51474.2. A shapeshifter, one of "the hundred" sent from the Link centuries ago to explore the galaxy, tries to convince Odo to abandon his life as a humanoid in favor of a grander quest.

overview.zh: 原作者在生活大师软件中暗埋的彩蛋剧情突然展开，他的酒店被一个虚拟黑道老大抢走。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. A surprise programming feature brings mobsters to take over Vic's lounge, leading the DS9 crew to devise a plan to get rid of them.

overview.zh: 31号部门又找上巴舍医生参与一个对罗慕兰的阴谋。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. When the mysterious Sloan attempts to recruit Bashir for an undercover mission on Romulus, Sisko orders Bashir to go along with the plan, in hopes of learning more about Section 31.

overview.zh: 艾丝蕊擅自去找战场上失踪的沃尔夫，却因为前世记忆导致两人意外的发展。
overview.en: Stardate: 52576.2. While Ezri goes searching for Worf, who has been missing since a Dominion attack on his ship, Sisko proposes marriage to Kasidy and begins plans to build a house on Bajor.

overview.zh: 布林人突然不明原因抓住艾丝蕊和沃尔夫，另一方面杜卡整型成贝久人以进行一项秘密计划。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Sisko must decide whether to oppose the Prophets and marry Kasidy. Meanwhile, Dukat comes to DS9 with a Bajoran identity and a plan to manipulate Kai Winn; and Worf and Ezri are held captive by the Breen.

overview.zh: 自治同盟突然和布林人结盟，联邦陷入大危机。艾丝蕊和沃尔夫则快被处死。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. A new alliance between the Dominion and the Breen further appalls Damar. Meanwhile, Winn finds her spirituality thrown into chaos when she has a vision from the Pah-wraiths.

overview.zh: 自治同盟攻下钱度卡星系后战局对联邦转趋不利, 此时混入贝久的杜卡也使凯王温著了魔道。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. As Winn begins studying her uncertain role in following the path of the Pah-wraiths, the Federation engages in battle for the first time against the Dominion and their new Breen allies.

overview.zh: 本杰明指派卡拉和加拉克去支援卡达西内部的叛乱革命。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. As Kira leads a mission to help organize Damar's resistance forces, Bashir learns that Odo has been infected with the disease sweeping through the Great Link.

overview.zh: 沃尔夫发现克林贡皇帝的私心决定采取反制。卡拉的反抗军决定劫下一艘布林改装战舰以破解新武器的秘密。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. As tensions mount within Kira and Damar's resistance cell, Worf realizes he must take action to prevent Gowron from making a key strategic mistake.

overview.zh: 巴舍和奥布赖恩必须诱捕一个31区干员以逼问出救奥度的解药。
overview.en: Stardate: 52645.7. Bashir and O'Brien capture Sloan and probe his mind in a search for the cure to Odo's disease.

overview.zh: 夸克突然有机会被选为那格斯大王，此时卡拉和加拉克的敌后革命军却被出卖全歼。
overview.en: Stardate: 52861.3. With the Cardassian resistance movement crushed, Kira, Damar, and Garak find themselves trapped behind enemy lines. Meanwhile, Grand Nagus Zek announces his retirement and plans to name Quark his successor.

overview.zh: 杜卡准备释放远古恶魔；此时本杰明率领三国联军与自治同盟展开大决战，而卡拉和加拉克的敌后革命也正要发动，阿尔发象限的命运正迎向最后关键。
overview.en: Stardate: 52902.0. As the war careens toward a final showdown on Cardassia, Sisko's definitive action as the Emissary draws near.

overview.zh:
《星际迷航：航海家号》是《星际迷航》系列剧中的第五部，其剧情发生在其《星际迷航：深空九号》之后《星际迷航：复仇女神》之前。

星历48038.5（公元2371年），联邦星舰航海家号在凯瑟琳·珍妮薇舰长的指挥下起航，她接到的第一个任务是寻找一艘在天棘区失踪的马奇游击队飞船，不料同游击队一起被名为”守护者“的外星生命体传送至银河系的另一端——德尔塔象限中。在此之间，航海家号失去了一些船员，其中包括大副、舵手、轮机长及所有的医护人员。

”守护者“死后，为了阻止贪得无厌的外星人占据传送阵列，进攻原本处在”守护者“呵护下的奥康帕人，珍妮薇舰长下令摧毁了传送阵列……

为了返回阿尔法象限，舰队军官们与游击队通力合作，开始七万光年、七十五年的回家旅程。马奇船的舰长查可泰成为了航海家号的大副。人类与克林贡混血儿贝拉娜·朵芮丝成为了主轮机长。杜沃克卸掉了潜藏在马奇船中的星际舰队间谍的伪装，恢复了他作为总安全官的职务。前囚犯汤姆·派瑞斯成为了舵手，而紧急医疗全息程序成为了主医官。

在第四象限，航海家号还接受了泰莱克斯人尼利克斯和他的奥康帕女朋友凯丝也作为本地的向导与厨师登舰。在第四季中，船员中还增加了一名从集合体中解放出的博格个体九之七。

对于星际联邦来说，第四象限是全然未知的领域。在回家的途中，航海家号遭遇了一系列的敌对种族，其中有盗取器官的维汀人、好战的卡松人、游牧的希罗吉恩猎手、博格人与来自液态空间的8472种族。同样，他们也遭遇了许多危险的宇宙异象
overview.en: Pulled to the far side of the galaxy, where the Federation is 75 years away at maximum warp speed, a Starfleet ship must cooperate with Maquis rebels to find a way home.
Pulled to the far side of the galaxy, where the Federation is 75 years away at maximum warp speed, a Starfleet ship must cooperate with Maquis rebels to find a way home.

overview.zh:
凯瑟琳·珍妮薇上校接到星际舰队指挥部的命令，指挥最新型星舰航海家号，前往天棘区寻找一艘数日前失踪的马奇游击队飞船，珍妮薇的安全官杜沃克在这艘飞船上卧底。临行前珍妮薇还从监狱里保释一名囚犯——派里斯上将之子汤姆·派里斯，当航海家号抵达天棘区后，意外地被一股强大的力量拖拽到七万光年以外的德尔塔象限。

失去了舵手、医疗官和大副的航海家号在德尔塔象限找到了失踪的马奇飞船，并得知将他们拖到此处的是一个叫做守护者的生物，守护者不久之后死亡，为防止当地残暴不堪的凯松人利用守护者的设施对银河系造成威胁，珍妮薇舰长与马奇游击队联手，毅然决然地炸毁了他们回家的唯一希望——守护者的太空站。为了重返地球，马奇游击队与星际舰队通力合作，由查克泰担任大副，汤姆·派里斯担任舵手，贝拉娜·朵芮斯担任轮机长，紧急全息医疗程序担任医疗官，并在流浪者尼利克斯和其女友凯丝的帮助下，航海家号踏上了返回地球的漫长旅程。
overview.en: Stardate: 48315.6. The USS Voyager, led by Captain Kathryn Janeway, is sent into the dangerous Badlands in pursuit of a Maquis ship, only for both ships to find themselves 70,000 light years from home in the uncharted Delta Quadrant.

overview.zh: 被困于德尔塔象限的航海家号船员面临重新调配，查克泰推荐自己的船员贝拉娜·朵芮斯担任轮机长，但她因为天生的暴脾气和其他人相处不融洽（时不时打断别人鼻子），令珍妮薇不得不暂缓工作调配。航海家号途经一处黑洞时，接受到不明飞船的求救信号，珍妮薇下令前往黑洞附近展开救援，但船员们不仅没有发现所谓的遇难飞船，反倒是航海家号自己被困在了黑洞的视界之中。为了脱困，珍妮薇和贝拉娜一同驾驶穿梭机为航海家号引导方向，这给了珍妮薇检验贝拉娜实力的一个机会。
overview.en: Stardate: 48439.7. As the Maquis crewmembers begin to integrate themselves into the Starfleet crew, Voyager becomes trapped in a quantum singularity.

overview.zh: 凯瑟琳·珍妮薇舰长与汤姆·派里斯一同前往一颗不久前被神秘毁灭的星球上进行调查，不料被一个异常的时间乱流带到了过去，经过调查发现，原来一群示威者将企图引爆一家能源站以示抗议，不料意外触发连锁反应造成整个星球文明的灭亡，珍妮薇舰长必须和时间赛跑，抢救未来。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. After being hit by the shockwave of a devastating planet-wide explosion, Voyager investigates. While on the surface, Janeway and Paris are accidentally 'shifted' one day into the past.

overview.zh: 尼利克斯在一颗星球上进行侦查时遇到意外袭击，一个长期受一种微生物腐蚀的种族——维汀人为了替换自己衰竭的器官而偷走了他的肺，在医生的全力救治下，尼利克斯依靠一个全息肺活了下来，但为了让他能恢复，珍妮薇舰长下命令全力抓捕那群器官盗贼。
overview.en: Stardate: 48532.4. During an away mission, Neelix is attacked and his lungs are surgically removed. His only hope for survival is if the crew of Voyager can get them back.

overview.zh: 航海家号进入了一片星云以收集 θ 粒子作为燃料，后来却发现这片星云是一个活的有机体，而他们的收集过程损害了这个生命体的身体结构，凯瑟琳接受医生的建议，冒险用航海家号船身作针给其作缝合术。
overview.en: Stardate: 48546.2. Janeway tries to figure out what her dynamic with the crew should be while all stuck in the Delta Quadrant together. Voyager tries to harvest omicron particles to refuel the ship, but inadvertently injures a spacefaring organism.

overview.zh: 船员们意外发现了一处通往阿尔法象限的微型虫洞，并成功同另一端的一艘太空船取得联系，但他们很快意识到同他们联系上的是星际联邦的大敌——罗慕伦人。但是后来罗慕伦人同意传送到航海家号上，与此同时，人们发现那个罗慕伦人来自20年以前。珍妮薇把所有船员的信交给了他，叮嘱她20年以后把它们交给航海家号船员的家人。
overview.en: Stardate: 48579.4. The discovery of a wormhole leading to the Alpha Quadrant elates the crew, however, their only contact within range is a skeptical and paranoid Romulan.

overview.zh: 汤姆·派里斯在外星球拜访一位知名人士时，陷入了一场谋杀指控中，而所有的证据都指向了派里斯，派里斯的刑罚则是，在他的大脑中每隔几个小时重放一遍受害者的死前记忆，杜沃克必须在派里斯被刑罚弄到神志不清之前证明他的清白。当杜沃克束手无策时，他意外发现他还遗漏了一位重要的证人。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Tom Paris is accused of a murder he claims he did not commit. His sentence is to re-live the last few moments of his victim's life every 14 hours through a memory transplant.

overview.zh: 航海家号在一颗小行星内部发现了一种新的元素，当他们传送到其内部查看时才发现这里原来是一座墓地，那种新元素是尸体腐化的产物，为了不打扰逝者，查克泰等人打算离开，但是临走之前，一种异常的空间泡现象吸走了哈里·金，他被传送到了一颗深信转世说星球上的棺材里，而棺材里原有的“尸体”则被传送到航海家号上，原来那个空间异常便是所谓的转世，而哈里被当地人当成了“从另一个世界回来的人”为了尽快返回航海家号，哈里和船员们两头分工，试图揭开转世之谜。
overview.en: Stardate: 48623.5. A transporter accident swaps Harry Kim with a dying woman from another dimension. Harry finds himself among aliens who believe he’s returned from their afterlife, while the woman, expecting paradise, wakes up on the Voyager.

overview.zh: 一个种族拥有能让航海家号更快速回家的传送科技，但他们却不愿分享。在轮机员瑟斯卡的怂恿下，贝拉娜·朵芮斯违反最高指导原则，偷出那台传送器，却失望地发现它与航海家号设备不兼容。
overview.en: Stardate: 48642.5. The Voyager crew are offered luxurious shore leave by the advanced and gregarious Sikarians, who have a device that could send Voyager 40,000 light years closer to home. However, Sikarian law strictly prohibits sharing their technology with others.

overview.zh: 航海家号接收到来自卡松飞船的求救信号，船员登舰后惊讶地发现所有卡松船员的身体都和船上甲板融合到了一起，仅有一人生还。朵芮斯还在卡松飞船上发现了来自星际联邦的合金成分，杜沃克怀疑有人暗中将航海家号上的设备交给了卡松人，珍妮薇下令让轮机组想办法回收那艘卡松飞船上的数据面板。瑟斯卡少尉违背朵瑞斯的命令，用极其冒险的方式回收卡松飞船的控制面板，结果遭到失败。医生和凯丝在治疗时发现瑟斯卡其实是卡达西人。朵芮斯成功回收卡松飞船上的控制面板，分析表明，爆炸源头来自卡松飞船上一台试图进行改装的食物复制机，而且其中的零件来自航海家号上。再也无可置疑了，航海家号上出现了叛徒。查克泰、朵芮斯、杜沃克几个人一块设局，试图让叛徒现出原形……
overview.en: Stardate: 48658.2. When stolen Federation technology is found on a severely damaged Kazon Nistrim ship, Seska becomes the prime suspect. The evidence is further reinforced when questions arise regarding her true heritage.

overview.zh: 金哈里在全息甲板上体验史诗《贝奥武夫》时离奇失踪，随后去寻找他的杜沃克和查克泰也意外失踪，贝拉娜调查认为全息甲板上存在一处故障，会把所有接触该区域的人从物质转化成能量。为了救出三名船员，大家把希望放在了唯一不会变成能量的人——医生身上，于是，医生开始了他的第一次“外遣”任务，然而发现的结果却令他大吃一惊，有一种光子生物进入了航海家号。医生放出了先前捕捉到的生物，所有人都得救了。
overview.en: Stardate: 48693.2. Harry Kim disappears from the holodeck during his holo-novel, "Beowulf." According to the characters, he died at the hands of a mystical beast known as "Grendel". When Chakotay and Tuvok also disappear, the Doctor is transferred to the holodeck to investigate.

overview.zh: 一个“外星人”控制了船员们的身体，而查可泰在他的穿梭机被攻击后进入脑死亡状态。
overview.en: Stardate: 48734.2. After Chakotay and Tuvok are injured in a shuttle accident, a non-corporeal life form begins to wreak havoc on Voyager by infiltrating the minds of the crew and altering the ship's systems one by one.

overview.zh: 贝拉娜·朵芮斯被维汀人分成了人类和克林贡纯血统的两个人，用来研制一款新疫苗。她们决定齐心合力逃出去。但是克林贡纯血统的贝拉娜战死了。
overview.en: Stardate: 48784.2. The Vidiians capture Paris, Torres and Durst while on an away mission. Torres is taken to a lab and 'split' into two people: one human, and one Klingon.

overview.zh: 与泰莱克斯人爆发种族战争的哈康尼亚人的一员找到了航海家号，这让尼利克斯感到不安，因为他的家人都是被哈康尼亚人杀害的。
overview.en: Stardate: 48832.1. The inventor of a weapon that slaughtered Neelix’s people contacts Neelix to warn of a fatal disease he may have contracted as a side effect.

overview.zh: 杜沃克训练了一群未有完全融入航海家号集体的马奇游击队成员。
overview.en: Stardate: 48846.5. In order to bring some rebellious Maquis crewmembers into line, Tuvok gives them a Starfleet Academy crash course. Meanwhile, the crew investigate a series of failures affecting the Voyager’s bio-neural systems.
Capt. Janeway and her crew encounter the Kazon and other new Delta Quadrant enemies as they continue the long, perilous journey back to Earth.

overview.zh: 航海家号在航行中发现不明来源的铁锈，经过调查，他们意外发现了一辆漂浮在德尔塔象限的福特1937皮卡，珍妮薇认为一定是有什么人将其带到德尔塔象限，这也许能为他们找到一条回家的捷径。而汤姆·派里斯在调试车载老式收音机时，接收到一段古老的SOS信号，航海家号追踪源头到了一颗星球上，却发现从地球来的不只是一辆老爷车、一段神秘的讯号，还有群来自1937年地球、被封冻数百年的人类——其中包括失踪的著名女飞行员阿米莉亚·伊尔哈特。这里已经有了一个新的人类文明，航海家号不得不决定是走还是留……
overview.en: Stardate: 48975.1. The crew happen upon a 1936 Ford truck adrift in space, leading to the discovery of a cryogenic chamber of humans abducted in the 1930s, including Amelia Earhart.

overview.zh: 查克泰独自一人驾驶穿梭机离舰纪念他父亲的忌日，不料误入卡松-尼斯楚人的领空，按照习俗，一名卡松少年驾驶飞船前去刺杀查克泰作为成人礼的仪式，查克泰费尽周折击毁飞船，并抓住卡松少年，在和他的相处过程当中，两人有了一定了解。查克泰还是被卡松人抓住，卡松首领命令他杀掉卡松少年——因为他未能完成自己的成人仪式，查克泰临机应变，挟持首领，带着少年驾驶穿梭机向一颗月球逃难，少年和查克泰成了朋友，少年在关键时刻保护了查克泰……
overview.en: Stardate: 49005.3. A young Kazon, desperate to prove himself and earn his name, tries to attack Chakotay.

overview.zh: 航海家号遭受卡松人袭击，医生被自动激活，借助新安装的全息投影设备，医生得以在航海家号内部自由活动，并四处奔走，尽一个紧急全息医疗程序的职责帮助船员，但在与卡松人战斗中，医生意外发现自己负伤流血，而且能感觉到疼痛，这还不算，电脑的身份核对结果显示他自己是一个活生生的人——刘易斯·齐默曼博士，紧急全息医疗程序的发明者，而航海家号上的其他船员都是些全息投影，就在医生感到混乱且手足无措时，一个自称雷金纳德·巴克利（注：《星际迷航：下一代》中的客串角色，曾在航海家号上担任计算机系统工程师，相当神经质且胆小怕事，但又希望自己担当大任，《星际迷航：航海家号》剧情发生时他已经调任至木星站，给刘易斯·齐默曼当副手，共同开发紧急全息医疗程序）的人出现，声称医生就是刘易斯·齐默曼，而航海家号上的一切只是全息投影。
overview.en: Stardate: 48892.1. The Emergency Medical Hologram is activated during a red alert and finds the ship has been abandoned after an unknown emergency. As he explores, evidence mounts that the Doctor may in fact be the only real human in a holo-program called Voyager.

overview.zh: 一种生活在太空的生命形式让凯丝进入了奥康帕人的性成熟期，这为她与尼利克斯的关系平添不少压力。
overview.en: Stardate: 48921.3. While the crew of Voyager investigate a cluster of space-borne life forms, Kes begins exhibiting strange intense symptoms.

overview.zh: 哈里·金一觉之后，意外发现自己不知什么原因身处旧金山的家中，惊慌之下，哈里试图找出自己为何会身处地球，他从服役记录中发现几个月前自己没能登上航海家号，而是调至星际舰队总部从事星舰设计工作，现在的自己已经和女朋友结了婚，生活幸福美满。哈里不敢相信眼前的一切，在过着美好生活的同时也感到惶恐不安，认为对不起航海家号上的同伴。他找到了该为时空错乱负责的外星人，对方告诉他，要想修复时间线就必须冒着时空紊乱的风险，重现异常开始的那一刻，哈里在马赛找到汤姆·派里斯——后者因为在深空九号斗殴，也没登上航海家号——想要让他帮忙，但此刻的派里斯完全是个扶不起的阿斗，不肯帮忙，更糟糕的是，因为非法入侵航海家号数据库，哈里被星际舰队当成间谍四处追捕。汤姆·派里斯和哈里金登上了原型舰黄石号，逃了出去。就在星舰即将爆炸时，启动了紧急传送……一瞬间哈里回到了航海家号上。
overview.en: Stardate: 49011. Harry Kim arises one morning to find he is back in San Francisco on Earth with his girlfriend Libby. In order to help him restore reality, he enlists the help of a shady figure in France by the name of Tom Paris, who has no idea who Harry is.

overview.zh: 一片异常的空间扭曲了航海家号的内部。无论什么都对它无效。在它离去时，它下载了航海家号的所有数据……
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Voyager enters a spatial distortion ring, which causes the ship’s layout to shift in confusing ways.

overview.zh: 尼利克斯与汤姆·派里斯为了凯丝而争风吃醋，但却被派在一起执行一次外勤任务。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Tom Paris and Neelix, while fighting over Kes’s affections, crash-land on a dangerous planet and become responsible for a sickly baby creature.

overview.zh: 一个外星人让航海家号上的船员产生了幻觉，只有凯丝和医生能对其免疫。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Captain Janeway starts seeing characters and objects from her holo-novel around the ship. Soon afterwards the crew begins entering a catatonic state one by one, while only Kes and the Doctor remain unaffected.

overview.zh: 查可泰遇见了一群头上和他有着相同刺青的外星人。这解开了地球上印第安人的来历——原来这些外星人曾经去过地球……
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Upon discovering a cultural symbol drawn in the ground on a planet that was used by his ancestors to 'heal the land', Chakotay tries to contact the beings his tribe called the 'Sky Spirits.'

overview.zh: 一名奥康帕人帮助凯丝开发自己的精神能力，与此同时，船员们也找到了守护者的雌性同伴。但是那名奥康帕人和守护者的雌性同伴有一个巨大的阴谋……航海家号最终幸而脱险。
overview.en: Stardate: 49164.8. The crew of Voyager make contact with the Caretaker's mate, Suspiria, and a community of Ocampa that have been living on her Array. One of the Ocampa begins to train Kes in growing her psychic abilities, but pushes her to become more powerful than she can control.

overview.zh: 卡松-尼斯楚派偷走了航海家号上的一个传送器模块，企图兼并其他的卡松宗派。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. After the Kazon steal some Federation technology Chakotay goes after them on his own and is captured.

overview.zh: 在地面上获取一种化学物质时发生冲突后，杜沃克与贝拉娜被当成当地的反抗组织成员而被逮捕。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Tuvok and B'Elanna are captured and imprisoned after an away mission to obtain a chemical vital to Voyager's systems from a black market go wrong. Janeway is knocked unconscious and is rescued by a man who believes that she is his daughter.

overview.zh: 船员们发现了一具漂浮在太空中的机器人，他们修复了它。却发现被卷入了一场机器人的战争当中。贝拉娜毁坏了亲手修复的机器人……
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. After finding and repairing a robot found drifting in space, B'Elanna is abducted and forced to design a new prototype or Voyager will be destroyed.

overview.zh: 珍妮薇尝试与卡松人组成一个联盟，来改善航海家号在第四象限的处境。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Janeway tries to make an alliance with a Kazon sect for their own protection and so they can continue their journey through the Delta Quadrant.

overview.zh: 汤姆·派里斯驾驶科克伦号穿梭机打破了曲速十级的极限，但却对他本人产生了奇特的副作用。他进化得及其快……
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. After finding a type of dilithium that can survive at a higher temperatures, Tom Paris comes up with the ingenious idea of attempting to cross the transwarp threshold in an attempt to find a way to get home faster.

overview.zh: 为了让航海家号船员苏德尔的不良情绪得到压制，杜沃克与他进行了心灵融合。但是这对杜沃克产生了副作用……
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. In order to help out Lon Suder, a psychopath who killed a crewmember, Tuvok performs a mind meld. Soon after, he begins showing violent tendencies, which develop until he loses control.

overview.zh: 贝拉娜·朵芮丝曾经改编过卡达西一艘人工智能无人飞船的程序，而这艘性能强大的无人飞船却在第四象限中被发现。无人飞船载有的弹头即将毁灭一个无辜的星球，贝拉娜进入飞船，想要解除它。但是电脑骗过了她。情急之下贝拉娜用相位枪直接轰击飞船的弹头……
overview.en: Stardate: 49447. When Voyager encounters a Cardassian missile ship in the Delta Quadrant named 'Dreadnought', B'Elanna must disarm it before it destroys a planet with millions of innocent people.

overview.zh: 船员们遇到了一个企图终结自己不朽生命的Q连续体成员。
overview.en: Stardate: 49301.2. A suicidal Q threatens the future of the Q-Continuum after he requests asylum aboard Voyager.

overview.zh: 医生帮助了一名被噬菌感染的维汀女性，医生后来维汀女性相爱了。
overview.en: Stardate: 46504.3. After receiving a Vidiian patient who is about to die from the Phage, the doctor transfers her consciousness into the ship's computer and creates a holographic body. He soon finds himself becoming deeply attracted to her.

overview.zh: 船员们试图找出船上将情报出卖给卡松-尼斯楚派的叛徒。尼利斯发现了这个叛徒……
overview.en: Stardate: 49485.2. After weeks of erratic behavior, Tom Paris leaves Voyager and joins a Talaxian convoy.

overview.zh: 在穿越一处空间裂缝时，航海家号产生了一个复制品。正当两艘航海家号努力合体时，维汀人侵入了一艘航海家号。其中一个珍妮薇下令摧毁自己的船……
overview.en: Stardate: 49548.7. An accident in a plasma cloud duplicates Voyager after they are attacked by the Vidiians. During the aftermath, the ship is severely damaged, Ensign Wildman's baby dies and Harry Kim is sucked into space through a hull breach.

overview.zh: 杜沃克探索一颗月球上的矿产时，遭遇极端天气坠机，他意外地在那里发现了一群同样遭遇船难的孩子，杜沃克试图稳住孩子们的情绪，但他们依然感到十分恐惧，因为根据他们的传说，这颗月亮上有一个怪物，会在半夜里抓走一些孩子，杜沃克扫描周围环境，并没有发现任何生命信号，于是没放在心上，把孩子们哄去睡觉，但是，第二天早上醒来，竟然发现有两个孩子悄无声息地失踪了。原来，这个种族从衰老出生，越长越小……
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. When Tuvok crashes on a moon, he discovers three small children who believe they are about to die.

overview.zh: 航海家号驶近一颗遭遇生态危机而进入冰河期的星球，船员们发现当地住民通过低温冬眠使自己躲避危机，但不知什么原因，预设的复苏时间早已超过，而里面的人却没有被唤醒。当恒温仓被传送上飞船后，船员们更是惊讶地发现，这些人在冬眠状态下大脑似乎受助梦系统影响，处于极度恐惧的状态，有的人甚至因为惊吓而死，为了找出原因，哈里和贝拉娜进入机器冬眠，却发现计算机里产生了一个代表着恐惧的小丑在不断地折磨着人们。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. The crew of Voyager encounters a planet that has recently entered an ice age. They discover a series of stasis chambers where a small group of people are mentally connected to an artificial environment that turned horribly wrong.

overview.zh: 一次传送器故障将杜沃克与尼利克斯合成为一个新的个体。这个个体与船员相处得很好。但珍妮薇下令把他们分开……
overview.en: Stardate: 49655.2. A transporter accident merges Tuvok and Neelix into one new being who calls himself 'Tuvix.'

overview.zh: 珍妮薇与查可泰在感染了一种病毒后，留在一颗行星上隔离。如果他们离开了那里的环境，病情就有可能恶化。为了不影响航海家号的返乡旅程，珍妮薇下令让杜沃克接过指挥棒，继续走完剩下的旅程，听到这个消息的船员们均十分反对，尤其是哈里，他强烈要求杜沃克留下来，但杜沃克却认为为了船员们的利益，继续旅行是合乎逻辑的，眼看航海家号走得越来越远，哈里甚至开始打算在船上发动叛乱，与此同时，珍妮薇和查克泰遭遇恶劣天气，正为了生存而拼尽全力。正在这时，航海家号联系上了一艘维汀船，上面载有那名维汀女医生和治疗这种疾病但药物。航海家号与维汀船汇合，却发现陷入了圈套中……但那名女医生没有放弃，秘密地将药物传送给了航海家号……
overview.en: Stardate: 49690.1. When Captain Janeway and Chakotay contract an incurable virus they are left on a planet that shield them from its effects. While Janeway searches for a cure, she begins to form a deeper relationship with her first officer. Onboard Voyager, Tuvok, who is now in command, faces a near mutiny.

overview.zh: 西斯卡与卡松人夺取了航海家号的控制权，并将她的船员放逐在一颗原始的行星上。船员们想尽一切办法生存……
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Voyager receives a distress signal from Seska, who claims that Maje Cullah is going to take her baby away from her, a baby she says is Chakotay's. Chakotay is skeptical, but can't take the risk of abandoning his child, should it really prove to be his. Janeway authorises a mission to rescue Chakotay's child and the ship moves deep into Kazon Nistrim territory. However: was Seska for real, or is this all an elaborate trap?
As Capt. Janeway and her crew continue their journey home, they face many obstacles, including a time rip that sends them back to 20th-century Earth.

overview.zh: 船员们必须在这颗荒凉的行星上生存下来，而医生、苏德尔与派里斯则尝试重新夺回星舰的控制权。
overview.en: Stardate: 50023.4. Voyager is captured by the Kazon and the crew are dumped on a planet in its early stages of evolution.  As only Tom Paris and Lon Suder have evaded capture, it's up to them and the EMH to come up with a plan to retake the ship.

overview.zh: 在航海家号遇到一团17级的巨型星云后，杜沃克开始感受到身体不适，甚至出现一段奇怪然而真实的幻觉，医生认为那段幻觉可能是被抑制的记忆，星云的形象刺激大脑将其再现，他建议通过心灵融合将记忆完全释放，珍妮薇自愿担当融合对象，然而当珍妮薇进入杜沃克的记忆中时，她看到的并非幻觉，而是光苏鲁上校——这是杜沃克年轻时在联邦星舰精进号上服役的记忆！
overview.en: Stardate: 50126.4. After falling ill to what appears to be a repressed memory Tuvok must perform a mind-meld with Captain Janeway in order to survive. The meld takes them back to when Tuvok was a junior science officer aboard the U.S.S. Excelsior under the command of Captain Hikaru Sulu.

overview.zh: 汤姆·派里斯与哈里·金被囚禁了。
overview.en: Stardate: 50156.2. Paris and Kim are sent to an Akritian prison after being accused of a terrorist bombing.

overview.zh: 航海家号在穿越一处传感器网络的时候遭遇了一大群飞船，而医生的全息矩阵也出了问题。
overview.en: Stardate: 50252.3. Voyager must cross through the territory of a mysterious and fiercely isolationist species.  Meanwhile, B’Ellana tries to help the Doctor when he begins losing his memory.

overview.zh: 船员们遇到两名被外星人奉为上帝的佛瑞吉人。航海家号准备带走他们，但是两名佛瑞吉人陷进了一个不稳定但虫洞，不知去向……
overview.en: Stardate: 50074.3. The crew encounter a Bronze Age culture ruled by two “Sages” – a pair of Ferengi who arrived through a wormhole from the Alpha Quadrant.

overview.zh: 贝拉娜经历了奇怪却逼真的梦境。
overview.en: Stardate: 50203.1. After Voyager encounter a telepathic species, B'Elanna starts having powerful dreams that depict the life of a woman and her lover in a time of great political and social upheaval.

overview.zh: 凯丝在接触了一处圣殿的能量场后陷入昏迷状态，珍妮薇舰长决心通过宗教仪式来拯救凯丝。
overview.en: Stardate: 50063.2. Captain Janeway has to undergo a rigorous ritual in order to save Kes' life when she is knocked unconscious.

overview.zh: 艘来自29世纪的联邦时空舰万古号想要摧毁航海家号，避免一场时空大爆炸导致了一场时间悖论的发生，它意外地将它自己与航海家号送回了20世纪地球的两个时期。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Voyager is attacked by a Timeship from 500 years in the future, but the two ships are hurled into the past and Voyager is stranded in the year 1996.

overview.zh: 珍妮薇必须阻止一名20世纪的企业家驾驶时空舰前往29世纪，否则29世纪的太阳系将会被摧毁。与此同时，航海家号得到了一位20世纪但女天文学家的帮助……
overview.en: Stardate: 50312.5. While trying to rescue Paris and Tuvok, Torres and Chakotay are captured by a gang of weapons smugglers who believe that they are from the government.

overview.zh: 凯丝被一名外星暴君控制了。
overview.en: Stardate: 50348.1. A dying warlord transfers his consciousness to Kes’s body and uses her to stage a bloody coup on his home world.

overview.zh: Q造访了航海家号，请求凯瑟琳·珍妮薇帮他结束Q连续体中的内战。
overview.en: Stardate: 50384.2. Q begins courting Captain Janeway, claiming that her having his child is the only way to end a civil war wracking the Q Continuum.

overview.zh: 开展外交活动的珍妮薇和尼利克斯返回航海家号，却发现船上似乎遭受外星生物袭击，船员集体失踪，在珍妮薇尚摸不着头脑的时候，尼利克斯又失踪了，孤身一人的珍妮薇抄起武器，一路击杀外星生物，前往医务室找到医生，原来，航海家号响应了一处爆发病毒的采矿殖民地的呼救，这种病毒会通过叮咬生物而逐渐变大，成长为巨型病毒，不幸的是，乘着医生返回航海家号的功夫，这种病毒也跟着溜上来了……医生和珍妮薇使用全息的虚拟人来吸引这种病毒，并消灭了它们。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. After returning from a first contact mission, Janeway, Neelix and the Doctor must retake Voyager from an infestation of microorganisms that grow to an alarming size.

overview.zh: 航海家号航至了尼利克斯所知星域的边界，这里有一处交易空间站。但是尼利斯却鬼迷心窍地帮助黑帮盗取航海家号的曲速等离子体……
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Voyager arrives at the dangerous and uncharted Nekrit Expanse. Neelix, feeling useless now that he can’t guide them, reaches out to a shady contact to find the crew a map.

overview.zh: 船员们在全息甲板中举行了一次夏威夷宴会，杜沃克却发现了一个不同寻常的“全息”人物。这个全息人物被一个空间站控制了，那个空间站的主人爱上了杜沃克……
overview.en: Stardate: 50460.3. Ensign Kim asks for Tuvok’s help controlling his emotions when he finds himself desperately in love with a holodeck character.

overview.zh: 珍妮薇似乎陷入了时间循环中，但最终都以她的死亡告终。一个外星人扮作珍妮薇的父亲，吸引她进入所谓的“极乐世界”……
overview.en: Stardate: 50518.6. Captain Janeway and Chakotay are trapped in a time loop, reliving the same disastrous shuttle crash.

overview.zh: 沃里克经历了庞发，他向一同工作的贝拉娜求爱。贝拉娜被传染了……他们在探索一颗星球时发现这里有及其隐蔽的外星人，自称在一次惨烈的攻击后躲了起来……最后，决斗解决了沃里克的问题，并且人们发现攻击这颗行星的是——博格。
overview.en: Stardate: 50537.2. Ensign Vorik expresses his desire to mate with B'Elanna during his Pon-Farr. After they get in a brawl over the matter, Torres begins showing signs of the Pon-Farr herself.

overview.zh: 查可泰响应一颗行星的求救而来到该星，却发现自己卷入了两群人的冲突当中。此时，航海家号也发现了一艘被废弃的博格方块。该星球的前博格人利用神经收发器救了查克泰，被告知了这些人要建立一个合作体，这样可以避免冲突，但在航海家号上的人看来，这无异于创建一个新的博格集合体。查克泰在返回航海家号时被强制连入，帮助他们启动了博格方块。那些前博格人连到了一起，并且摧毁了博格方块……
overview.en: Stardate: 50614.2. During an away mission, Chakotay discovers a Federation hailing signature coming from an alien planet. After landing, he learns that all is not peaceful, and those helping him have not been entirely honest about their true origins.

overview.zh: 医生想把他人的个性嫁接到自己的程序中，但“升级”的结果却让他发展出了邪恶的个性。
overview.en: Stardate: 50693.2. When the doctor tries to improve his personality by incorporating the psychological profiles of famous and historical people, he is overwhelmed by their dark sides and begins exhibiting signs of a split personality, one the regular doctor, and the other dark and evil. Kes asks to leave Voyager when they encounter a race with vast knowledge of the region of space they are currently exploring.

overview.zh: 航海家号帮助一颗行星解决小行星撞击的问题，杜沃克与尼利克斯紧急着陆在该星上并打算修复磁悬浮的天梯。但是他们却在天梯顶部发现了一个秘密存储器;  与此同时，一场谋杀在天梯内展开来……
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Neelix is pushed to the limits when Tuvok's attitude becomes too much to bear while the pair is on an away mission to help evacuate a Nezu planet, which is being bombarded with asteroids.

overview.zh: 哈里金在得了一种奇怪病后，被一颗全是女人的行星联系了。哈利金在这里过得很愉快。后来他决定回到航海家号上，并且发现这里男人很少但原因：女人们为了收集到足够的基因，不惜杀死男人……
overview.en: Stardate: 50732.4. Harry Kim experiences strong senses of deja vu in an unknown region of space. He soon learns that he is native to this region and that he is T'Karian, not human.

overview.zh: 在未来凯丝死后不久，她开始逆时间旅行。医生使用了生物时空舱稳定了凯丝。
overview.en: Stardate: 50973. Kes begins traveling backwards through time from the moment of her death. With each shift, she comes closer to a solution but she also grows months and years younger at a time.

overview.zh: 医生在全息甲板上创造了一家人。但是他发现，一个真正的家庭远远比他的想象复杂。后来他的“女儿”在事故中去世了……
overview.en: Stardate: 50863.2. The Doctor decides he should create a holographic family in order to expand himself. When B'Elanna is disgusted by its unrealistic perfectionism, she alters the program to include random events and outcomes with interesting and devastating results.

overview.zh: 一个先进的蜥蜴种族发现了他们自己的真正的起源。他们其实来自于地球，由鸭嘴龙进化而来。但是长老院不承认这一点，因为这危及到了她的统治。航海家号船员和一名蜥蜴科学家差点被关到监狱中。为了拯救航海家号，最后那名科学家屈服了。不过他发誓要改变这里的一切，他相信，总有一天所有蜥蜴种族的人都会将地球当作他们的家……
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. An alien palaeontologist discovers a common ancestral link between his people and humans. He believes that this proves that his people (the Voth) evolved on Earth and migrated to the Delta Quadrant millions of years ago, but his government is not as willing to believe his interpretation of the evidence.

overview.zh: 航海家号的船员接二连三地消失，而同时却出现了相等数量的外星人。一个种族占领了航海家号并将它用作自己的巡逻舰。船员们发现他们被送到了一个独立的人造生物圈中，他们计划夺回航海家号……
overview.en: Stardate: 50912.4. Crew members are replaced one-by-one with aliens from an unknown race.

overview.zh: 贝拉娜·朵芮丝发现了一个不完整的全息甲板程序，在里面查可泰与马奇游击队的成员联合反抗珍妮薇。这个程序原来是杜沃克编写用于训练的，珍妮薇下令杜沃克把它编完。可是这时全息的塞斯卡造反了……
overview.en: Stardate: 50953.4. B'Elanna Torres discovers a holodeck program where Chakotay and the Maquis rebel against Janeway.

overview.zh: 航海家号必须穿越博格的星域，但一个新种族的出现却为双方都带来了麻烦。
overview.en: Stardate: 50984.3. Voyager finally enters Borg space, only to discover a threat more powerful than the Borg themselves.
On their long voyage back to Earth, Capt. Janeway and her spaceship crew do battle with Kazons, Borg, Cardassians and other galactic enemies.

overview.zh: 珍妮薇与博格人达成了协议：帮助他们使用修改过的纳米探针击退来自液态空间的8472种族，以换取安全通过博格星域的承诺。博格人派出个体九之七与他们一同工作。
overview.en: Stardate: 51003.7. The Voyager crew, allied with the Borg, prepare to battle the sinister alien Species 8472. But can an alliance between opinionated individuals and a collective race of consumers survive such fundamental differences?

overview.zh: 凯丝的精神能力发展到了危及航海家号的地步，她在临死前用尽她的能量将航海家号向阿尔法象限推了10000光年。
overview.en: Stardate: 51008. Janeway begins the process of integrating Seven of Nine into the Voyager crew. Meanwhile, Kes begins to experience extreme advances in her mental powers.

overview.zh: 贝拉娜想庆祝自己的克林贡荣耀日，然而不好的事接二连三地发生，甚至飞船的曲速核心因为一次事故被弹出了。汤姆派里斯和贝拉娜被困太空，贝拉娜向汤姆派里斯表白了……
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. When Voyager is forced to eject its warp core, Torres and Paris take a shuttle to retrieve it. But when the shuttle is damaged, the two officers are forced to abandon it—and find themselves alone in space with a rapidly depleting oxygen supply.

overview.zh: 查可泰在一场外星战争中被洗脑，帮一方战斗。
overview.en: Stardate: 51082.4. Chakotay is stranded on a planet where two races are trying to wipe each other out in a massive, planet-wide war.

overview.zh: 一个全息人物联系上了航海家号，医生因为见到另一个全息人物而倍感兴奋。但是这个全息人热衷于杀害有机人，一同前往的贝拉娜陷入危险中……
overview.en: Stardate: 51186.2. Torres and the Doctor assist a holographic ship's servant whose crew has been killed. Meanwhile, when Kim and Seven of Nine are assigned to work on a project together, the ensign attempts to get to know the person inside the mysterious former-Borg.

overview.zh: 九之七陷入博格记忆的重现中，她找到了小时候她生活的飞船，她希望自己能更具有人性。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Seven of Nine steals a shuttlecraft and flees Voyager in an attempt to answer a mysterious homing beacon and return to the Borg Collective.

overview.zh: 船员们被莫名其妙的疾病所困扰，而一群看不见的入侵者正在近距离地观察他们。珍妮薇冒死冲进了脉冲双星系统来甩掉他们……
overview.en: Stardate: 51244.3. When members of the crew begin suffering from bizarre mutations, Seven of Nine may be the only one who can uncover the reasons why.

overview.zh: 航海家号建造了一间新的天文观测室，这让他们走上了一条新的航线，也让他们遇到了能抹去历史的克瑞尼姆时间舰。
overview.en: Stardate: 51268.4. The Voyager crew finds its determination and morale challenged when trying to survive a brutal, long-lasting conflict with a race called the Krenim.

overview.zh: 航海家号受到了严重的损坏，因此不得不躲进一片星云中并留下骨干船员进行修复；同时克瑞尼姆舰的指挥官也在与查可泰和派里斯寻求妥协。这艘时间舰独立于时空之外，无数次地改变历史，但是没有一次完美。航海家号撞上了这艘时间舰，让历史回到了正常的轨道上……
overview.en: Stardate: 51425.4. While Chakotay and Paris remain on board Annorax's time ship, Janeway attempts to repair Voyager enough to pursue her crew members' abductors.

overview.zh: 朵芮丝在访问一个心灵感应种族居住的世界时被逮捕，罪名是暴力的思想。
overview.en: Stardate: 51367.2. After making contact with a race of telepaths, the Voyager crew must help defuse a volatile situation when a local citizen acts on a random, violent thought inadvertently tranferred from Torres.

overview.zh: 一群外星人偷走了航海家号的一些有技术价值的部件在一个星球上被出售。珍妮薇和全息人物达芬奇夺回了这些部件，珍妮薇也第一次乘坐了达芬奇的滑翔飞行器……
overview.en: Stardate: 51386.4. Janeway and the hologram of Leonardo da Vinci must work together to retrieve Voyager's main computer processor, which has been stolen by alien thieves.

overview.zh: 尼利克斯在星云里采集样品的过程中突发事故死亡，九之七使用博格探针让他复活。但复活后的尼利克斯发现很难去适应，尤其去相信死亡后并不能见到自己亲人的事实。
overview.en: Stardate: 51449.2. Neelix is killed during an away mission, but Seven of Nine is able to revive him using Borg technology, leading him into a crisis of faith regarding the afterlife.

overview.zh: 航海家号的船员陷入不能苏醒的梦境中，只有查可泰能救他们。
overview.en: Stardate: 51471.3. The crew is 'attacked' by a species of alien that live in the human dream state. It is up to Chakotay, with extensive knowledge about the dream state, to save the ship and its crew.

overview.zh: 医生的程序经由一个外星人的通讯网络而发送到了位于阿尔法象限的实验星舰普罗米修斯号上，但却发现星舰被罗慕伦人占领了。只有他和那艘船的紧急医疗全息程序能重新夺回船的控制权。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. When Seven discovers an alien communications array, the crew devises a way of sending the Doctor's program across it into the Alpha Quadrant, where he finds himself aboard a Starfleet vessel that has been commandeered by the Romulans.

overview.zh: 一则来自星际舰队的信息被截留在了希罗吉恩人的由量子奇点驱动的中继站上，珍妮薇设定航向去找回这则信息。最后所有中继站在争端中被摧毁……
overview.en: Stardate: 51501.4. As letters from the Alpha Quadrant come trickling through the communications array, the Voyager crew learns of an assortment of joyous, disturbing, and inevitable news.

overview.zh: 航海家号营救了一名希罗吉恩人，他告诉船员他的猎物逃跑了。这个猎物是8472种族的，珍妮薇决定将这名8472送回液态空间……
overview.en: Stardate: 51652.3. The crew rescues a critically injured but aggressive Hirogen hunter, who threatens to have his allies destroy Voyager if Janeway comes between him the hunt for his latest prey: a single creature from Species 8472.

overview.zh: 医生让九之七固执地相信，一个为航海家号装配新武器的商人盗取了她身上的博格技术。
overview.en: Stardate: 51658.2. While re-fitting Voyager's systems with newly traded weapons, Seven of Nine claims to have been assaulted by Kovin, the weapons dealer. The Doctor soon makes a surprising discovery about the situation.

overview.zh: 希罗吉恩人把装置植入船员体内，并猎取那些相信自己是全息程序角色的船员。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. After having taken over Voyager, the Hirogen supply the crew members with artificial identities and subject them to violent holodeck simulations.

overview.zh: 希罗吉恩人把装置植入船员体内，并猎取那些相信自己是全息程序角色的船员。
overview.en: Stardate: 51715.2. The crew must stop an artificial holodeck rendition of a World War II battle from spilling onto the decks of the ship while simultaneously dealing with a Hirogen takeover.

overview.zh: 一艘带着某种原型推进系统的外星飞船向航海家号求助，好动的派里斯主动要求去帮助飞行员修复飞船。但是这名飞行员为了生存，强制与派里斯交换了身体，留在了航海家号上……
overview.en: Stardate: 51762.4. An alien test pilot who has the capability of switching bodies manages to take Tom's place aboard Voyager in order to escape the law.

overview.zh: 在机密指令被激活后，珍妮薇开始不经解释就下达命令。这条命令是关于摧毁Ω分子的。这种分子威力如此之大，以至于几个就能养活一个文明。不过它一旦爆炸，会使一大片空间变得无法进行曲速航行。九之七认为这种粒子是完美的，想要稳定它……
overview.en: Stardate: 51781.2. When the Voyager computer detects a mysterious, powerful, and extremely dangerous substance, Janeway must risk all to attempt destroying it.

overview.zh: 一艘隐形飞船的外星女性想要见查可泰，并要求航海家号为她提供庇护。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. An alien woman who requests asylum on board Voyager claims that she was onboard the ship a month ago, and she fell in love with Chakotay.

overview.zh: 航海家号在克瑞安博物馆中被描述成了一艘邪恶但战舰。在700年后，一名克瑞安博物馆的馆长希望航海家号遗失的医生备份能证实他们的历史记载。但是医生推翻了这一切，为航海家号正了名。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. 700 years into the future the Doctor must defend the crew of Voyager and set history straight when an alien race claims that the Warship Voyager was responsible for war crimes commited against their race.

overview.zh: 汤姆·派里斯与哈里·金驾驶穿梭机降落在一颗环境恶劣的Y级行星上，以获取飞船航行的氘燃料。但是一种化合物复制了船员，这些复制船员竟然可以在这颗行星上呼吸……他们最后留了下来。
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. Kim and Paris beam down to a hellish, barren planet to search for deuterium, a crucial energy source required to keep the ship running.

overview.zh: 航海家号要穿过一片布满致死辐射的星云，这迫使除了九之七外的所有船员都要进入休眠状态。而在医生掉线后，九之七必须面临孤身一人的境遇，她因害怕产生了幻像。就在九之七极端害怕时，飞船成功通过了星云……
overview.en: Stardate: 51929.3. The crew goes into stasis during a month-long journey through a nebula, leaving Seven and the Doctor in sole charge of running the ship.

overview.zh: 派里斯与尼利克斯任务归来时带来了一名通晓4,000多种语言的乘客。他协助解码了星际舰队发送的信息，这似乎为航海家号的回家指明了道路。这条信息指引他们找到了一艘先进的联邦飞船，带有量子滑流技术。正当船员兴奋时，九之七解码了据那个乘客说无法解码的信息，这条信息表明星际舰队无计可施，更没有派什么飞船，一切都是伪造的。外星人乘客最后只抓到了珍妮薇和九之七，回到了外星人被博格占领的母星，企图让集合体同化他们。航海家号使用滑流引擎追赶了过去……
overview.en: Stardate: 51978.2. When an alien helps the Voyager crew decode the mysterious encrypted message from Starfleet, the crew learns the whereabouts of a secret experimental starship that may be able to get them back to the Alpha Quadrant within a mere matter of months.
Capt. Janeway and crew continue to try and find their way home, and Seven of Nine returns to the collective to confront the Borg queen.

overview.zh: 航海家号在穿越一片布满θ射线的黑暗空域时丢失了能量。这一切都源于一个种族污染了这个空域，而这个空域的生命受到了致命伤……
overview.en: Stardate: 52081.2. Traveling through a large area of space completely devoid of stars and civilizations, the Voyager crew copes with the prospect of long-term isolation.

overview.zh: 医生的移动全息发射器在一次传送过程中被损坏了，九之七拿走修理，却不慎将博格纳米探针与发射器融合，创造了一名拥有29世纪科技的博格个体——小一。怎么处理这个博格人成为了船员们头疼的问题。最终珍妮薇决定坦诚对待小一，并成功让他融入到了船员中去。博格人接受到小一无意中发出的信号，他们觊觎29世纪的科技，企图拦截航海家号，刚刚才明白友情的小一为了拯救朋友们，毅然牺牲自己的生命……
overview.en: Stardate: Unknown. A transporter accident merges some of Seven of Nine's nanoprobes with The Doctor's mobile emitter to create a 29th century Borg drone.

overview.zh: 贝拉娜故意将自己置入非常危险的境地，与此同时，船员们也打算建造一艘新的穿梭机——德尔塔飞艇。船员们开着德尔塔飞艇去一个气态巨行星抢救他们的探测器，以防被外星种族抢走……
