overview.en: The DMA approaches Earth and Ni’Var. With evacuations underway, Burnham and the team aboard the U.S.S. Discovery must find a way to communicate and connect with a species far different from their own before time runs out.

overview.zh: 第五季也是最后一季，讲述了柯柏船长和美国太空探索署《发现号》的船员们发现了一个神秘事件，这将让他们踏上穿越银河系的史诗般的冒险之旅，去寻找一个古老的力量，它的存在已经被故意隐瞒了几个世纪。但是也有其他人也在寻找这个目标……一些危险的敌人，他们渴望得到这个奖赏，并且会不惜一切代价去得到它。
overview.en: The fifth and final season finds Captain Burnham and the crew of the U.S.S. Discovery uncovering a mystery that will send them on an epic adventure across the galaxy to find an ancient power whose very existence has been deliberately hidden for centuries. But there are others on the hunt as well ... dangerous foes who are desperate to claim the prize for themselves and will stop at nothing to get it.

overview.zh: 伯纳姆船长和星际联邦发现号被派去取回一艘有 800 年历史的神秘罗慕兰船只；直到隐藏在里面的神器被盗，引发了一场史诗般的追逐。与此同时，萨鲁获得了终生难忘的职位，而蒂莉的努力却让她陷入了错综复杂的秘密之网。
overview.en: Captain Burnham and the U.S.S. Discovery are sent to retrieve a mysterious 800-year-old Romulan vessel; until the artifact hidden inside is stolen, leading to an epic chase. Meanwhile, Saru is offered the position of a lifetime, and Tilly's efforts to help pull her into a tangled web of secrecy.

overview.zh: 在萨鲁作为伯纳姆船长的一号人物的最后一次任务中，团队冒险前往一个看似废弃的星球，寻找银河系中最伟大的宝藏。
overview.en: On Saru's last mission as Captain Burnham's Number One, the team ventures to a seemingly abandoned planet to hunt for what might be the greatest treasure in the galaxy.

overview.zh: 格雷和萨鲁担任大使的第一天因他与特丽娜的订婚而变得复杂。
overview.en: On Trill, Captain Burnham, Book, and Culber must pass a dangerous test to prove themselves worthy of the next clue. Adira reconnects with Gray and Saru’s first day as ambassador is complicated by his engagement to T'Rina.

overview.zh: 在寻找下一条线索的路上，星际联邦发现号被一种神秘武器破坏，伯纳姆船长、雷纳和斯塔梅茨成为唯一有可能及时拯救这艘船的船员。
overview.en: On the way to the next clue, the U.S.S. Discovery is sabotaged by a mysterious weapon, leaving Captain Burnham, Rayner, and Stamets as the only crew members who can possibly save the ship in time.

overview.zh: 伯纳姆船长和布克前往超维度空间，寻找祖先力量所在位置的下一个线索。与此同时，雷纳指挥发现号执行了他的第一次任务，卡尔伯向蒂莉敞开心扉。
overview.en: Captain Burnham and Book journey into extradimensional space in search of the next clue to the location of the Progenitors' power. Meanwhile, Rayner navigates his first mission in command of the U.S.S. Discovery, and Culber opens up to Tilly.

overview.zh: 在扭曲前的社会中卧底时，当当地传统威胁到蒂莉的生命时，伯纳姆上尉被迫考虑违反最高指令。与此同时，卡尔伯试图与斯塔梅茨联系，当雷纳为他们分配一个桥上的位置时，阿迪拉挺身而出。
overview.en: While undercover in a pre-warp society, Captain Burnham is forced to consider breaking the Prime Directive when a local tradition threatens Tilly's life. Meanwhile, Culber tries to connect with Stamets, and Adira steps up when Rayner assigns them a position on the bridge.

overview.zh: 随着莫尔和拉克最终被拘留，当布林到达并要求交出他们时，联邦陷入了一场外交和道德风暴。与此同时，沮丧的布克在蒂莉、阿迪拉和雷诺努力破译最新线索时寻找帮助的方法。
overview.en: With Moll and L'ak finally in custody, the Federation is pulled into a diplomatic and ethical firestorm when the Breen arrive and demand they be handed over. Meanwhile, a frustrated Book looks for ways to help as Tilly, Adira, and Reno work to decipher the latest clue.

overview.zh: 当伯纳姆船长被困在一个旨在测试她是否有能力取回始祖强大技术的“心灵景观”中时，布克、雷纳和发现号的船员必须阻止布林足够长的时间，让她逃脱。
overview.en: When Captain Burnham is trapped within a “mindscape” designed to test her worthiness to retrieve the Progenitor's powerful technology, Book, Rayner, and the crew of the U.S.S. Discovery must hold off the Breen long enough for her to escape.

overview.zh: 在莫尔和布林号占领了一座蕴藏着始祖力量的神秘建筑后，伯纳姆船长必须领导一项秘密任务，在布林号弄清楚如何使用它之前将其取回。
overview.en: After Moll and the Breen capture a mysterious structure that contains the Progenitors' power, Captain Burnham must lead a covert mission to retrieve it before the Breen figure out how to use it.

overview.zh: 伯纳姆船长被困在一个神秘的外星传送门内，该传送门违背了熟悉的时间、空间和重力规则，他必须与莫尔以及环境本身作战，以便找到始祖的技术并为联邦保护它。与此同时，布克冒着危险帮助伯纳姆生存，雷纳带领发现号航空母舰与布林军队进行了一场史诗般的赢家通吃的战斗。
overview.en: Trapped inside a mysterious alien portal that defies familiar rules of time, space, and gravity, Captain Burnham must fight Moll – and the environment itself – in order to locate the Progenitors' technology and secure it for the Federation. Meanwhile, Book puts himself in harm's way to help Burnham survive and Rayner leads the U.S.S. Discovery in an epic winner-takes-all battle against Breen forces.

name.zh: 星际迷航：发现号之短途

overview.zh: 电视剧将介绍新的角色、新的外星种族登场，同时延续该系列对种族、政治、环境等社会问题关切的优良传统。
overview.en: Each episode tells a stand-alone story that serves as an opportunity for deeper storytelling and exploration of key characters and themes that fit into Star Trek: Discovery and the expanding Star Trek universe.

overview.zh: 登上发现号后，Ensign Tilly（Mary Wiseman饰）遇上一名意料外的访客并被寻求协助，不过这对组合意外地有着不少共同点。
overview.en: Onboard the U.S.S. Discovery, Ensign Tilly encounters an unexpected visitor in need of help. However, this unlikely pair may have more in common than meets the eye.

overview.zh: Craft（Aldis Hodge饰演）在一间不熟悉的病房醒来后，他发现自己是这船中的唯一人类，而唯一陪伴着他的是船上的A.I.电脑界面。
overview.en: After waking up in an unfamiliar sickbay, Craft finds himself on board a deserted ship, and his only companion and hope for survival is an A.I. computer interface.

overview.zh: 作为第一名加盟星际舰队的Kelpien人Saru（Doug Jones），他过去与父亲及妹妹在母星过着原始的生活，而saru的聪明才智以及好奇心总是让他与质疑自己种族的传统。怀揣着的家人亲情与自我梦想最终会引领他走向何方。
overview.en: Before he was the first Kelpien to join Starfleet, Saru lived a simple life on his home planet of Kaminar with his father and sister. Young Saru, full of ingenuity and a level of curiosity uncommon among his people, yearns to find out what lies beyond his village, leading him on an unexpected path.

overview.zh: Harry Mudd（Rainn Wilson饰演，他本人执导此集）四处惹麻烦的诈骗犯，这次就让我们来看看他的“冒险”故事吧
overview.en: Harry Mudd, back to his old tricks of stealing and double-dealing, finds himself in a precarious position aboard a hostile ship - just in time to try out his latest con.
On his first day aboard the USS Enterprise, Ensign Spock and his new superior officer Number One get trapped in a turbolift.

name.zh: 第2集 爱德华的麻烦

overview.en: Newly minted Captain Lynne Lucero is excited to take command of the U.S.S. Cabot. That is, until she meets Edward Larkin, an ornery scientist who believes he has found a revolutionary new use for tribbles.
When an attack on Starbase 28 leaves a surprise prisoner under Cadet Thira Sidhu's watch, she is faced with making a decision that may threaten her standing in Starfleet.

name.zh: 第4集 水熊虫和点点

overview.en: Ephraim, a humble tardigrade, is flying through the mycelial network when an unexpected encounter takes her on a bewildering adventure through space.

name.zh: 第5集 创造星辰的女孩
name.en: The Girl Who Made the Stars

overview.en: When a lightning storm in space scares a young Michael Burnham, her father aims to ease her fears with a mythical story about a brave little girl who faced her own fears head on.
12 year-old classmates Kima and Lil find themselves at odds with each other on a day that will change their lives forever.

overview.zh: CBS All Access过去预订两季份的成人向动画剧《星际迷航：下层舰员 Star Trek: Lower Decks》，该动画由《瑞克和莫蒂 Rick and Morty》主编剧Mike McMahan负责，剧中讲述一艘重要性不高星舰里的支援组舰员。
overview.en: The lives of the support crew serving on one of Starfleet's least important ships, the U.S.S. Cerritos, in 2380. Ensigns Mariner, Boimler, Rutherford and Tendi have to keep up with their duties and their social lives, often while the ship is being rocked by a multitude of sci-fi anomalies.

overview.zh: 2380年，在一架极为不重要的联邦星舰喜瑞都号上，剧集讲述发生于现役船员之间的日常故事。滕迪少尉兴致勃勃地开始了她在喜瑞都号上的新任务，这是一艘加利福尼亚级的星舰，专门执行第二次接触任务，为船员们大胆地去以前没有人去过的地方做后续的繁杂工作。她很快就结识了布拉德-博伊姆勒少尉、贝克特-马里纳和山姆-卢瑟福，他们被统称为 “下层舰员"，正如马里纳所指出的，那是真正行动的地方。
overview.en: Meet the USS Cerritos and its quirky lower-deck crew as they tackle second-contact missions and unexpected challenges. The season blends humor with heartfelt moments, showcasing the crew's camaraderie and their unique approach to Starfleet duties.

overview.zh: 滕迪少尉在星际舰队的喜瑞都号上度过了她的第一天，在那里她遇到了其他支援人员。博伊姆勒被赋予了一项秘密的特殊任务。卢瑟福试图在灾难降临的时候保持他的约会生活的完整。
overview.en: Ensign Tendi has her first day of work on Starfleet's USS Cerritos, where she meets fellow support crew members. Boimler is tasked with a secret special assignment. Rutherford attempts to keep his dating life intact while a disaster strikes the ship.

overview.zh: 博伊姆勒少尉和马里纳少尉开始了前往克林贡的穿梭任务，而滕迪少尉和卢瑟福少尉则在喜瑞都号上共度时光。
overview.en: Ensigns Boimler and Mariner embark on a shuttle mission to a Klingon compound while Ensigns Tendi and Rutherford spend time together back on the USS Cerritos.

overview.zh: 新的工作规程取消了 "缓冲时间"，使下层甲板的工作人员疲于奔命，因为他们试图跟上紧张的时间表。马里纳少尉和兰森指挥官在一次外出执行任务时，相互间缺乏尊重的关系达到了顶峰。
overview.en: A new work protocol eliminating "buffer time" has the Lower Decks crew running ragged as they try to keep up with their tightened schedules. Ensign Mariner and Commander Ransom's mutual lack of respect comes to a head during an away mission.

overview.zh: 在马里纳当着船员的面公然不尊重她之后，弗里曼船长寻求终极复仇。好心的滕迪意外地搞砸了一个中尉的精神升华尝试，并试图将其纠正过来。
overview.en: Captain Freeman seeks the ultimate payback after Mariner blatantly disrespects her in front of the crew. A well-meaning Tendi accidentally messes up a Lieutenant's attempt at spiritual ascension and tries to make it right.

overview.zh: 博伊姆勒少尉欢迎他的女友芭芭拉来到喜瑞都号，这让马里纳少尉很不高兴--当喜瑞都号与更先进的温哥华号会合时，卢瑟福少尉和滕迪少尉对星舰产生了嫉妒。
overview.en: Ensign Boimler welcomes his girlfriend Barb onto the USS Cerritos, much to Ensign Mariner’s dismay — while Ensigns Ruthford and Tendi have starship envy when the Cerritos rendezvous with the more-advanced USS Vancouver.

overview.zh: 可爱但笨拙的弗莱彻少尉让马里纳和博伊姆勒的工作变得困难。卢瑟福向滕迪介绍了他创造的全息投影培训项目。
overview.en: The lovable but awkward Ensign Fletcher makes work difficult for Mariner and Boimler. Rutherford introduces Tendi to a holodeck training program he created.

name.zh: 关于博伊姆勒的多事之秋

overview.zh: 马里纳试图给她在星际舰队学院的好朋友留下好印象，她现在是一位来访的船长。博伊姆勒被送到星际舰队的一艘医疗船上，因为在一次传送器事故中，他无法完成传送，卡在了相位外的状态。
overview.en: Mariner tries to impress her best friend from Starfleet Academy who is now a visiting Captain. Boimler is sent to a Starfleet medical ship after a transporter accident puts him “out of phase.”

overview.zh: 当外星人强迫他们为一系列看似不相关的事件作证时，马里纳、博伊姆勒、滕迪和卢瑟福措手不及。
overview.en: Mariner, Boimler, Tendi and Rutherford are caught off guard when aliens force them to testify about a series of seemingly unrelated events.

overview.zh: 马里纳重新编程了博伊姆勒的全息程序，让自己在一部下层甲板风格的电影中扮演反派角色。
overview.en: Mariner repurposes Boimler's holodeck program to cast herself as the villain in a Lower Decks style movie.

overview.zh: 喜瑞都号遇到了一个熟悉的敌人。滕迪帮助一个正在挣扎的新人找到自己的立足点。
overview.en: The USS Cerritos encounters a familiar enemy. Tendi helps a struggling recruit find her footing.

overview.zh: 第二季《星际迷航：下层舰员》更惊险、更有趣，更有星际迷航的风格，粉丝们将看到奇怪的新（和熟悉的）外星人向联邦星舰喜瑞都号和联邦星舰泰坦号的船员发出挑战。对玛丽娜、坦迪、卢瑟福和鲍姆勒而言，新的动画冒险之旅才刚刚开始。
overview.en: Follow the support crew on one of Starfleet's least important ships, the U.S.S. Cerritos, in 2380. Ensigns Mariner, Boimler, Rutherford and Tendi have to keep up with their duties and their social lives, often while the ship is being rocked by a multitude of sci-fi anomalies.

overview.zh: 首播集。在第一季大结局的事件发生后三个月，联邦星舰喜瑞都号被派去执行一项任务，结果遭遇了“奇怪能量”。
overview.en: Approximately three months after the events of the season one finale, the U.S.S. Cerritos is dispatched on a mission where it ends up in a sci-fi event resulting in "strange energy," which Commander Ransom inadvertently absorbs.

overview.zh: 下层舰员们和被调来接手鲍姆勒的铺位和轮班工作的杰特曼哈维少尉难以相处。与此同时，我们得以一窥鲍姆勒在联邦星舰泰坦号上的生活，这比他想象中要激烈得多。
overview.en: Our Lower Deckers have trouble bonding with Ensign Jet Manhaver, who has been assigned Boimler’s bunk and shift duties. Meanwhile, we get a glimpse of Boimler’s life on the U.S.S. Titan, which is more intense than he thought it would be.

name.zh: 汤姆帕里斯永远与我们同在

overview.zh: 坦迪接到了特阿纳博士任命的一项特殊任务，并叫上玛丽娜来帮忙。在联邦星舰喜瑞都号上，卢瑟福因为一个舰桥船员的复活之谜而心神不宁。
overview.en: Assigned a special task by Dr. T'Ana, Tendi enlists Mariner for help. On the U.S.S. Cerritos, Rutherford is consumed by a bridge crew mystery.

overview.zh: 联邦星舰喜瑞都号被派往一个星球调查一起离奇而又危险的白猩猩目击事件。
overview.en: The U.S.S. Cerritos is dispatched to a planet to investigate an unexplained sighting of a dangerous Mugato.

overview.zh: 玛丽娜和鲍姆勒试图找到一个传说中的星际舰队派对的所在地，与此同时，舰桥船员要应对一个没有安全感的外星人外交官。
overview.en: Mariner and Boimler try to track down the location of a legendary Starfleet party while the bridge crew deals with an insecure alien diplomat.

overview.zh: 喜瑞都号上的异常物质整合日让下层舰员们五味杂陈, 弗里曼船长试图在派克力人的母星上促成停火协议。
overview.en: Anomaly consolidation day on the U.S.S. Cerritos leaves the Lower Deckers with mixed emotions. Captain Freeman attempts to negotiate peace on the Pakled home world.

overview.zh: 玛丽娜和鲍姆勒还有一台有意识的电脑被困在一个无人居住的星球。在喜瑞都号上，上尉指挥官毕拉普必须向一位老对手证明他的工程能力。
overview.en: Mariner and Boimler are stranded on an uninhabited planet with a sentient computer. On the Cerritos, Lt. Commander Billups must prove his engineering abilities to an old adversary.

overview.zh: 一名顾问抵达喜瑞都号进行测试并要求下层舰员和舰桥船员互换职责。
overview.en: A consultant arrives on the U.S.S. Cerritos to run drills that require the lower deckers and bridge crew to swap duties.

overview.zh: 鲍姆勒努力给自己寻觅一个舰桥伙伴，与此同时，喜瑞都号上的船员们在长途曲速旅行中进行了短暂的休整。
overview.en: Boimler tries to find a friend from the bridge, while the crew of the USS Cerritos has free time during a long warp trip.

overview.zh: 在第二季的最终集中，喜瑞都号受命前去帮助一艘精进级星舰飞船执行第一次接触任务。
overview.en: In the season two finale, the U.S.S. Cerritos is tasked to aid another class starship on a first contact mission.

overview.zh: 第三季以第二季惊心动魄的结局作为开篇，用一众啼笑皆非、完全超乎想象的困境，考验喜瑞都号的各位少尉。
overview.en: Season three challenges the U.S.S. Cerritos ensigns in (hilarious) ways they could never imagine, starting with a shocking resolution for season two’s epic cliffhanger finale.

overview.zh: 本季首播。弗里曼船长因派克力星球毁灭面临军事法庭的审判，玛丽娜与她的朋友们暗中执行任务，帮助她母亲洗清罪名。
overview.en: Mariner enlists her friends on a rogue mission to exonerate her mother, as Captain Freeman faces a military tribunal for the destruction of Pakled Planet.

overview.zh: 在一个天堂般的热带星球上，玛丽娜质疑兰塞姆指挥官组建离舰小队的方式。鲍姆勒做出了一个大胆的职业决定。
overview.en: On a tropical paradise planet, Mariner questions Commander Ransom on how he structures his away team. Boimler makes a bold career decision.

overview.zh: 在一个偏远的科学前哨站，神秘矿石能将幻想变为现实。坦迪开始了她作为高级科学官学员的第一天。
overview.en: On a remote science outpost, stone orbs are bringing fantasies to life. Tendi starts her first day as a Senior Science Officer Trainee.

overview.zh: 玛丽娜、鲍姆勒和坦迪与他们的宿敌德尔塔班组发生冲突。喜瑞都号的工程师们开始了强制性度假之旅。
overview.en: Mariner, Boimler and Tendi clash with their arch-rivals: Delta Shift. The Cerritos engineers go on mandatory relaxation leave.

overview.zh: 玛丽娜和鲍姆勒在外星人招聘会上的星际舰队展位工作，卢瑟福挑战自我。
overview.en: Mariner and Boimler work the Starfleet recruitment booth at an alien job fair, Rutherford challenges himself.

overview.zh: 喜瑞都号的船员意外地在深空9号度过一天。
overview.en: The Cerritos crew unexpectedly spends a day on Deep Space Nine.

name.zh: 一次数学上完美的救赎

overview.zh: 一个任性的星际舰队少尉努力寻找救赎之路。
overview.en: A wayward Starfleet ensign struggles to find a path to redemption.

overview.zh: 鲍姆勒的全息甲板电影续集试图比肩原版。
overview.en: Boimler's holodeck movie sequel tries to live up to the original.

overview.zh: 喜瑞都号上的一位来访记者让弗里曼船长紧张不安。
overview.en: A visiting reporter on the Cerritos puts Captain Freeman on edge.

overview.zh: 第三季迎来了大结局，喜瑞都号的船员们必须在一次任务竞赛中证明自己的价值。
overview.en: The Cerritos crew must prove their worth in a mission race.

overview.zh: 《星际迷航：下层舰员》第四季，一股未知力量正在摧毁星舰，威胁银河系的和平。幸运的是，喜瑞都号船员还没重要到会卷入这类大事！马里纳、博伊姆勒、滕迪、卢瑟福与临时少尉特琳继续推进星联生涯，应对晋升、个人成长与各种荒诞的常规任务 —— 直到这场撼动银河的危机，最终降临到他们头上。
overview.en: The fourth season of Star Trek: Lower Decks finds the U.S.S. Cerritos ensigns being challenged in new ways and given new opportunities, while also learning they’ll be “lower decks” for a long time to come.

name.zh: 第 1 集 杜沃斯军团

overview.zh: 喜瑞都少尉必须协助看守人进行具有历史意义的星际飞船的航行。
overview.en: The Cerritos ensigns must assist a caretaker on the voyage of a historically significant starship.

name.zh: 第 2 集 无骨也得跑
name.en: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee

overview.zh: Mariner 试图降职，Rutherford 试图升职，Boimler 做出了一个大动作。
overview.en: Mariner tries to get demoted, Rutherford tries to get promoted, and Boimler makes a big move.

name.zh: 第 3 集 在维西隆的的摇篮里

overview.zh: Boimler 在外星巨型建筑上领导了他的第一次外出任务。
overview.en: Boimler leads his first away mission on an alien megastructure.

name.zh: 第 4 集 一样借，一样绿

overview.zh: Tendi 被召回 Orion 参加婚礼。
overview.en: Tendi is summoned back to Orion for a wedding.

name.zh: 第 5 集 移情病谬误

overview.zh: 三个 Betazoids 在 Cerritos 上造成混乱。
overview.en: A trio of Betazoids cause chaos on the Cerritos.

name.zh: 第 6 集 帕斯的心灵之所

overview.zh: Cerritos 访问了 Ferengi 母星。
overview.en: The Cerritos visits the Ferengi homeworld.

name.zh: 第 7 集 徽章重重

overview.zh: 三个计算机化的恶棍回来给 Cerritos 船员带来麻烦。
overview.en: Three computerized villains return to cause problems for the Cerritos crew.

name.zh: 第 8 集 洞穴回忆

overview.zh: Lower Deckers 执行一项经典的洞穴任务。
overview.en: The Lower Deckers go on a classic cave mission.

name.zh: 第 9 集 心灵之争

overview.zh: 弗里曼船长给 Lower Deckers 分配了一个过于安全的任务，试图让自毁的水手远离危险。
overview.en: Captain Freeman assigns the Lower Deckers an overly safe mission to try and keep a self-destructive Mariner out of danger.

name.zh: 第 10 集 老朋友，新星球

overview.zh: 马里纳面对她的过去。
overview.en: Mariner faces her past.

overview.zh: 《星际迷航：下层舰员》第五季，喜瑞都号船员受命去封堵 “太空坑洼”—— 那些正在阿尔法象限制造混乱的亚空间裂缝。对于马里纳、博伊姆勒、滕迪、卢瑟福这些初级军官而言，封堵裂缝本是简单任务，可他们还要应对猎户座战争、暴怒的克林贡人、外交灾难、谋杀谜案，而最令人忐忑的，是他们自己的职业理想。本季将致敬这群出身底层的船员，他们即将晋升，告别下层舰员身份，迎来星联全新的未知岗位。
overview.en: In season five, the crew of the U.S.S. Cerritos is tasked with closing "space potholes" – subspace rifts that are causing chaos in the Alpha Quadrant. Pothole duty would be easy for Junior Officers Mariner, Boimler, Tendi and Rutherford ... If they didn't also have to deal with an Orion war, furious Klingons, diplomatic catastrophes, murder mysteries and scariest of all: their own career aspirations.

name.zh: 第 1 集 双份喜瑞都号

overview.zh: 空间异常迫使 Cerritos 船员面对自己的面孔。滕迪海盗。
overview.en: A spatial anomaly forces the Cerritos crew to face their own faces. Tendi pirates.

name.zh: 第 2 集 绿色诸相

overview.zh: Tendi竞相阻止冲突，而Boimler和Mariner竞相阻止资本家。
overview.en: Tendi races to stop a conflict while Boimler & Mariner race to stop capitalists.

name.zh: 第 3 集 奇异纳米粒子豪华酒店

overview.zh: Lower Deckers 在度假村捕猎纳米机器人......在太空中？！
overview.en: The Lower Deckers hunt nanites on a resort...in space?!

name.zh: 第 4 集 别了农场

overview.zh: Migleemo 博士会烹制一些热菜，而 Mariner 则喜欢冷菜。
overview.en: Dr. Migleemo cooks up some hot dishes while Mariner prefers hers served cold.

overview.zh: Ransom 使用了过多的消毒凝胶，而 Mariner 则对诅咒感到偏执。
overview.en: Ransom uses too much disinfectant gel while Mariner gets paranoid about curses.

name.zh: 第 6 集 诸神与角度

overview.zh: 水手与一位陷入困境的少尉合作，而喜瑞都则主持文明之间的和平谈判。
overview.en: Mariner teams up with a troubled ensign while the Cerritos hosts peace talks between civilizations.

name.zh: 第 7 集 完全时间膨胀

overview.zh: 这是一场前扭曲社会卧底 Girls Trip！
overview.en: It's a pre-warp society undercover Girls Trip!

name.zh: 第 8 集 	上层舰桥

overview.zh: Lower Deckers 有一个南瓜雕刻派对。
overview.en: The Lower Deckers have a pumpkin carving party.

name.zh: 第 9 集 裂隙求索（上）

overview.zh: 裂缝必须在发炎之前闭合。
overview.en: Fissures must be closed before they get inflamed.

name.zh: 第 10 集 新的下一代（下）

overview.zh: 本季大结局，发生了很多疯狂的事情！
overview.en: Season finale where lots of wild stuff happens!

overview.zh: 《星际迷航：皮卡德》讲述Jean-Luc Picard（Patrick Stewart饰）舰长的新篇章故事，剧中一名年轻女子（Isa Briones饰）正面临危险，因此Jean-Luc Picard决定带她到星际舰队上。
overview.en: Set twenty years after the events of Star Trek Nemesis, we follow the now-retired Admiral Picard into the next chapter of his life.

At the end of the 24th Century, and 14 years after his retirement from Starfleet, Jean-Luc Picard is living a quiet life on his vineyard, Chateau Picard. When he is sought out by a mysterious young woman, Dahj, in need of his help, he soon realizes she may have personal connections to his own past.

overview.zh: 在24世纪末，也就是他从星际舰队退休14年后，让-吕克·皮卡德在他的葡萄园——皮卡德酒庄过着平静的生活。当他被一个神秘的年轻女子达杰找到，需要他的帮助，他很快意识到她可能有个人联系到他的过去。
overview.en: At the end of the 24th Century, and 14 years after his retirement from Starfleet, Jean-Luc Picard is living a quiet life on his vineyard, Chateau Picard. When he is sought out by a mysterious young woman, in need of his help, he soon realizes she may have personal connections to his own past.

overview.zh: 皮卡德开始调查达赫的神秘以及她的存在对联邦意味着什么。没有星际舰队的支持，皮卡德只能依靠其他人的帮助，包括阿格尼斯·朱拉蒂博士和一位疏远的前同事拉菲·穆西克。与此同时，隐藏的敌人也对皮卡德对达赫真相的探索将指向何方感兴趣。
overview.en: Picard begins investigating the mystery of Dahj as well as what her very existence means to the Federation. Without Starfleet's support, Picard is left leaning on others for help, including Dr. Agnes Jurati and an estranged former colleague, Raffi Musiker. Meanwhile, hidden enemies are also interested in where Picard's search for the truth about Dahj will lead.

overview.zh: 索吉继续她的工作，完全没有注意到她的特殊性，并且引起了博格立方研究项目的执行主任的注意。在与一个不情愿的拉菲重温过去的事件后，皮卡德寻找其他愿意加入他对布鲁斯·马多克斯的搜索的人，包括飞行员和前星际舰队军官克里斯托巴尔·里奥斯。
overview.en: Completely unaware of her special nature, Soji continues her work and captures the attention of the Borg cube research project’s executive director. After rehashing past events with a reluctant Raffi, Picard seeks others willing to join his search for Bruce Maddox, including pilot and former Starfleet officer Cristóbal Rios.

overview.zh: 当皮卡德下令在瓦什蒂星球停留时，机组人员前往自由云的旅程绕道而行，14年前，皮卡德和拉菲在瓦什蒂星球重新安置了罗慕兰难民。抵达后，皮卡与埃尔诺团聚，埃尔诺是一个年轻的罗慕兰人，他在搬迁期间成为朋友。与此同时，纳雷克继续尝试了解索吉的更多情况，而纳丽莎对索吉缺乏进步的不耐烦情绪也在增长。
overview.en: The crew's journey to Freecloud takes a detour when Picard orders a stop at the planet Vashti, where Picard and Raffi relocated Romulan refugees fourteen years earlier. Upon arrival, Picard reunites with Elnor, a young Romulan he befriended during the relocation. Meanwhile, Narek continues his attempts to learn more about Soji while Narissa's impatience with his lack of progress grows.

overview.zh: 拉塞雷纳号船员开始了一次不可预测的、充满活力的探险，在弗里克劳德号上搜寻布鲁斯·马多克斯。当他们得知马多克斯的处境岌岌可危时，一张熟悉的面孔向她伸出援手。
overview.en: The La Sirena crew begins an unpredictable and lively expedition on Freecloud to search for Bruce Maddox. When they learn that Maddox has found himself in a precarious situation, a familiar face offers her assistance.

overview.zh: 皮卡德和机组人员追踪索吉到罗慕兰太空中的博格立方体，为皮卡德重新浮现出萦绕的记忆。与此同时，纳雷克相信他终于找到了一种安全利用索吉获取信息的方法。
overview.en: Picard and the crew track Soji to the Borg cube in Romulan space, resurfacing haunting memories for Picard. Meanwhile, Narek believes he finally found a way to safely exploit Soji for information.

overview.zh: 皮卡德和索吉前往尼彭斯星球，那里有一些老朋友和值得信赖的朋友。当拉塞琳娜剧组的其他成员试图加入他们时，皮卡德帮助索吉分析她最近被解开的记忆。与此同时，休和埃尔诺被留在博格魔方，必须面对愤怒的纳丽莎。
overview.en: Picard and Soji transport to the planet Nepenthe, home to some old and trusted friends. As the rest of the La Sirena crew attempt to join them, Picard helps Soji make sense of her recently unlocked memories. Meanwhile, Hugh and Elnor are left on the Borg cube and must face an angered Narissa.

overview.zh: 当火星袭击背后毁灭性的真相被揭露时，皮卡德意识到，在拉塞雷纳号船员努力处理自己的秘密和揭露的同时，还有多少人将要去保存延续几代人的秘密。纳瑞莎指挥她的警卫抓住埃尔诺，在博格立方体上引发了一连串意想不到的事件。
overview.en: When devastating truths behind the Mars attack are revealed, Picard realizes just how far many will go to preserve secrets stretching back generations, all while the La Sirena crew grapples with secrets and revelations of their own. Narissa directs her guards to capture Elnor, setting off an unexpected chain of events on the Borg cube.

overview.zh: 在一次不正常的危险运输之后，皮卡德和船员们终于抵达索吉的家乡科佩利厄斯，但是他们却被罗慕兰战鸟跟踪，它们的到来只会带来更大的危险，因为机组人员获得了比预期更多的关于地球居民的信息。
overview.en: Following an unconventional and dangerous transit, Picard and the crew finally arrive at Soji's home world, Coppelius. However, with Romulan warbirds on their tail, their arrival brings only greater danger as the crew discovers more than expected about the planet’s inhabitants.

overview.zh: 在本季的最后一场对决中，科佩利厄斯、皮卡德团队、罗慕兰人以及那些不惜一切代价保护自己生存的合成人展开了最后的对决。
overview.en: A final confrontation on the synthetics’ homeworld, Coppelius pits Picard and his team against the Romulans, as well as the synths who seek to safeguard their existence at all costs.

Season two takes the legendary Jean-Luc Picard and his crew on a bold and exciting new journey: into the past. Picard must enlist friends both old and new to confront the perils of 21st century Earth in a desperate race against time to save the galaxy’s future – and face the ultimate trial from one of his greatest foes.

overview.zh: 星际舰队必须再次召回传奇人物让-吕克·皮卡尔，因为他昔日的船员克里斯托巴尔·里欧斯、九之七、拉菲·穆斯卡和艾格妮丝·朱拉蒂博士在太空中发现了一个威胁银河系的异常。
overview.en: Starfleet must once again call on legendary Jean-Luc Picard after members of his former crew – Cristóbal Rios, Seven of Nine, Raffi Musiker, and Dr. Agnes Jurati – discover an anomaly in space that threatens the galaxy.

overview.zh: 皮卡德发现自己被传送到2400年的一条被替代的时间线中，这是他的老对手Q所安排的最终“试炼”。皮卡德在弄清楚造成这个反乌托邦式未来的原因时，也在寻找深受自己信赖的舰员。
overview.en: Picard finds himself transported to an alternate timeline in the year 2400 where his longtime nemesis, Q, has orchestrated one final “trial.” Picard searches for his trusted crew as he attempts to find the cause of this dystopian future.

overview.zh: 皮卡德和船员回到2024年的洛杉矶寻找“守望者”。对方能帮他们确定发生时间偏离的时刻。七、拉菲和瑞奥斯冒险回到400年前那个陌生的世界，皮卡德和朱拉提试图从一个不太可能且危险的盟友那里获取信息。
overview.en: Picard and the crew travel back to 2024 Los Angeles in search of the “Watcher,” who can help them identify the point at which time diverged. Seven, Raffi and Rios venture out into an unfamiliar world 400 years in their past, while Picard and Jurati attempt to gather information from an unlikely, and dangerous, ally.

overview.zh: 随着拯救未来的时间越来越少，皮卡尔决定亲自动手，并向一位老朋友寻求帮助。与此同时，里欧斯最终触犯了法律，朱拉蒂与博格女王达成了协议。
overview.en: With time running out to save the future, Picard takes matters into his own hands and seeks out an old friend for help. Meanwhile, Rios ends up on the wrong side of the law and Jurati makes a deal with the Borg Queen.

overview.zh: 皮卡德发现他的一位旧识可能是时间线发生偏离的重要因素。Q继续操纵时间线，并对亚当宋博士产生兴趣。七和拉菲欲放手一搏营救瑞奥斯，而朱拉提则须承担与博格女皇交易的后果。
overview.en: Picard discovers an important person from his past may be integral to the divergence in the timeline. Q continues his manipulation of the timeline, taking an interest in Dr. Adam Soong. Seven and Raffi attempt a daring rescue of Rios, while Jurati faces the consequences of her deal with the Borg Queen.

overview.zh: 在塔林的帮助下，皮卡尔和船员们潜入了一场在联合太空任务前夕召开的盛会，以保护他们认为对恢复时间线至关重要的一名宇航员——蕾妮·皮卡尔。科莱对她父亲的工作有了一个惊人的发现。
overview.en: With the help of Tallinn, Picard and the crew infiltrate a gala on the eve of a joint space mission, to protect one of the astronauts they believe to be integral to the restoration of the timeline – Renee Picard. Kore makes a startling discovery about her father’s work.

overview.zh: 塔林冒险进入皮卡德的潜意识，以期将其从昏迷中唤醒并直面他最黑暗的秘密与最深处的恐惧。七和拉菲恐朱拉提已臣服于内心的恶魔而开始寻找她。瑞奥斯极力向特蕾莎隐瞒他的真实身份。
overview.en: Tallinn ventures inside Picard’s subconscious mind to help wake him from a coma and face both his darkest secrets and deepest fears. Seven and Raffi go in search of Jurati whom they fear has succumbed to the monster inside. Rios struggles to hide the truth of who he really is from Teresa.

overview.zh: 木卫二任务发射在即，皮卡德与盖南必须想办法从联邦调查局脱身。七和拉菲与朱拉提化身的恶魔对峙。
overview.en: With time running out before the launch of the Europa Mission, Picard and Guinan must free themselves from FBI custody. Seven and Raffi come face-to-face with Jurati and the horror of what she's become.

overview.zh: 宿敌新化身来犯，皮卡德及舰员们为保全性命奋力一战。为了求生，皮卡德须先面对往日幽灵。七和拉菲与朱拉提决一死战。
overview.en: Picard and his crew fight for their lives as they come under attack from a new incarnation of an old enemy. But to survive, Picard must first face the ghosts of his past. Seven and Raffi have a final showdown with Jurati.

overview.zh: 第二季剧终，距木卫二发射只剩数小时，皮卡德及舰员们为拯救未来与时间赛跑。
overview.en: With just hours until the Europa launch, Picard and the crew find themselves in a race against time to save the future.

In season three, a desperate message from a long-lost friend draws Starfleet legend Admiral Jean-Luc Picard into the most daring mission of his life, forcing him to recruit allies spanning generations old and new. This final adventure sets him on a collision course with the legacy of his past and explosive, new revelations that will alter the fate of the Federation forever.

overview.zh: 在接到贝弗莉克拉夏医生神秘的紧急求救呼叫后，让卢克皮卡德上将寻求新老几代人的帮助，启航开始了最后的冒险之旅：一项将永远改变星际舰队和他老舰员们的大胆任务。
overview.en: After receiving a cryptic, urgent distress call from Dr. Beverly Crusher, Admiral Jean-Luc Picard enlists help from generations old and new to embark on one final adventure: a daring mission that will change Starfleet, and his old crew forever.

overview.zh: 在九之七和联邦星舰泰坦号舰员的帮助下，皮卡德有了一个令人震惊的发现，这将永远改变他的生活—并使他与其今生最狡猾的敌人发生冲突。与此同时，拉菲在争分夺秒地追踪一种毁灭性武器—并与一个熟悉的盟友发生了冲突。
overview.en: Aided by Seven of Nine and the crew of the U.S.S. Titan, Picard makes a shocking discovery that will alter his life forever – and puts him on a collision course with the most cunning enemy he’s ever encountered. Meanwhile, Raffi races to track a catastrophic weapon – and collides with a familiar ally.

overview.zh: 皮卡德要努力解决一个爆炸性的、将会让其生活天翻地覆的意外发现。而泰坦号和它的舰员则试图在一场致命的星海猫鼠游戏中战胜不择手段的瓦迪奇。同时，拉菲和武夫发现了一个邪恶阴谋，策划者是一个被星际舰队遗忘已久，却仍愤愤不平的宿敌。
overview.en: Picard grapples with an explosive, life-altering revelation, while the Titan and her crew try to outmaneuver a relentless Vadic in a lethal game of nautical cat and mouse. Meanwhile, Raffi and Worf uncover a nefarious plot from a vengeful enemy Starfleet has long since forgotten.

overview.zh: 时间越来越紧迫，皮卡德、瑞克和舰员们必须面对他们在过去犯下的罪责，治愈新的创伤。而泰坦号则动弹不得，在一个神秘的空间异常中无助地漂向毁灭。
overview.en: With time running out, Picard, Riker and crew must confront the sins of their past and heal fresh wounds, while the Titan, dead in the water, drifts helplessly toward certain destruction within a mysterious space anomaly.

overview.zh: 卡德被星际舰队逮捕并面临军事法庭的审判。他努力探求过往一名归来舰员的目的，是盟友，还是一个一心想要毁灭他们所有人的敌人。在这过程中，他越来越疑神疑鬼。
overview.en: Caught by Starfleet and facing court martial, paranoia grows as Picard struggles to uncover whether a prodigal crewman from his past has returned as an ally – or an enemy hellbent on destroying them all.

overview.zh: 现在，皮卡德和联邦星舰泰坦号的几名舰员正在逃亡。他们必须闯入星际舰队的绝密机构，揭露一个可能会摧毁联邦的阴谋。皮卡德必须求助于银河系中唯一能帮助他的人—一位老友。
overview.en: Now on the run, Picard and the skeleton crew of the U.S.S. Titan must break into Starfleet's most top-secret facility to expose a plot that could destroy the Federation. Picard must turn to the only soul in the galaxy who can help: an old friend.

overview.zh: 皮卡德陷入困境，走投无路，他谋划了一场豪赌，以困住瓦迪奇并揭露她的真实动机。这场豪赌让泰坦号成为各方狙击的目标，迫使皮卡德和贝弗莉质疑所有他们曾经坚定不移的道德准则。
overview.en: Crippled, cornered, and out of options, Picard stages a gambit to trap Vadic and reveal her true motive – a gamble that puts the Titan in the crosshairs and forces Picard and Beverly to question every moral code they’ve ever held.

overview.zh: 瓦迪奇迫使皮卡德做出一个不可能的选择：交出他永远无法给予的东西...或者看着他的舰员们逝去。他们唯一的救赎就在一个老朋友和老对手的思想中。
overview.en: Vadic forces Picard to make an impossible choice: deliver what he can never give... or watch his crew perish. Their only salvation lies in the mind of an old friend and old foe.

overview.zh: 关于杰克的毁灭性真相永远改变了皮卡德的人生轨迹，并揭示了一个会威胁到联邦中每个生命的真相。最终之战开始了，皮卡德和他的舰员们为了从毁灭中拯救银河系争分夺秒，但也付出了惨痛的代价。
overview.en: A devastating revelation about Jack alters the course of Picard’s life forever – and uncovers a truth that threatens every soul in the Federation. The final battle begins as Picard and his crew race to save the galaxy from annihilation – but not without a gut-wrenching cost.

overview.zh: 在绝望的最后一战中，让卢克皮卡德和几代新老舰员一起战斗，从他们遇到过的最大威胁中拯救银河系，《星际迷航：下一代》的传奇故事也迎来了令人激动的史诗般结局。
overview.en: In a desperate last stand, Jean-Luc Picard and generations of crews both old and new fight together to save the galaxy from the greatest threat they’ve ever faced.

overview.zh: 继CBS All Access过去预订成人向动画剧《星际迷航：下层舰员 Star Trek: Lower Decks》后，Nickelodeon现在宣布要制作一部面向年轻观众的《星际迷航 Star Trek》动画剧，由兄弟档Kevin及Dan Hageman负责。这部动画讲述一群无法无天的青少年意外发现一艘废弃星舰，而他们决定用它来进行探险、寻找目标及找到自己的救赎。
overview.en: A motley crew of young rebellious aliens commandeer an old Starfleet ship and must figure out how to work together while navigating a greater galaxy, in search for a better future. These six young outcasts know nothing about the ship they have commandeered, but over the course of their adventures together, they will each be introduced to Starfleet and the ideals it represents.

overview.zh: 在发现一艘废弃的星际舰队飞船后，一群衣衫褴褛的年轻冒险家联合起来探索银河系，躲避无情的霸主。
overview.en: After discovering an abandoned Starfleet ship, a ragtag crew of young adventurers unites to explore the galaxy and evade a ruthless overlord.

name.zh: 失物招领（上）/ 失物招领（下）

overview.zh: 一群无法无天的青少年被流放到联邦空间外的一个采矿殖民地，在那里他们发现了一艘废弃的星际舰队船只。Dal 必须为他们新发现的这艘船招募一支不太可能的船员，如果他们想逃离塔尔斯·拉莫拉的话。但是，预言者和他的女儿格温却有其他计划。
overview.en: A group of lawless teens, exiled on a mining colony outside Federation space, discover a derelict Starfleet ship. Dal must gather an unlikely crew for their newfound ship if they are going to escape Tars Lamora, but the Diviner and his daughter Gwyn have other plans.

overview.zh: 在全息影像顾问珍妮薇的指导下，《原星号》的船员们在飞船处于危险的宇宙碰撞航线时接受了考验。
overview.en: Even with the guidance of their hologram advisor Janeway, the crew of The Protostar is tested when their ship is on a dangerous cosmic collision course.

overview.zh: 船员们首次执行登陆任务，目的地是一颗能将他们内心最深层渴望具象化的未被发现星球。然而很快他们便意识到，这颗星球本身也有着属于自己的 “欲望”。
overview.en: The crew has their first away mission on an undiscovered planet that manifests their deepest desires, only to realize the planet has desires of its own.

overview.zh: 船员们被困在一颗致命的星球上，为了活下去，他们必须与被俘虏的格温（Gwyn）联手合作 —— 但要注意，此刻紧追不舍的可不止这颗星球。
overview.en: Marooned on a deadly planet, the crew must work together with their captive Gwyn to stay alive…except the planet isn’t the only thing in pursuit.

overview.zh: 船员们被困在一颗致命的星球上，为了活下去，他们必须与被俘虏的格温联手合作…… 但值得警惕的是，紧追不舍的并非只有这颗星球本身。与此同时，格温在 “原星号”上努力寻找自己的定位，而达尔则在新发现的全息甲板中，测试着自己的领导能力。
overview.en: As Gwyn struggles to find her role aboard the U.S.S. Protostar, Dal tests his leadership skills in the newly discovered holodeck.

overview.zh: 当一位来自达尔过去的导师，劝说他利用联邦的身份掩护谋取私利时，众人很快便意识到 —— 星际舰队制定那些规章制度，绝非毫无缘由。
overview.en: When a mentor from Dal’s past persuades him to use their Federation cover for personal gain, they quickly discover Starfleet has protocols for a reason.

overview.zh: 当 “原星号”被一处时空异常撕裂、陷入时间错位状态时，珍妮薇全息影像必须让分散在不同时空片段的船员重新同步，还要在星舰解体前拯救这艘船。
overview.en: When the U.S.S. Protostar is fractured in time by an anomaly, Hologram Janeway must synchronize the disjointed crew and save their ship before it destructs.

overview.zh: 当 “原星号”被一处时空异常撕裂、陷入时空错乱状态时，珍妮薇全息影像必须让分散在不同时空的船员重新同步，在星舰解体前挽救它。而在一场注定 “无解” 的困境中，船员们不得不放弃加入星际舰队的梦想，选择返回塔尔斯拉莫拉。
overview.en: The crew forgo their dreams of Starfleet to return to Tars Lamora in a no-win scenario.

overview.zh: 当计划意外失控时，船员们不得不随机应变。与此同时，格温发现了一个残酷的真相 —— 这个真相将永远威胁到他们追寻救赎的征程。
overview.en: When the plan goes awry, the crew must improvise. Meanwhile, Gwyn discovers a dark truth that will forever jeopardize their quest toward salvation.

overview.zh: 在永久离开塔尔斯・拉莫拉（Tars Lamora）几周后，船员们一直在积累善举，希望星际舰队能忽略他们曾 “偷走” 星舰（即 “原星号” U.S.S. Protostar）的事实，并接纳他们加入。他们前往联邦空间边缘最近的通讯中继站，希望能在这里获得收容，找到一个能接纳他们的地方。
overview.en: At the edge of Federation space, the crew applies for asylum at a comm relay outpost, only for their starship to reveal its shocking true purpose.

overview.zh: 当船员们遭遇一艘处于休眠状态的博格方块时，泽洛为了拯救他们的星舰，不惜赌上一切。
overview.en: When the crew encounters a dormant Borg Cube, Zero risks everything to save their ship.

overview.zh: 船员们响应了一则求救信号，却发现求救的殖民地竟被困在了星际舰队的 “过去” 之中。
overview.en: The crew answers a distress call to find a colony trapped in Starfleet's past.

overview.zh: 当船员们试图找到交通工具前往联邦时，却在无意间与正在追捕他们的那位上将不期而遇。
overview.en: When the crew attempts to secure transport to the Federation, they unwittingly cross paths with the Vice Admiral who is hunting them.

overview.zh: 船员们被困在中立区时，遇到了一位叛逃的遗传学家 —— 此人揭开了达尔过往的关键秘密。
overview.en: Trapped in the Neutral Zone, the crew encounters a rogue geneticist who sheds light on Dal’s past.

overview.zh: 一位星际舰队上将深入调查 “原星号”船员们的过往。与此同时，“占卜者”也回忆起了自己毕生的使命。
overview.en: A Starfleet Admiral digs into the past of the Protostar crew. Meanwhile, the Diviner recalls his life's mission.

overview.zh: 当船员们因全息甲板发生神秘故障而被困其中时，他们根本无法分辨眼前的一切是程序设定，还是真实存在。
overview.en: When the crew gets trapped in the holodeck by a mysterious malfunction, they aren't sure what's programmed or what's real.

overview.zh: 达尔迫切想要向星际舰队警示他们当前的困境，为此开展了一项大胆的实验 —— 然而实验意外失控，达尔不慎与一位星际舰队上将互换了意识。
overview.en: Desperate to warn Starfleet of their dilemma, a daring experiment goes awry as Dal inadvertently swaps minds with a Starfleet Vice Admiral.

overview.zh: 在星际舰队的重重包围下，船员们竭力阻止自己的星舰摧毁整个星际舰队
overview.en: Surrounded by the Federation armada, the crew attempts to stop their ship from destroying all of Starfleet.

overview.zh: 当联邦的命运悬而未决时，船员们必须做出终极牺牲，以拯救星际舰队的未来。
overview.en: As the Federation hangs in the balance, the crew must make the ultimate sacrifice to save Starfleet's future.

overview.zh: 现在星际舰队的学员，达尔和他的朋友们开始了另一场冒险，以解决《原星号》的神秘面纱，并拯救一个星球免于毁灭。
overview.en: Now Starfleet trainees, Dal and his friends embark on another adventure to solve the mystery of the Protostar and save a planet from destruction.

overview.zh: 达尔和朋友们登上珍妮薇的星舰，前去调查由 “原星号”引发的虫洞。而达尔早已厌倦了训练，迫切渴望能参与一场真正的行动。
overview.en: Dal and his friends board Janeway's starship to investigate the wormhole created by the Protostar. Tired of his training, Dal longs for some action.

overview.zh: 格温在索卢姆星球上遭遇了一位熟悉的敌人。与此同时，珍妮薇向达尔和他的朋友们揭露了此次任务背后真正的风险与关键利害。
overview.en: Gwyn runs into a familiar foe on the planet Solum. Janeway reveals the true stakes of their mission to Dal and his friends.

overview.zh: 达尔与船员们穿越时间裂缝，前往索卢姆星搜寻查可泰；与此同时，格温在父亲的支持下，向阿森西亚发起了挑战。
overview.en: Traveling through the time rift, Dal and the crew search for Chakotay on Solum. With the support of her father, Gwyn challenges Asencia.

overview.zh: 尽管相隔数十年，“无限号”与 “航海家号”的船员们还是联手拯救了格温的性命。与此同时，一位神秘使者主动联系了格温。
overview.en: Although separated by decades, the Infinity and the Voyager crews band together to save Gwyn's life. A mysterious messenger reaches out to Gwyn.

overview.zh: 在 “航海家号” 上重聚后，众人处于严密监管之下，他们必须破解神秘资助人留给莫夫的一条秘密信息。
overview.en: Reunited on the Voyager and under strict supervision, the gang must decode a secret message their mysterious benefactor left with Murf.

overview.zh: 为了在 “无限号” 按计划销毁前劫持它，达尔与船员们制作了全息替身，以掩盖他们的缺席。
overview.en: Hoping to hijack the Infinity before its scheduled destruction, Dal and the crew create hologram doubles to cover for their absence.

overview.zh: 达尔和朋友们借助博格传送通道实现了更快的时间穿越后，发现自己落入了一名难缠的卡松人手中，处境由对方掌控。
overview.en: After using a Borg conduit to travel through time faster, Dal and his friends find themselves at the mercy of a demanding Kazon.

name.en: Is There in Beauty No Truth?

overview.zh: 船员们绕道前往一个非实体生物聚居地，那里的生物为泽罗提供了获得实体身躯的机会。与此同时，珍妮薇发现了达尔的真实意图。
overview.en: The crew detours to a colony of non-corporeal entities, who offer Zero an opportunity to obtain a physical body. Janeway discovers Dal's real intentions.

overview.zh: 终于抵达坐标位置后，“无限号” 的船员们发现了一颗隐秘星球 —— 同时也揭开了他们期盼已久的神秘信使的真实身份。
overview.en: Finally arriving at the coordinates, the Infinity crew discovers a hidden planet – and the long-awaited identity of their mysterious messenger.

overview.zh: “无限号” 船员及其新盟友在能消除时间的追击者的追捕下四处逃亡，同时寻找逃生之路。“航海家号” 则启动了救援行动。
overview.en: On the run from their time-erasing pursuers, the Infinity crew and their new ally search for an escape. The Voyager embarks on a rescue mission.

overview.zh: 多亏韦斯利・克拉舍的及时介入，学员们找到了 “原星号”—— 但这艘星舰上被困的守护者，却并不愿意接受他们的帮助。
overview.en: Thanks to Wesley Crusher's timely intervention, the cadets find the Protostar — but the ship's marooned guardian isn't eager for their assistance.

overview.zh: 查克泰与学员们制定了一个大胆却危险的计划，意图让 “原星号” 重新启航。然而，在这艘星舰能够升空之前，它必须先完成 “航行” 这一步。
overview.en: Chakotay and the cadets devise a bold but perilous plan to relaunch the Protostar. Before the ship can fly, however, it will first have to sail.

overview.zh: 在一颗荒芜星球采集玻色子矿时，船员们遭遇了极具攻击性的基因改造 Tribble—— 以及创造出它们的克林贡科学家。
overview.en: While harvesting bosonite on a barren world, the crew encounters aggressive, genetically-modified tribbles — and the Klingon scientist who created them.

overview.zh: “原星号” 与 “航海家号” 重逢后，引发了意想不到的副作用 —— 船员们在多个平行现实间不断穿梭，其中还包括镜像宇宙。
overview.en: The Protostar's reunion with Voyager has unexpected side effects, bouncing the crew between alternate realities — including the Mirror Universe.

overview.zh: 正当 “原星号” 与 “航海家号” 的船员们即将完成任务之际，一位昔日的敌人突然携惊人的新能力再度现身。
overview.en: Just as the Protostar and Voyager crews bring their mission to a close, a former enemy suddenly resurfaces with surprising new powers.

overview.zh: 面对阿森西亚拥有的神秘先进武器，“原星号” 与 “航海家号” 的船员们陷入了被动，他们不得不采取一系列精心谋划却让学员们身陷险境的冒险举措。
overview.en: Overwhelmed by Asencia's mysteriously advanced weaponry, the Protostar and Voyager crews take a series of calculated risks that endanger the cadets.

overview.zh: 联邦与索卢姆之间的战争一触即发，格温提议带领学员们执行一项卧底任务 —— 既要搜集情报，也要营救伊尔图兰。
overview.en: As war looms between the Federation and Solum, Gwyn proposes to lead the cadets on an undercover mission to gather intelligence and rescue Ilthuran.

overview.zh: 珍妮薇上将制定了一个巧妙的计划，旨在将她的船员从阿森西亚的监狱中解救出来 —— 此刻她的船员们正被困在那里，还与一名来自 “织机”的愤怒俘虏共处一室。
overview.en: Admiral Janeway devises a clever plan to liberate her crew from Asencia's prison, where they're trapped with an angry captive from the Loom.

overview.zh: 走投无路的阿森西亚对联邦发动了全面进攻 —— 这场进攻足以摧毁亚空间；与此同时，韦斯利和学员们正试图修正时间线，以阻止灾难发生。
overview.en: A desperate Asencia launches an all-out attack on the Federation that will destroy subspace, while Wesley and the cadets try to correct the timeline.

overview.zh: 学员们与阿森西亚展开激战，争夺对索卢姆及未来的控制权 —— 但一个极具破坏性的物种突然入侵，让他们的最终计划陷入了混乱。
overview.en: The cadets fight Asencia in a battle for control of Solum and the future — but a sudden invasion by a destructive species complicates their end-game.

overview.zh: 克里斯托弗·派克舰长率领企业号船员探索未知星系，寻找新世界与新生命，在一次次星际冒险中面对外星威胁、个人命运与联邦理想的考验。
overview.en: Follow Captain Christopher Pike, Science Officer Spock and Number One in the years before Captain Kirk boarded the U.S.S. Enterprise, as they explore new worlds around the galaxy.

overview.zh: 克里斯托弗·派克舰长得知自己注定会在数年后死于一场事故，却仍率领企业号探索未知世界。在接触新文明、遭遇外星威胁的同时，他也开始思考如何面对无法改变的命运。
当派克的一名军官在执行星际舰队的秘密任务时失踪，派克不得不从自我放逐中走出来。在他不知如何面对已预知未来的同时必须想方设法营救他的手下。
overview.en: When one of Pike’s officers goes missing while on a secret mission for Starfleet, Pike has to come out of self-imposed exile. He must navigate how to rescue his officer, while struggling with what to do with the vision of the future he’s been given.

overview.zh: 一个古老的外星遗物阻止了企业号机组人员将一颗彗星重新引导到轨道上以袭击一个有人居住的星球。
overview.en: While on a survey mission, the U.S.S. Enterprise discovers a comet is going to strike an inhabited planet. They try to re-route the comet, only to find that an ancient alien relic buried on the comet’s icy surface is somehow stopping them. As the away team try to unlock the relic’s secrets, Pike and Number One deal with a group of zealots who want to prevent the U.S.S. Enterprise from interfering.

overview.zh: 尤娜必须面对一个她一直隐藏的秘密，当时一种传染病席卷了这艘船，使其他船员失去了行动能力。
overview.en: The U.S.S. Enterprise encounters a contagion that ravages the ship. One by one, the entire crew is incapacitated except for Number One, Una Chin-Riley, who must now confront a secret she’s been hiding as she races to find a cure.

overview.zh: 派克必须找到独特的星际舰队方法来对付攻击企业号的邪恶力量。
overview.en: While on a routine supply mission to a colony planet, the U.S.S. Enterprise comes under an attack from an unknown malevolent force. Pike brings all his heart and experience to bear in facing the crisis, but the security officer warns him that the enemy cannot be dealt with by conventional Starfleet means.

overview.zh: 在斯波克和派克与一个不寻常的外星物种的关键谈判中，一个人出现引发了一场错误喜剧。
overview.en: It’s a comedy of manners when Spock has a personal visit in the middle of Spock and Captain Pike’s crucial negotiations with an unusual alien species.

name.zh: 请带我们到苦难无可触及之地
name.en: Lift Us Where Suffering Cannot Reach

overview.zh: 一个威胁使派克船长与他最爱的人重聚在这个美好的星球。为了保护她和一位科学圣童免遭阴谋迫害，派克提供了帮助，并被迫面对他过去未解决的感情。
overview.en: A threat to an idyllic planet reunites Captain Pike with the lost love of his life. To protect her and a scientific holy child from a conspiracy, Pike offers his help and is forced to face unresolved feelings of his past.

overview.zh: 在执行一项危险的人道主义任务时，企业号船员与整个象限中最致命的太空海盗陷入了一场令人痛心的杠杆游戏。
overview.en: While on a dangerous humanitarian mission, the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise stumbles into a harrowing game of leverage with the quadrant’s deadliest space pirate.

overview.zh: 企业号被困在一个星云中，这个星云是一个外星人意识的家园，它将船员们困在一个童话故事中。
overview.en: The U.S.S. Enterprise becomes stuck in a nebula that is home to an alien consciousness that traps the crew in a fairy tale.

overview.zh: 企业号船员在面对自己的恶魔和怪物的同时，他们的登陆队与一个贪婪的敌人困在了一个贫瘠的星球上。
overview.en: The U.S.S. Enterprise crew comes face-to-face with their demons – and scary monsters too – when their landing party is stranded on a barren planet with a ravenous enemy.

overview.zh: 就在派克船长认为他已经找到了摆脱命运的方法时，未来的自己拜访了他，并向他展示了自己行为的后果。
overview.en: Just as Captain Pike thinks he's figured out how to escape his fate, he's visited by his future self, who shows him the consequences of his actions.

overview.zh: 企业号继续执行深空探索任务，船员们遭遇克林贡冲突、时间异常和全新外星文明。与此同时，派克与船员们各自面对感情、信念与舰队职责的抉择。
overview.en: In season two, the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise, under the command of Captain Christopher Pike, confronts increasingly dangerous stakes, explores uncharted territories and encounters new life and civilizations. The crew will also embark on personal journeys that will continue to test their resolve and redefine their destinies. Facing friends and enemies both new and familiar, their adventures will unfold in surprising ways never seen before.

overview.zh: 努尼恩-辛格中尉发出的求救信号迫使斯波克违抗命令并占领了星舰。企业号及其船员冒着与克林贡人再次发生敌对的风险进入有争议的太空，以帮助他们的船友。
overview.en: A distress call from Lt. Noonien-Singh compels Spock to disobey orders and take the U.S.S. Enterprise and its crew into disputed space, risking renewed hostilities with the Klingons in a bid to aid their shipmate.

overview.zh: 乌娜指挥官面临军事法庭审判，还可能被监禁，并被星际舰队不光彩地解雇，她的辩护由一名律师负责，该律师也是她儿时的朋友，与她发生了严重的争吵。
overview.en: Commander Una faces court-martial along with possible imprisonment and dishonorable dismissal from Starfleet, and her defense is in the hands of a lawyer who’s also a childhood friend with whom she had a terrible falling out.

overview.zh: 拉安回到二十一世纪的地球，阻止一场将改变人类未来历史的袭击，并让她面对自己有争议的遗产。
overview.en: La'an travels back in time to twenty-first-century Earth to prevent an attack which will alter humanity’s future history—and bring her face to face with her own contentious legacy.

overview.zh: 回到一个唤起悲惨记忆的星球，派克船长和他的登陆小组发现自己忘记了一切，包括当他面对过去的幽灵时他们自己的身份。
overview.en: Returning to a planet that dredges up tragic memories, Captain Pike and his landing party find themselves forgetting everything, including their own identities as he confronts a ghost from his past.

overview.zh: 一次航天飞机事故导致斯波克的瓦肯 DNA 被外星人移除，使他完全成为人类，并且完全没有准备好在重要的晚宴上面对提'萍的家人。
overview.en: A shuttle accident leads to Spock's Vulcan DNA being removed by aliens, making him fully human and completely unprepared to face T'Pring's family during an important ceremonial dinner.

overview.zh: 乌胡拉似乎是唯一能听到奇怪声音的人。当噪音引发可怕的幻觉时，她找了一位不太可能的助手来帮助她追踪噪音源。
overview.en: Uhura seems to be the only one who can hear a strange sound. When the noise triggers terrifying hallucinations, she enlists an unlikely assistant to help her track down the source.

overview.zh: 调查时间门户时发生的事故让少尉布拉德·博伊姆勒穿越到了二十四世纪，派克船长和他的船员必须让他回到属于他的地方，然后才能以某种方式改变时间线。
overview.en: An accident while investigating a time portal sends Ensign Brad Boimler through time from the twenty-fourth century, and Captain Pike and his crew must get him back where he belongs before he can somehow alter the timeline.

overview.zh: 派克船长和他的船员在企业号上欢迎一名克林贡叛逃者企业号，但他的出现引发了一些令人震惊的秘密的揭露。
overview.en: Captain Pike and his crew welcome a Klingon defector aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise, but his presence triggers the revelation of some shocking secrets.

overview.zh: 一场实验量子概率场的事故导致企业号上的每个人都陷入困境。企业号无法控制地开始歌唱，但真正的危险是这个领域正在扩大并开始影响其他船只——盟友和敌人。
overview.en: An accident with an experimental quantum probability field causes everyone on the U.S.S. Enterprise to break uncontrollably into song, but the real danger is that the field is expanding and beginning to impact other ships—allies and enemies alike.

overview.zh: 当美国企业号调查联邦太空边缘殖民地遭受的袭击，派克船长和他的船员面临着强大敌人的回归。
overview.en: When the U.S.S. Enterprise investigates an attack on a colony at the edge of Federation space, Captain Pike and his crew face the return of a formidable enemy.

overview.zh: 企业号从戈恩危机中幸存下来，却发现新的威胁正在逼近。派克和船员们继续探索未知星域，并在一次次任务中面对外星势力、时间异常与自身命运的改变。
overview.en: In season three, when we reconnect with the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise, still under the command of Captain Pike, they face the conclusion of season two's harrowing encounter with the Gorn. But new life and civilizations await, including a villain that will test our characters' grit and resolve. An exciting twist on classic Star Trek, season three takes characters both new and beloved to new heights, and dives into thrilling adventures of faith, duty, romance, comedy and mystery, with varying genres never before seen on any other Star Trek.

overview.zh: 当登陆小队躲避致命敌人的追击时，派克舰长在敌人后方领导了一次危险的营救行动。
overview.en: Pike leads a risky rescue behind enemy lines as the landing party flees a deadly enemy.

overview.zh: 在一次联邦庆典中，一位不速之客打断了史波克与船员们的思绪。
overview.en: At a Federation celebration, an uninvited guest disrupts Spock and the crew's reflections.

overview.zh: 派克与姆'本加深入克林贡争议区，为巴特尔舰长寻药，却在一颗致命生物横行的星球上，揭开了姆'本加尘封的过往。
overview.en: Pike and M'Benga enter Klingon space for Batel's cure as M'Benga's past returns on a deadly world.

overview.zh: 拉安测试全息甲板原型机，破解一桩唯她能解的虚构谜案，然而失败的代价层层升级，最终令企业号危在旦夕。
overview.en: La'An tests a prototype holodeck with a fictional case only she can solve.

overview.zh: 查佩尔与科尔比的探索之旅，将企业号引向了隐藏着黑暗秘密的古老遗迹。
overview.en: Chapel and Korby's quest leads the Enterprise to ancient ruins hiding a dark secret.

name.en: The Sehlat Who Ate Its Tail

overview.zh: 柯克担任舰长的第一天便遭遇灾难——一艘掠夺者飞船劫持了企业号。
overview.en: Kirk's first day as captain turns disastrous when a Scavenger Ship seizes the Enterprise.

overview.zh: 在援助一个饱受战争摧残的星球时，派克和船员们面临着一位调查记者的严密审查。
overview.en: While aiding a war-torn planet, Pike and crew face scrutiny from a probing journalist.

overview.zh: 当任务将船员转变为瓦肯人后，他们试图恢复人类形态时便引发了麻烦。
overview.en: After a mission turns crew members into Vulcans, trouble arises when they try to revert to human.

overview.zh: 被困在有毒的月球上，奥尔特加必须违背她最深的信念才能生存。
overview.en: Stranded on a toxic moon, Ortegas must defy her deepest beliefs to survive.

overview.zh: 当远古邪恶再度现世，派克面临着改变人生的抉择——阻止它。
overview.en: When an ancient evil resurfaces, Pike faces a life-altering choice to stop it.

overview.zh: 企业号继续穿梭于未知星域，在时空异常、外星文明和各种超自然事件中执行任务。随着新的威胁出现，派克与船员们也被迫面对时间线、联邦未来以及彼此的选择。
overview.en: In the fourth season, the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise—led by Captain Christopher Pike—embarks on a series of thrilling and emotional adventures across the stars. As they journey to strange new worlds, they battle inner demons and external threats, encounter colorful new characters, reunite with familiar faces and confront terrifying aliens. Through it all, they strive to embrace a bright, hopeful future.

overview.zh: 派克率领企业号驶入恒星风暴，意外穿越时空，回到6500万年前的地球。
overview.en: Pike leads the crew into a stellar storm, sending the Enterprise back 65 million years.

overview.zh: 拉安、斯波克与柯克被困在一艘神秘的联邦失踪飞船上。
overview.en: La'An, Spock, and Kirk get trapped on a mysterious, long-lost Federation ship.

overview.zh: 企业号船员来到一颗充满欢乐的星球，却逐渐受到这里特殊氛围的影响。
overview.en: The Enterprise crew visits a shore-leave planet that guarantees fun in an inebriating atmosphere.

overview.zh: 乌娜被误认为反抗克林贡占领势力的地下首领，不得不卷入当地冲突。
overview.en: Una is mistaken for a virtuous kingpin against a Klingon occupation.

overview.zh: 一次传送事故让除斯波克外的船员全部变成木偶，此时海盗又登上企业号。
overview.en: A transporter accident turns everyone but Spock into puppets as pirates invade the ship.

overview.zh: 企业号陷入异常曲速通道，并不断逼近可能导致灾难的曲速临界点。
overview.en: The Enterprise falls into a slipstream that pushes them to a catastrophic warp threshold.

overview.zh: 神秘的太空捣蛋鬼将企业号船员困进肥皂剧世界，派克也被迫面对失去的人生。
overview.en: A space trickster traps the Enterprise crew in a soap opera as Pike mourns a lost life.

overview.zh: 海军上将里格尔接管企业号，命令船员追踪一艘神秘的外星飞船。
overview.en: Enterprise is commandeered by Admiral Reeger to track down an alien ship.

overview.zh: 船员重返“伊利西亚王国”，却发现这一次他们真的来到了一个奇幻世界。
overview.en: We return to the Elysian Kingdom, but this time on a real fantasy planet.

overview.zh: 时间波动损坏企业号，年轻与年长的乌乎拉必须合作，修复遭到破坏的时间线。
overview.en: A time ripple damages the Enterprise, forcing young and old Uhura to cooperate and fix the timeline.

name.zh: 星际迷航：星际舰队学院

overview.zh: 该系列将讲述一批新星际舰队学员在银河系中最传奇的地方成长的历程。《星际迷航：星际舰队学院》将介绍一群年轻的学员，他们聚集在一起追求共同的希望与乐观梦想。在教官们严密且严苛的监督下，他们将发现成为星际舰队军官所需的条件，同时经历萌芽中的友谊、激烈的竞争、初恋以及威胁学院和联邦的新敌人。
overview.en: A young group of cadets come together to pursue a common dream of hope and optimism. Under the watchful and demanding eyes of their instructors, they will discover what it takes to become Starfleet officers as they navigate blossoming friendships, explosive rivalries, first loves and a new enemy that threatens both the Academy and the Federation itself.

overview.zh: 一群年轻的星际舰队学员，一边在友谊与竞争、初恋情愫中周旋，一边还要应对一个全新的敌人——这个敌人的威胁不仅直指星际舰队学院，更关乎整个星际联邦的安危。而在这些重重纠葛之间，他们仍竭力达到严苛教官们定下的标准。
overview.en: A young group of Starfleet cadets navigating friendships and rivalries, as well as first loves and a new enemy that poses a threat not to just the Academy, but to the Federation. And, in between all that drama, they strive to meet the standards of their exacting instructors.

overview.zh: 天才街头少年凯勒布·米尔，获邀加入星际舰队学院新一届学员班。
overview.en: Caleb Mir, a brilliant street kid, is offered admission to the new Starfleet Academy class.

overview.zh: 新学年伊始，凯勒布·米尔不禁开始怀疑，自己是否真的适合星际舰队学院。
overview.en: Caleb questions whether he belongs at Starfleet Academy as the new academic year begins.

overview.zh: 学院学员们为跻身一支精英小队而激烈角逐，与此同时，星际舰队学院与一所宿敌院校之间，一场恶作剧大战愈演愈烈。紧张局势迅速升级，不仅危及学员们刚建立起来的情谊，更对一段悄然萌芽的浪漫情愫造成了威胁。
overview.en: While our cadets compete to join an elite team at the Academy, a battle of escalating pranks breaks out between Starfleet Academy and a rival school. Tensions rise fast, threatening their newly-emerging bonds and a blossoming romance.

overview.zh: 当一场关乎存亡的危机降临，一个饱受争议却又深受喜爱的种族面临灭顶之灾。一名学员被迫直面自己的过往，以及与家人之间紧张僵化的关系。在她选择用一种意想不到的方式应对困境之际，娜拉必须争分夺秒，竭力拯救这个种族免遭灭绝的命运。
overview.en: When an existential crisis threatens to wipe out a beloved but infamous Star Trek species, a cadet is forced to confront his past and strained relationship with his family. As he pursues an unexpected method of coping, Nahla races against time to save this species from extinction.

overview.zh: 一名学员立志解开星际舰队的一桩古老悬案，踏上了一场自我探寻的旅程，也逐渐领悟到走出独属于自己的道路的真正意义。与此同时，娜拉应允协助一位同僚议长，主持一场繁复的异星仪式。
overview.en: As a cadet sets out to solve an ancient Starfleet mystery, she embarks on a journey of self-discovery and learns the value of forging her own path. Meanwhile, Nahla agrees to help a fellow chancellor with an elaborate alien ritual.

overview.zh: 学员们登上一艘废弃星舰，执行首次实战训练任务，却遭遇了一股全新的危险敌势力，生死存亡之际，众人只得拼死求生；与此同时，娜拉向一个意想不到的对象寻求援助。
overview.en: During the cadets' first training mission on an abandoned ship, they encounter a dangerous new enemy and must fight for survival while Nahla seeks help from an unexpected source.

overview.zh: 学院假期来临，学员们返乡归巢，却不得不直面一场艰难抉择 —— 是顺从家人的期许，还是坚守心中的星舰梦想。
overview.en: During a school holiday, cadets return home and must choose between family expectations and dreams.

overview.zh: 一位客座教官到访星际舰队学院，他以非传统的教学方式，引导学员们梳理内心情绪，直面成为一名星际舰队军官所需肩负的一切。
overview.en: A visiting instructor arrives at the Academy and uses an unorthodox method to help the cadets process the emotions of what it takes to become a Starfleet officer.

overview.zh: 年关将至，凯勒布不得不做出抉择 —— 是奔赴曾向往的人生，还是坚守在星际舰队学院打拼出的一切。与此同时，娜拉为信守承诺，不惜打破舰队条例。
overview.en: As the year ends, Caleb must choose between the life he wanted and the life he's built at Starfleet Academy. Meanwhile, Nahla breaks protocol to keep her promise.

overview.zh: 季终篇章，宿敌卷土重来，娜拉被迫直面自身过往的失误；星际舰队学院的学员与教官们接下一项看似不可能完成的任务 —— 拯救联邦，而这场行动也将定义星际舰队的未来。
overview.en: The return of an old enemy forces Nahla to confront her own mistakes as the cadets and instructors undertake a seemingly impossible mission to save the Federation, while defining the future of Starfleet.
